The government answered that initial refusals were about 140 to 300 a year, mostly reversed, with COA and municipalities handling procedures and a guidance document in preparation.
Because status holders have left COA, it is not centrally recorded how many status holders under the hotel and accommodation scheme refuse a home.
Omdat statushouders zijn uitgestroomd bij het COA, wordt niet centraal bijgehouden hoeveel statushouders onder de Hotel- en accommodatieregeling een woning weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de stilgevallen vergunningverlening in Brabant

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders ask the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen why permit granting in Brabant has stalled due to nitrogen deposition in vulnerable nature, questioning the EU targets, the impact on housing and farmers, and the AERIUS model update. The Minister answers that the province as competent authority halted permits because the Natura 2000 analyses cannot support the required conclusion, affecting about 1050 homes in two plans, and defends the nitrogen policy while not committing to scrapping it.
It falls within the responsibility of the province as competent authority to make such an assessment.
Het valt binnen de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie als bevoegd gezag om een dergelijke afweging te kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de onbereikbaarheid van energiebedrijven

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the minister why energy companies were hard to reach about the price cap and why the cap was not better prepared and more generous. The minister acknowledged the overload, said suppliers are working to improve service and app information, and refused to widen the cap or backdate it.
The price cap was established under great time pressure.
Het prijsplafond is onder grote tijdsdruk tot stand gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen die zijn gesteld door het lid Kops over het bericht dat Utrecht bewoners dwingt van het gas af te gaan

An MP asked the housing minister about Utrecht forcing residents off gas, the alleged cost burden and electricity impact, and whether forced transition is justified. The minister defended the neighbourhood approach, said the Utrecht experiment saves residents money, and called compulsion a justified last resort for those opposing the transition, while declining to answer some questions and referring others to the municipality.
What the exact costs and benefits per home or resident are in the Utrecht neighbourhood Overvecht-Noord, and on what calculations they are based, you would best ask the municipality itself.
Wat de exacte kosten en baten per woning of bewoner zijn in de Utrechtse wijk Overvecht-Noord en waar zij deze berekeningen op hebben gebaseerd kunt u het beste vragen aan de gemeente zelf.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Kops (PVV) over het bericht ‘Woede over WOZ gluurders- Gemeente wil interieurfoto’s”.

An MP asked the Minister about municipalities requesting photos of home interiors for WOZ property valuation, questioning their necessity, legal basis, storage, and whether the pilots should stop. The Minister answered that interior condition can only be obtained from owners, that self-made photos are an optional alternative with privacy safeguards and Waarderingskamer oversight, and that data is retained seven years.
Self-made photos are an option and not an obligation.
Zelfgemaakte foto's zijn een optie en geen verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht ‘De Jonge: gemeenten moeten een ‘tandje erbij doen’ om statushouders aan een woning te helpen’

An MP from the PVV asks the housing minister whether it is acceptable that refugees with residence permits receive priority access to social housing and furnishing allowances while Dutch housing seekers wait, and whether the minister is doing enough for Dutch citizens. The minister rejects the framing, explains that municipalities have discretion over urgency categories and furnishing credit, and says the housing of permit holders is a national agreement to relieve asylum reception.
Municipalities can themselves determine which categories of housing seekers they can include as an urgency category.
Gemeenten kunnen zelf bepalen welke categorieën woningzoekenden zij als urgentiecategorie kunnen opnemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Madlener over het in Brussel bereikte principeakkoord over de uitfasering van de nieuwverkoop van personenvoertuigen en lichte bedrijfsvoertuigen met een interne verbrandingsmotor

PVV MPs Kops and Madlener asked the government to react to the EU agreement phasing out new petrol and diesel car sales by 2035 and to explain how ordinary motorists can keep driving and afford cars. State Secretary Heijnen defended the EU deal, said the 2035 phase-out does not ban existing cars, pointed to EV subsidies, a forthcoming IBO-klimaat review and studies of post-2025 scenarios, and did not accept the characterisations of policy as absurd.
Following the Bontenbal motion, I committed to the Chamber to develop scenarios for EV stimulation after 2025.
Naar aanleiding van de motie Bontenbal 2 heb ik de Kamer toegezegd om scenario’s voor EV-stimulering na 2025 uit te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Kops over de dreigende sluiting van 200 zwembaden

PVV MPs Maeijer and Kops asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about reports that 200 public swimming pools face closure due to energy costs, including what the government will do and how sport stays affordable. The minister acknowledged the concern, said the figures cannot be substantiated, pointed to existing energy support schemes and a pending review of sport-sector needs, and promised a further update in November.
These figures cannot be substantiated concretely, but I do share the concerns about the impact of rising energy costs on public swimming pools.
Deze cijfers zijn niet concreet te onderbouwen, maar ik deel wel de zorgen omtrent de impact van de stijgende energiekosten voor openbare zwembaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het stikstofreducerende middel Kopros

An MP asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen whether the ammonia-reducing manure additive Kopros, reportedly effective in Switzerland and in Dutch farms, could be added to the RAV emission-factor list, and why innovations abroad are not recognised in the Netherlands. The Minister answered that the Dutch recognition procedure requires full measurements in practice barns, that a provisional factor is possible with conditions, that support schemes exist, and that the Kopros claims cannot yet be endorsed because measurements are incomplete.
It is therefore also possible to get onto the RAV list with a provisional emission factor before the measurements are completed.
Het is daarom ook mogelijk om voorafgaand aan de metingen met een voorlopige emissiefactor 3 op de Rav-lijst te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Kops over het bericht 'Chronisch zieken hebben weinig baat bij het prijsplafond: ‘Het voelt als een oneerlijke strijd’'

PVV MPs Agema and Kops asked how the government will address chronically ill and disabled people who cannot afford energy bills, including whether the energy price cap can be raised or differentiated for high medical energy use. The minister acknowledged the hardship, said differentiation within a price cap is not feasible, pointed to municipal Bijzondere Bijstand and other measures, and promised to inform parliament on a related motion.

In reply to your questions 5 and 6, the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport will inform Parliament about the motion by MP Van der Plas et al. on energy compensation for higher energy costs due to medical causes.
Als antwoord op uw vraag 5 en 6 zal de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS) het Parlement informeren over de motie van het Kamerlid Van der Plas c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht 'Energiebedrijven wijken niet: laat aangekondigde prijsverhogingen gaan door'

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the minister why energy suppliers were still raising prices on 1 October despite rules against it, and whether he would stop the increases. The minister replied that the regulator ACM had told suppliers to comply and could enforce, and that the five largest suppliers had withdrawn their increases; he did not directly commit to blocking them himself.
It is up to the independent regulator Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) to start any investigation into possible legal violations.
Ik heb ook aangegeven dat het aan de onafhankelijk toezichthouder Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) is om een eventueel onderzoek te starten naar mogelijke wettelijke overtredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht Natuur kan nog slechter tegen stikstof, normen moeten mogelijk strenger

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about a report on European critical nitrogen loads suggesting stricter Dutch norms, asking its basis, its relation to the Remkes talks, why the UN was involved, and whether the minister would scrap the report and policy. The minister replied the report covers European critical loads without Dutch-specific statements, that the Netherlands does not report nitrogen figures to the Commission as alleged, that Dutch application will be updated using the best available knowledge, and that the results are taken seriously.
The report does not use data on nitrogen deposition in the Netherlands.
Het rapport maakt geen gebruik van gegevens over stikstofdepositie in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de Nederlandse gasprijs als hoogste in Europa

MPs Kops and Wilders (PVV) asked why Dutch households face the highest gas prices in Europe, questioning the government's energy relief and whether energy is affordable. Minister Jetten answered that the government is concerned, that cross-country comparisons are incomplete, that about EUR 7 billion of purchasing-power measures were taken with a focus on vulnerable households, and that further targeted measures will be announced on Prinsjesdag.
Parliament will be informed about this on Prinsjesdag.
Hierover wordt uw Kamer met Prinsjesdag geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Kops over de dieselvoorraad in Nederland

MPs Madlener and Kops asked the government about diesel and other fuel stocks in the Netherlands, the risk of shortages if Russian oil is boycotted, and crisis plans, including bunker supplies for shipping. The minister answers that strategic stocks still cover about 85 days of domestic demand, that restocking is starting, that the Landelijk Crisisplan Olie is being updated, and that import data is publicly available.
At this moment, the restocking and expansion of these strategic stocks is being started.
Op dit moment wordt gestart met het opnieuw aanvullen en uitbreiden van deze strategische voorraden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over met het bericht Nieuwbouw daalt in wooncrisis – Opnieuw minder vergunningen afgegeven

An MP from the PVV asks why building permits for new housing keep falling during the housing crisis, whether the minister's own targets are being met, how many projects are stalled by nitrogen rules, and whether migration is crowding out Dutch home seekers. The minister answers that capacity, construction prices and nitrogen uncertainty are the causes, points to funding and monitoring measures and an unchanged 900,000-home target, admits nitrogen stalls cannot be fully quantified, and rejects the claim that housing is prioritised for asylum holders.
The central government does not have a central overview of (planned) housing construction projects in the Netherlands.
De rijksoverheid beschikt niet over een centraal overzicht van (beoogde) woningbouwprojecten in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Edgar Mulder over een artikel in het Algemeen Dagblad (22 juli jl.) 'Pal naast Natura 2000-gebied in Barchem wil Natuurmonumenten grote huizen bouwen’

MPs Kops and Edgar Mulder asked why Natuurmonumenten may build four homes next to a Natura 2000 area in Barchem while farmers may not, and whether this serves nature. The minister answered that the homes fit the zoning plan and the Rood voor Rood scheme, that emissions and nature gains result, and that no action against Natuurmonumenten is warranted.
Organisations and companies in the Netherlands are free to pursue initiatives within the law.
Het staat organisaties en bedrijven in Nederland vrij om initiatieven te ontplooien binnen de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de financiële voordelen van kernenergie

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about a Groningen study claiming nuclear power is financially and climate-wise more efficient than offshore wind and solar, and challenges the government on nuclear plans and wind subsidies. The Minister answers that studies on the future energy mix and nuclear's role are pending for the summer, that nuclear is not excluded, and that no subsidies are currently given for offshore wind parks, while concrete nuclear plans will be informed before the summer recess.
I will inform you about that before the summer recess.
Ik informeer u daarover voor het zomerreces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de warmtepompplicht

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning, with the Minister for Climate and Energy, about the planned heat pump obligation, questioning its cost to households, its feasibility for pre-1995 homes, its savings and climate effect, and whether it distracts from the housing shortage. The government rejects the framing, stresses that households remain free to choose the installation with exceptions for unsuitable homes, and argues hybrid heat pumps save money and cut gas use, while describing the enforcement and suitability criteria as still to be worked out.
We will further elaborate on the enforcement of the standard in the coming period.
De handhaving van de normering gaan we de komende tijd verder uitwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de ondergrondse opslag van CO2

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about CO2 capture and storage, questioning its cost, the Porthos subsidy, safety risks, and comparisons with failed projects. The Staatssecretaris answered that CCS is a necessary technology for climate targets, that Porthos subsidy is a maximum commitment budget likely to be lower in practice, and that storage risks are judged acceptable under mining law, but gave no firm total subsidy figures.
It is therefore not possible to state now how much subsidy will be spent on CCS in the coming years.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk nu aan te geven hoeveel subsidie besteed gaat worden aan CCS in de komende jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over vertraging bij de afhandeling van smartegeld in Groningen

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about delays in paying immaterial damage (smartegeld) in Groningen, the repeated promises to speed things up, the coordination problems between the NCG and IMG, and whether a crisis approach will be taken. The State Secretary acknowledged delays, pointed to faster processing and the phased rollout at IMG, defended the two-organisation structure and listed acceleration measures, and committed to informing parliament on a crisis approach at short notice.
I will inform the House about this at very short notice.
Ik informeer uw Kamer hierover op zeer korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'EU: aardgas is duurzaam'

An MP asks the government how its stance on natural gas squares with the EU's classification of gas as sustainable and with its policy to phase out gas in homes, and questions the effect of Dutch CO2 cuts given emissions elsewhere. The minister rejects the view that the EU label is good news, says inclusion in the taxonomy is temporary and conditional and does not alter Dutch climate ambitions, and maintains that the gas phase-out in buildings continues.
The taxonomy is neither a prohibition nor a requirement, does not detract from the climate targets applying to the Netherlands, and therefore does not conflict with Dutch climate policy.
De taxonomie is verbod noch gebod, doet niets af aan de klimaatdoelen die gelden voor Nederland en staat daarmee niet haaks op het Nederlandse klimaatbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over boomverbrandingen voor biomassa

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister for Climate and Energy why complete trees are still burned for biomass, why the government claims biomass is climate neutral, and demands a full list of biomass subsidies and an end to them. The minister says the NEa investigation results are awaited, admits the sources of wood are not known per project for confidentiality reasons, and refuses to withdraw existing subsidies, while stopping new subsidies for low-temperature heat from woody biomass.
The origin of the wood is not known per project. This is because it concerns commercially confidential information.
De herkomst van het hout is niet bekend per project. Dit komt omdat het bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de berichten 'Chaos rond energiegeld – Willekeur in gemeenten' en 'Steeds meer huishoudenskunnen energierekening nauwelijks nog voldoen'

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the government about reports of chaos and arbitrariness in municipal distribution of the one-off energy allowance and about households struggling with energy bills, including whether energy suppliers were using debt collectors. Minister Schouten answered that the government has taken relief measures, that municipalities have policy freedom in the allowance, and that the state guarantees financial compensation to municipalities, while leaving much of the response to local democracy and existing debt assistance channels.
With these commitments, in my view there is no longer any brake on the objective of the bill.
Met deze toezeggingen bestaat er naar mijn mening geen rem meer op de doelstelling van het wetsvoorstel
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de vergoeding aan kolencentrales voor het beperken van hun productie

MP Kops (PVV) asks the Climate minister why compensation for limiting coal plant output could cost up to 1.5 billion euros, and why coal plants are not run at full capacity given the energy crisis. Minister Jetten defends the output limit as necessary under the Urgenda ruling, says compensation claims are under review and will be reported to parliament, and says he will act if supply security becomes unacceptably at risk.

I will inform your House of this as soon as possible and will take into account the Urgenda ruling and the concerns about the security of gas and electricity supply in light of the situation in Ukraine.
Ik zal uw Kamer daar zo snel mogelijk over informeren en betrek daarbij het Urgenda-vonnis en de zorgen over leveringszekerheid van gas en elektriciteit in het licht van de situatie in Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de schadelijke gezondheidseffecten van windturbines

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether wind turbines cause health harm to nearby residents, whether a 10-times-tip-height distance norm should be kept, and whether projects and existing turbines should be halted. The minister answered that health complaints are taken seriously, that a new national norm is being prepared via a plan-mer, and that no commitment to halt projects was made.
For wind turbines, the policy (the norms) must be redone following the ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State of 30 June 2021.
Voor windturbines geldt dat het beleid (de normen) opnieuw gemaakt moet worden na de uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State van 30 juni 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het verder opendraaien van de Groningse gaskraan

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked whether raising Groningen gas extraction and exporting Groningen gas to Germany breaks the government's promise to close the field, and why 30,000 damage claims remain open. The state secretary answered that a decision on the extraction level will be taken before 1 April 2022, that claims are being handled with a six-month target, and that export cannot stop immediately because export contracts and household demand abroad constrain it.
Before 1 April 2022 I will take a definitive decision on the extraction level.
Voor 1 april 2022 zal ik een definitief besluit nemen over het winningsniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de schaarste aan gas en de productiebeperking van kolencentrales

An MP from the PVV asked the minister why coal plant output limits take effect on 1 January 2022 given gas scarcity, rising imports from coal plants abroad, and climate effects. The minister defended the flexible energy mix and the planned coal output cap as compatible with supply security, promising to monitor and act if risks emerge.
If I conclude that this measure leads to unacceptable risks for the security of electricity supply or gas supply, I will take measures to prevent this.

Als ik tot de conclusie kom dat deze maatregel tot onaanvaardbare risico's leidt voor de leveringszekerheid van elektriciteit of de voorzieningszekerheid van gas, zal ik maatregelen nemen om dit te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over dreigende grootschalige stroomuitval

An MP asked the minister about media reports and expert warnings of large-scale power outages in the Netherlands and Europe in winter 2021-2022, linked to gas scarcity, coal plant closures and weather-dependent renewables. The minister replied that electricity supply is currently secure, citing TenneT monitoring and ENTSO-E outlooks, outlined measures such as a possible strategic reserve and a Value of Lost Load study, and rejected the claim that renewables and coal closures endanger supply.
The security of electricity supply is currently in order.
De leveringszekerheid van elektriciteit is momenteel op orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de berichten 'Epidemioloog haalt uit: ‘RIVM-conclusies over windmolens deugen niet’' en 'RIVM verzweeg invloed windlobby op positieve rapporten'

An MP from the PVV asked the government about claims that RIVM reports on wind turbine health effects were too favourable and influenced by the wind industry, and about measures to protect residents. The minister declined to take a position on the scientific dispute, acknowledged hinder and sleep disturbance as health effects, and pointed to a planMER and RIVM work, while refusing to halt wind turbine construction.
For a substantive response I therefore refer to the response of the RIVM.
Voor een inhoudelijke reactie verwijs ik daarom naar de reactie van het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het de leden Kops en Mulder over de rampzalige gevolgen van de EU-klimaatplannen voor de landbouw

PVV MPs Kops and Mulder asked whether EU climate plans (Fit-for-55, Farm to Fork) would cause large food price rises, deforestation and worsening nature, citing a German study. The minister responded that the study uses unrealistic hypothetical assumptions and covers only part of the strategy, that the government shares the goal of affordable food but supports the EU climate plans, and that these plans protect nature and cut emissions.
These assumptions are not realistic because they are not part of the climate plans of the European Commission.
Deze aannames zijn niet realistisch omdat ze geen onderdeel uitmaken van de klimaatplannen van de Europese Commissie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Kops over de gastekorten en het bericht dat het Russische Gazprom minder gas levert

PVV MPs De Roon and Kops asked the government about gas shortages, reduced Gazprom deliveries, nuclear energy and mandatory gas storage reserves. The State Secretary answered that Dutch-specific gas imports cannot be isolated, that high prices reflect supply and demand factors, that nuclear energy is not excluded, and that storage obligations are not currently necessary.
It is only possible to measure European gas imports from Russia.
Het is enkel mogelijk om de Europese gasimport vanuit Rusland te meten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over stijgende gasprijs

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about rising gas prices, the resulting higher energy bills, the possible need for a strategic gas reserve, and energy poverty. The government answered that it cannot directly set tariffs but is adding temporary energy tax reductions for 2022, extra funds for insulating vulnerable households, rejects a strategic gas reserve for now, and says it monitors energy affordability.
The cabinet has no direct influence on supply tariffs but keeps energy prices and their consequences closely in view.
Het kabinet heeft geen directe invloed op de leveringstarieven maar houdt de energieprijzen en de consequenties daarvan scherp in beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, Markuszower en Wilders over woningweigering door statushouders

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether it is acceptable that refugee status holders (statushouders) refuse housing offers, citing reports of families expelled from a reception centre, and requested data on refusals since 2010. The minister answered that refusals are rare and mostly handled by COA's procedure, gave figures showing 1,696 refusal procedures since 2013 with 1,598 judged unjustified and 137 eviction procedures started, and rejected calls to deport such persons.
Of the total number of housing refusals, 98 were found justified and 1,598 were found unjustified.
Van het totale aantal woningweigeringen zijn er 98 terecht en 1.598 onterecht bevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Tegenslag voor aardgasvrij maken van woonwijken: voor¬loper Purmerend loopt vertraging op'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior whether the Purmerend gas-free neighbourhood pilot should be stopped given its delays, high costs and the lack of accountability to the central government for the subsidy. The Minister replied that the planning was not unrealistic, that costs are inherent to the experimental phase, that the Rijk will keep funding it, and that the programme's evaluation will follow in 2022.
Municipalities do not have to account to the central government for spending under this type of grant.
Gemeenten hoeven bij deze uitkeringsvorm over de uitgave geen verantwoording af te leggen aan het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het SCP-rapport over het klimaatbeleid en de energietransitie

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about a SCP report on climate policy and energy poverty, public participation and the health effects of wind turbines, asking whether climate policy pushes households into energy poverty. The State Secretary rejected that conclusion, acknowledged real distributional risks, and pointed to participation efforts, a RIVM expertise point on wind turbines and health, and a planned report in spring 2022.
I take the SCP report very seriously, and it strengthens my commitment to shaping the transition so that people share in its benefits and burdens as fairly as possible.

Ik neem het rapport van het SCP dan ook zeer serieus, en het sterkt mij in de inzet van het kabinet om de transitie zo vorm te geven dat mensen zoveel mogelijk delen in de voordelen en de nadelen van de transitie zo eerlijk mogelijk worden verdeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over malafide makelaars

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about reports from Vereniging Eigen Huis of unfair practices by estate agents (favouritism, price inflation, envelope bribes, staged 'no interest' claims) and the scale of complaints. The Minister condemned these practices, said she is working with industry bodies on binding rules for a fair, transparent and enforceable purchase process, but gave no firm timeline or legal change.
I am therefore currently working with industry associations and other relevant parties on concrete agreements on a fair, transparent and enforceable purchase process.
Ik werk daarom momenteel met brancheorganisaties en andere betrokken partijen aan concrete afspraken over een eerlijk, transparant en handhaafbaar koopproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Kops over ontbossing voor biodiesel uit palm en soja

Two MPs asked the government whether biodiesel from palm and soy oil, which they say has driven deforestation, should be stopped and whether the policy undermines forest protection. The government answered that such crops are excluded in the Netherlands, that domestic biodiesel comes only from waste and residues, and that EU sustainability criteria and phase-out rules for high-ILUC crops apply.
In line with the motion by MP Schonis, the cabinet is working to also have soybean oil classified as a feedstock with a high ILUC risk.
Conform de motie van het lid Schonis 6 spant het kabinet zich daarbij in om ook sojaolie aan te laten merken als een grondstof met een hoog-ILUC risico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Kops over de stijgende energielasten

PVV MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about rising household energy bills, the CO2 price and energy poverty, and whether the government would stop the stacking of climate taxes. The state secretary answered that supply tariffs are set by the market, that the government only directly controls energy taxes, that energy taxes were cut for households under the Climate Agreement, and that the government monitors the energy bill closely while defending the ETS and climate policy.
The cabinet only has direct influence over energy taxes and therefore cannot steer the development of the total energy bill.
Het kabinet heeft alleen directe invloed op de belastingen op energie en kan daarom niet sturen op de ontwikkeling van de totale energierekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over stijgende energielasten door de vele windturbines, zonnepanelen, laadpalen, warmtepompen etc.

An MP from the PVV asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why rising energy bills from grid expansion for renewables, EVs and heat pumps should be accepted, and whether the energy transition should be halted. The State Secretary acknowledges grid congestion and affordability concerns, defends the transition as feasible and affordable, and states that the regulator ACM oversees network tariffs.
The Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) supervises this as regulator.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) ziet hier als toezichthouder op toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over ‘de miljardenverslindende klimaatkruistocht van Urgenda’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why the Urgenda climate ruling costs billions for a marginal emissions reduction, who sets climate policy, and whether the new Urgenda lawsuit over a penalty payment and the collective action provision (art. 3:305a BW) should be questioned. The State Secretary answered that climate policy is for politicians but the government must comply with the court ruling, rejected the claim that costs are absurd, said the penalty amount is for the judge to decide, and defended the collective action right as useful.
The collective action right as anchored in article 3:305a BW I consider a useful and meaningful element of our legal system.
Het collectief actierecht zoals dat is verankerd in artikel 3:305a BW acht ik een nuttig en zinvol element van ons rechtssysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de rechtszaak tegen Shell

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders questioned the court ruling ordering Shell to cut emissions by 45% by 2030, arguing it was political and that climate science and the court's reasoning were contradictory. The ministers defended the court as acting within civil law on a duty of care, said the economic consequences are not yet known, and refused to withdraw from the Paris Agreement or the national climate law.
It is not yet known what consequences the ruling will have. An analysis is now being carried out, on which the House will be informed after the summer.
Het is nog niet bekend welke gevolgen de uitspraak zal hebben. Er wordt nu een analyse uitgevoerd, waarover de Kamer na de zomer wordt geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over een Europese CO2-heffing voor huizen

An MP asks the state secretary about a proposed EU carbon levy on homes passed through gas suppliers, its price effects and a EU solidarity fund, and whether the Dutch government will reject it. The government answers that the Fit-for-55 proposals are not yet published, that an emissions trading extension is not a household tax, that it will assess any proposal critically and that energy must stay affordable, without committing to reject it.
The cabinet awaits the Commission's proposals and will weigh them once it is clear what the whole package looks like.
Het kabinet wacht de voorstellen van de Commissie af en zal een afweging maken als duidelijk is hoe het gehele pakket er uit ziet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Kops over het bericht dat er weer miljoenen worden uitgetrokken voor de huisvesting van asielzoekers

MPs Markuszower and Kops asked whether millions spent on renovating the Gilze asylum centre and on housing for asylum seekers, including a EUR 50 million housing scheme, is justified given the Dutch housing shortage. The government answered that the renovation maintains monumental COA buildings and that the EUR 50 million scheme is mostly unearmarked, serves several priority groups, and eases pressure on social housing, while refusing to end asylum reception.
Of this amount, EUR 3 million is specifically earmarked for developing so-called interim facilities.
Van dit bedrag is € 3 miljoen specifiek bestemd voor het ontwikkelen van zogeheten tussenvoorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Markuszower over het mét subsidie huisvesten van grote statushoudersgezinnen

MPs Kops and Markuszower (PVV) asked why municipalities receive subsidies to house large refugee-status-holder families, calling it absurd and unfair to Dutch housing seekers. The State Secretary defended the scheme as necessary because large families stay too long in COA reception, and refused to end it or to have refugees find housing abroad.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht ‘Ruimte voor half miljoen woningen in het groen’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about an EIB report claiming 500,000 homes could be built in green areas, whether the national government should take more control of housing construction and override Utrecht's wind turbine plans at Rijnenburg, and whether closing borders to asylum seekers and immigrants from Islamic countries would ease the housing shortage. The minister replied that planned capacity is sufficient until 2030, that peripheral building is locally constrained and not feasible before 2030, that regional steering will be strengthened with the next cabinet, that the Rijnenburg case is addressed in a separate letter, and that border closure is not a realistic solution.
I share the conclusion that it will not be possible to build a million homes only within urban areas.
Ik deel de conclusie dat het niet zal lukken om een miljoen woningen alleen binnenstedelijk te bouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de stijgende energielasten naar aanleiding van het artikel ‘Rekening energie door dak – Nota kan oplopen tot +200’ in de Telegraaf

An MP from the PVV asks the minister why energy bills keep rising, questioning the CO2 price, climate levies and the EU ETS, and whether climate policy is affordable. The state secretary answers that the government controls only energy taxes, which were unchanged, that market supply tariffs are rising for market reasons, and that the government defends the ETS and affordability while weighing household income in budget decisions.
The cabinet only has direct influence over energy taxes.
Het kabinet heeft alleen directe invloed op de belastingen op energie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het opkopen van duurzame-energiepapieren in het buitenland

An MP from the PVV asks why the Netherlands is spending up to 200 million euros on statistical transfers of renewable energy from abroad to meet its 2020 EU target, and calls the climate targets unachievable and unaffordable. The State Secretary defends the statistical transfer as a legitimate, necessary last resort to avoid EU fines, explains the basis for the amount, and rejects calls to stop the policy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Kops over het artikel 'Vogels overleven vlucht langs nieuwe windmolens Tweede Maasvlakte gegarandeerd dankzij deze radar'

PVV MPs Madlener and Kops asked the ministers about a planned wind park on the Tweede Maasvlakte, its bird and bat impacts, the loss of beach and kitesurfing amenity, and costs of stoppages. The minister answered that impacts were assessed under the Nature Protection Act, mitigation including a bird radar and bat shutdowns applies, the municipality consulted on kitesurfing, and Eneco bears stoppage costs.
The effectiveness of the radar system will be further investigated in the coming years.
De effectiviteit van het radarsysteem zal de komende jaren nader worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Energienota onder druk – Uitbreiding stroomnet kost 102 miljard euro'

An MP from the PVV asks whether the energy transition, including a 102 billion euro grid expansion, is unaffordable, and whether the government will halt it. The Minister replies that the transition must be affordable, cites PwC's estimate of a modest rise in household grid tariffs, and rejects calls to abandon climate policy.
Network operators want the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) to decide to reimburse investments in the electricity grid more quickly.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) besluit om investeringen in het elektriciteitsnet sneller te vergoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de wachttijden voor sociale huurwoningen

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the Minister of Interior about long waiting times for social rental housing, linking them to housing allocated to status holders and alleged discrimination against Dutch citizens. The Minister rejected the claim that status holders displace Dutch applicants, cited measures to accelerate construction, and said discrimination in the housing market is being tackled through awareness, information and new municipal instruments.
The approach to discrimination in the housing market is being intensified, through awareness and information provision, but also by giving municipalities new legal instruments and enforcement powers.

De aanpak tegen discriminatie op de woningmarkt wordt geïntensiveerd, door in te zetten op bewustwording en informatievoorziening, maar ook door gemeenten nieuw wettelijk instrumentarium en handhavingsmogelijkheden te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Artsen uit Noord en IJburg: windmolens dicht bij woongebied wel degelijk riskant'

An MP from the PVV asks the minister whether wind turbines close to residential areas in Amsterdam pose health risks, citing a letter from over 100 doctors and a Danish study, and questions whether the RIVM literature review is outdated. The state secretary responds that the RIVM review remains valid, additional Dutch research will be scoped by end 2021, a Expertisepunt Windenergie en Gezondheid will be set up, and the noise norm with an accepted 9% seriously-annoyed risk is maintained.
Nevertheless, I share the need for more knowledge about the Dutch situation and therefore for additional research.
Desalniettemin deel ik de behoefte aan meer kennis over de Nederlandse situatie en dus aan aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Kops over het bericht dat 11.000 vergunninghouders in de tweede helft van dit jaar een woning moeten krijgen

PVV MPs Markuszower and Kops asked why about 11,000 asylum permit holders should receive housing within six months when Dutch citizens wait years, and whether they should be denied housing and borders closed. The minister replied that asylum protection is required by law, that housing allocation is handled by municipalities under a half-yearly quota, that no nationality-based distinction is made, and that closing borders is not a realistic solution.
No distinction is made in the Netherlands on the basis of nationality.
Er wordt in Nederland geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Netbeheerder Stedin gaat bij gemeenten langs voor € 200 miljoen'

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Stedin's request to its municipal shareholders for 200 million euros to reinforce the grid, the rise in network costs, municipal tax increases, and grid reliability linked to the energy transition. The minister answers that the investment is normal business and that the network tariffs are set and supervised by the independent regulator ACM, while promising to evaluate the n-1 regulation and examine the role of the state in grid capital needs.
ACM, as independent regulator, supervises that grid operators can recover their efficient costs including a reasonable return.
ACM ziet als onafhankelijke toezichthouder toe dat netbeheerders hun efficiënte kosten kunnen terugverdienen inclusief een redelijk rendement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Gasunie vraagt om jaarlijkse bijdrage van €100 miljoen om draai te maken naar ‘groen’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why Gasunie's request for an annual state contribution of 100 million euros to make a hydrogen business case viable should not be seen as unjustified subsidy, and questioned the need for hydrogen infrastructure and higher gas taxes. The minister answered that the government is still researching with grid operators whether part of the gas network can carry hydrogen, will wait for results (due in May) before taking positions, and argued that temporary subsidies can be justified for CO2-reducing technologies not yet on a level playing field.
By mid-May the research will be ready and will be sent to the House.
Medio mei is het onderzoek gereed en zal het aan de Kamer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de rampzalige kaalkap van bossen voor biomassa

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that large forest areas in Estonia and Latvia are being clear-cut for wood pellets used in the Netherlands, and whether earlier denials and the policy on biomass are defensible. The minister denies that whole forests are cut for Dutch pellets, cites Estonian data showing forest area growing, defends biomass as climate-neutral during the transition, and promises to revert on the Van Esch motion on ending subsidies.
I will revert as soon as possible on the implementation of the Van Esch motion (Kamerstuk 30 175, no. 360).
Ik kom zo spoedig mogelijk terug op de uitvoering van Motie Van Esch (Kamerstuk 30 175, nr. 360 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over aardgas als duurzame en klimaatvriendelijke brandstof

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked whether natural gas should be classed as a sustainable fuel under the EU Taxonomy, why households are being moved off gas, and whether the gas-free neighbourhood pilots should stop. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes the Commission's proposal to classify gas plants as sustainable, that the transition is voluntary and aligned with the Climate Agreement, and that the Netherlands remains committed to its climate targets.
The Netherlands therefore spoke out against the Commission's new proposal to classify private investments in gas power plants as sustainable under conditions.
Nederland heeft zich dan ook uitgesproken tegen het nieuwe Commissievoorstel om private investeringen in aardgascentrales onder voorwaarden als duurzaam aan te merken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het verduurzamen van huurwoningen

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Interior whether the cost of making social rental homes sustainable (around 100,000 euro per home, as reported) is absurd, why costs seem to have doubled since 2018, and why the minister speaks of 'sustainability' while gas is called a sustainable fuel. The minister rejects the 100,000 figure, cites ABF research putting gas-free conversion at roughly 23,000 to 29,000 euro plus about 8,000 euro insulation, and defends scaling up and subsidies while defining sustainability as energy improvement toward gas-free homes.
I do not recognise this amount.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht 'Huizen aardgasvrij maken is complex en kost ook meer dan verwacht'

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the ministers whether the government would stop the natural-gas-free neighbourhoods programme, citing an EIB study estimating costs of about 40,000 euro per home and doubts about affordability. The Minister of Interior answered that the EIB case is not representative, that costs will fall through innovation, that the programme is a learning exercise, and that the government will not stop the transition.
I do not share that conclusion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over rillen in een gasloos huis

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the ministers about tenants in gas-free homes in Nijmegen's Meijhorst who were cold and faced rising energy bills, and whether the energy transition is affordable. Minister Ollongren said the situation is unpleasant, that Portaal is contacting tenants and will visit them, rejected the claim that the energy transition is unaffordable, and disputed the Ecorys projection of rising energy poverty.
I therefore do not get the impression that housing corporation Portaal is trying to shift the cause onto the residents.
Ik heb dan ook niet de indruk dat woningcorporatie Portaal de oorzaak op bewoners probeert af te wentelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, Van Aalst en Wilders over nieuwe rekenregels voor geluid die de woningbouw lam dreigen te leggen

PVV MPs asked whether new noise calculation rules for cumulative noise would stall housing construction, and whether windmill noise would be counted less strictly. The government answered that it is aware of the housing shortage, that the updated aviation noise rule is still under joint impact analysis with local partners and an interim transitional provision keeps the current formula, and that separate noise norms for windmills remain and their noise is included in cumulative assessment without being weakened.
Together with the administrative partners it has been agreed to jointly carry out a further impact analysis of the possible consequences of updating the aviation noise calculation rule.
Met de bestuurlijke partners is afgesproken gezamenlijk een nadere impactanalyse uit te voeren naar de mogelijke consequenties van de actualisering van de rekenregel voor luchtvaartgeluid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de schadelijke gezondheidseffecten van windmolens en biomassacentrales

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether wind turbines and biomass plants harm residents' health, why they are not removed, whether enforcement via penalties or shutdowns has been used, and whether climate policy is harmful. The government replied that noise norms protect residents, that evidence of direct health effects is lacking, that three penalty orders for turbine noise have been imposed since 2013, and that it does not accept that climate policy is harmful.

I have asked the RIVM to make existing knowledge on low-frequency noise in general, including from sources other than wind turbines, more accessible and to examine which aspects of low-frequency noise require further research.

Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd om de bestaande kennis omtrent laagfrequent geluid in het algemeen, dus ook afkomstig van andere bronnen dan windmolens, beter toegankelijk te maken en na te gaan naar welke aspecten van laagfrequent geluid nader onderzoek gewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht 'Huurder moet langer wachten en is duurder uit'

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the Minister of the Interior whether the decline in social rental stock, longer waiting times, rent rises and priority allocation of social housing to status holders were acceptable, and whether rents would be cut. The minister rejected the criticism, citing growing corporation output, planned rent measures and CBS data showing rent increases below inflation, and refused to accept that priority for status holders is unfair.
I consider it important that housing corporations build more social rental homes.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat corporaties meer sociale huurwoningen gaan bouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de betrouwbaarheid van VN-klimaatrapporten op 16 oktober 2020

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether a UN report on disasters, which speaks of a rising trend while also claiming a 15% decline since 2000, is reliable, and urges Netherlands to withdraw from the Paris Agreement. The minister rejects the criticism, defends IPCC reports as the primary basis for climate policy, and refuses to withdraw from the Paris Agreement.
The Netherlands will continue to commit to ambitious implementation of the Paris Agreement in the fight against climate change.
Nederland zal zich in de strijd tegen klimaatverandering blijven inzetten voor een ambitieuze uitvoering van de Overeenkomst van Parijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht 'Proefproject 'van gas af' stilgelegd'

PVV MPs asked whether the Purmerend Overwhere-Zuid gas-free pilot, a Programma Aardgasvrije Wijken project, was halted, questioning costs, the EUR 6.9 million allocation and the EUR 100 million second round. The minister replied that the pilot was not stopped but delayed for evaluation, that the funds are a municipal decentralisation grant rather than a subsidy, and that she stands by the programme's learning goal.
An overview of progress at the pilot sites will be sent to your House in the first quarter of 2021 through the annual progress report of the PAW.
Een overzicht van de voortgang bij de proeftuinen zal ik aan uw Kamer sturen in het eerste kwartaal van 2021 middels de jaarlijkse voortgangsrapportage van het PAW.
Antwoord op vragen van de lede Madlener en Kops over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake een biomassacentrale in Vierpolders

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether his earlier denial of subsidy for a biomass plant in Vierpolders still holds, given that the plant received a subsidy decision in 2018. The minister said the subsidy is only paid once the project is realised and producing, the decision will not be withdrawn if the initiator complies with the conditions, and the plant's wood fuel meets sustainability requirements, while refusing to halt all biomass and climate subsidies.
That is not the case at this moment.
Dat is op dit moment nog niet het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over haperende warmtepompen en stijgende energierekeningen

An MP from the PVV asked ministers why residents of Spoorwijk in The Hague have had faulty heat pumps and rising energy bills, and questioned the energy transition's affordability and claims of lower bills. The minister replied that the Warmtewet protects heat consumers, the government cannot guarantee total energy bills, and the Ecorys and PBL findings are disputed, while a related question was answered separately.
It is therefore not the role of the Minister to assess these individual cases.
Het is dan ook niet de rol van de Minister om deze individuele gevallen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over “stijgende energierekeningen en vaste lasten door warmtepompen”

An MP (PVV) asks the ministers whether the energy transition to gas-free homes, including heat pumps, has raised energy bills and created energy poverty, and whether they will reverse course. The government replies that the transition must stay affordable, cites subsidies and the Warmtefonds, declines to comment on the Transvaal case (referred to the complaints committee), disputes the Ecorys projections as outdated, and rejects reversing the connection obligation removal.
I cannot go into this specific case, as the matter is being referred to the complaints committee.
Ik kan niet ingaan op dit specifieke geval, aangezien de kwestie wordt voorgelegd aan de geschillencommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Emiel van Dijk en Kops over het aan hun lot overlaten van kwetsbare Nederlanders ten gunste van statushouders in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked whether it is unacceptable that Amsterdam gives housing priority to refugee status holders over Dutch residents with medical problems, and whether subsidies to Amsterdam should be cut. The minister replied that there is no discrimination by nationality, that municipalities set their own urgency categories and must meet the statutory quota, and that she will not withhold support but is funding pilots and housing projects.
No distinction is made in the Netherlands on the basis of nationality.
In Nederland wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het onmiddellijk stopzetten van biomassa

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why biomass is treated as a climate reduction and whether it should be stopped immediately, calling the policy climate fraud. The minister rejected the fraud characterisation, maintained that biomass is necessary for the Climate Agreement targets, and said the sustainability framework for biomass will be sent to parliament after the summer.
In the sustainability framework for biomass expected to be sent to parliament after the summer, the cabinet will further address the role of sustainable biomass in achieving those targets.
In het duurzaamheidskader voor biomassa dat naar verwachting na de zomer aan Kamer zal worden aangeboden, zal het kabinet nader ingaan op de rol van duurzame biomassa om die doelen te bereiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Kops over het bericht ‘Zes locaties in beeld voor stookfabriek in Vierpolders’

Two PVV MPs asked the government about a reported plan for a biomass wood-burning plant in Vierpolders, claiming biomass emits more CO2 than coal and gas, questioning whether it is sustainable, and asking whether subsidies will be stopped. The minister rejected the claims, said biomass is a necessary transition alternative, confirmed no new subsidy for solid wood-fired electricity and no subsidy for heat plants under 5 MWth in the autumn 2020 SDE++ round, and promised a sustainability framework and a phase-out strategy.
No new subsidy will be made available for the use of solid woody biomass for the production of electricity only.
Er wordt geen nieuwe subsidie beschikbaar gesteld voor het gebruik van vaste houtige biomassa voor de productie van uitsluitend elektriciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de inzet van biomassa

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports of forest clearing in Estonia for biomass pellets, whether biomass is CO2-reducing, and whether the 14 billion euro in subsidies is justified. The minister denies that whole forests are cleared for Dutch use, says subsidised pellets must meet sustainability criteria that are checked, defends biomass as climate-neutral when sustainable, and rejects ending climate policy.
All wood pellets used in the Netherlands with subsidy must meet strict sustainability criteria.
Alle houtpellets die in Nederland met subsidie worden gebruikt, moeten voldoen aan strenge duurzaamheidscriteria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, Kops en Wilders over de achterstelling van Nederlandse woningzoekenden

PVV MPs asked whether the municipality of Vlaardingen giving refugees priority on social rental housing is discrimination against Dutch citizens, whether municipalities should be barred from such priority, and whether temporary asylum permits should be withdrawn so social housing goes only to Dutch nationals. The minister rejected the discrimination framing, explained that municipalities set their own urgency categories and that housing refugees serves integration, and refused to withdraw asylum permits.

After the mandatory urgency status of status holders was removed from the Housing Act on 1 July 2017, municipalities can themselves decide which categories of housing seekers they wish to include as urgency categories in the housing ordinance.

Nadat de verplichte urgentiestatus van statushouders per 1 juli 2017 uit de Huisvestingswet is gehaald kunnen gemeenten zelf bepalen welke categorieën woningzoekenden ze als urgentiecategorie in de huisvestingsverordening wensen op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over 100 miljoen euro subsidie voor de versnelde verduurzaming van huurwoningen

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior why EUR 100 million is being spent on accelerating energy renovation of rental homes during the corona and housing crises, and whether this raises rents. The minister defends the Renovatieversneller as part of the Climate Agreement that lowers renovation costs and keeps tenants' energy-bill savings in line with rent increases, but gives no per-home cost figures.
Landlords and tenants agreed in the social rental accord that rents will not rise more than the saving on the energy bill.
Verhuurders en huurders hebben in het sociaal huurakkoord afgesproken dat de huren niet meer zullen stijgen dan de besparing op de energierekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over aardgasvrije woningen (Startmotorkader Warmtenetten)

An MP from the PVV asked about the Startmotorkader Warmtenetten, which uses a EUR 200 million subsidy so housing associations can disconnect homes from gas and connect them to heat networks while keeping tenants' housing costs neutral, and questioned whether heat-network costs can really stay below gas bills and who ultimately pays. The Minister for Home Affairs defended the framework and the cost-neutrality goal, noting it is not guaranteed for every household, that the Warmtewet caps tariffs at the gas-reference level, that costs are shared between companies, landlords, society and residents, and that the government will not halt the gas-free transition.
I will inform the House after the summer about the results of this study.
Ik informeer uw Kamer na de zomer over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het sluiten van de Nederlandse kolencentrales

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the Netherlands would close coal plants when other countries keep building them, whether this undermines energy reliability, and whether the government will withdraw from the Paris Agreement. The minister answered that the government is preparing additional measures under the Urgenda ruling, that the coal ban has a small global temperature effect but is an effective national CO2 measure, that energy reliability is currently in order according to TenneT, and that the government will not withdraw from Paris.
I will inform the House shortly about the results of this.
Ik zal de Kamer op korte termijn informeren over de resultaten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht ‘Klimaatwet Timmermans onderuitgehaald’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report that the European Parliament's legal service judged the Commission's climate law proposal unlawful for delegating essential elements to delegated acts, and whether the Minister would reject the plans and consider leaving the EU. The Minister agreed the 2030–2050 trajectory is an essential element that should not be delegated, shared concern about the choice of delegated acts, but rejected the claim of illegality, defended monitoring of member states, and refused to withdraw support or consider EU exit.

Specifically on this point, the cabinet states in the BNC fiche that setting the optimal trajectory between 2030 and 2050 is seen as an essential element of the law, and therefore the cabinet argues that the trajectory between 2030 and 2050 should not be able to be fixed as a delegated act.

Specifiek op dit punt stelt het kabinet in het BNC-fiche dat het vaststellen van het optimale traject tussen 2030 en 2050 als essentieel element van de wet wordt gezien en daarom pleit het kabinet dat het traject tussen 2030 en 2050 niet als gedelegeerde handeling dient te kunnen worden vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de groeiende steun voor kernenergie

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why he supports nuclear energy yet the Climate Agreement excludes it, whether subsidies for wind and solar should stop, and whether a 25% land-use scenario for renewables is realistic. The Minister replies that no CO2-free source is excluded, that new nuclear is unlikely before 2030, that he will not give regular subsidies to any flexible capacity, that subsidies for wind and solar on land end after 2025, and that the 25% land-use claim is unrealistic and alarmist.
It is my aim not to give regular subsidies to any form of flexible capacity.
Het is mijn inzet om geen reguliere subsidie te geven aan welke vorm van regelbaar vermogen dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Kops over anti-Israëlstraatnaamborden in Eindhoven

PVV MPs Wilders and Kops asked whether street-name signs in Eindhoven describing Israeli places as 'in Palestine' are factually wrong, and whether the municipality should be forced to replace them promptly. Minister Knops agreed the descriptions are incorrect, said the municipality now plans to replace the signs this spring and has already updated the register, and rejected the claim that the signs reflect anti-Israel policy.
The municipality is thereby acting in accordance with its 2014 commitments.
Daarmee handelt de gemeente conform de toezeggingen uit 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht ‘Nu stoppen met aardgas zorgt juist voor méér CO2-uitstoot’

An MP asked the minister whether ending gas use increases CO2 emissions, citing a professor's claim, and asked about contradictions in Dutch gas and climate policy and whether the Paris agreement should be abandoned. The minister defended a phased exit from domestic gas use by 2050 and continued extraction from Dutch fields, and said sustainable biomass is climate-neutral.
In short, we are gradually phasing out natural gas, but not gas altogether.
We gaan, kortom, geleidelijk van het aardgas af, maar niet van het gas af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over stijgende energielasten door warmtepompen en laadpalen

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether rising household energy bills from heat pumps and EV chargers are acceptable, and whether he would abandon climate policy. The minister acknowledged grid investment is needed, pointed to the Climate Agreement and tax measures to lower bills in 2020, and refused to end the climate policy.
The cabinet understands the concerns surrounding the energy bill and considers it important that the energy transition be feasible and affordable for everyone.
Het kabinet begrijpt de zorgen die rond de energierekening leven en vindt het belangrijk dat de energietransitie voor iedereen haalbaar en betaalbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over te pessimistische klimaatonderzoeken

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the minister whether climate research using pessimistic scenarios like RCP8.5 is misleading and whether the government will stop its climate agenda and withdraw from the Paris Agreement. The minister rejected these claims, arguing that worst-case scenarios remain necessary for risk planning, that sea-level rise risks justify precautionary policy, and that Dutch participation in the Paris Agreement continues.
The Netherlands is and remains a party to the Paris Climate Agreement, because it offers the greatest chance of an effective global approach
Nederland is en blijft partij bij het Klimaatakkoord van Parijs, omdat dat de grootste kans biedt op een effectieve mondiale aanpak
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de Rotterdamse klimaatplannen

An MP from the PVV asks the ministers whether Rotterdam's plan to remove gas from 100,000 homes and halve CO2 emissions in ten years is feasible, whether municipalities may force homeowners off gas, what climate effect the Rotterdam plans achieve, and whether the Climate Agreement should be scrapped. The minister rejects the criticism, citing the Climate Agreement, a DCMR estimate of 0.15 megaton CO2 reduction from Rotterdam's building measures by 2030, and voluntary choices for residents, and refuses to withdraw the plans.
No one is forced to participate.
Niemand wordt gedwongen mee te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Emiel van Dijk over eigen woningen voor Nieuwegeinse statushouders

Two PVV MPs asked whether it is discriminatory that Nieuwegein reserves 30 social rental homes for single refugee status holders, and whether asylum permits should be revoked so social housing goes only to Dutch residents. The minister answered that nationality-based distinctions are not made, that municipalities set their own urgency categories, that the social housing construction claim is disputed, and that revoking permits is refused.
No distinction is made in the Netherlands on the basis of nationality.
In Nederland wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de verkoop van Eneco

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the sale of Eneco to a Japanese consortium should be stopped, and what it means for jobs, customers and energy prices. The minister answers that the municipal shareholders decide on the sale, that he will test the deal against public interests such as security of supply, and that Eneco stays Dutch with jobs and customer terms unchanged.
Subsequently, I will test the takeover against its effects on the public interests of public safety, security of supply and security of delivery.
Vervolgens zal ik de overname toetsen op de gevolgen van de investering voor de publieke belangen van openbare veiligheid, voorzieningszekerheid en leveringszekerheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het toenemende aantal huishoudens dat de energierekening niet meer kan betalen

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the rising number of households unable to pay energy bills and whether the government's energy and climate policy causes energy poverty. The minister rejected the link, pointed to Klimaatakkoord measures shifting costs to businesses and lowering the tax burden on households, and said the government monitors energy bill affordability, but did not commit to reversing policy.
The cabinet keeps a close eye on developments in energy bills and monitors the development of the energy bill.
Het kabinet houdt een vinger aan de pols en volgt de ontwikkeling van de energierekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de stilgevallen woningbouw

An MP from the PVV asks the minister why housing construction is stalling despite stated acceleration goals, why building permits have fallen, what the government will do about nitrogen (PAS) rules and its gas-free building policy, and whether it will allow more building on the urban periphery. The minister answers that the government has prioritised housing, cites record construction figures and a EUR 2 billion housing impulse, attributes the permit decline to nitrogen rulings, labour shortages and cost overruns, and refuses to reverse the gas-connection obligation removal while committing to continue talks with regions.
I am not willing to reverse this.
Ik ben niet bereid dit terug te draaien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Noodkreet bouwers – ‘Ruimte zat in Nederland’'

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister why housing construction is lagging despite promised acceleration, and presses for more greenfield sites, reversal of the gas-connection requirement for new builds, relief from nitrogen rules, and priority for native Dutch citizens over status holders in social housing. The Minister answers that housing policy is a priority with new programmes and deals, that regions must find sites, that the gas connection obligation will not be restored, that nitrogen rules are EU-based with local mitigation options, and that no nationality-based allocation is possible.
I am not willing to reverse this.
Ik ben niet bereid dit terug te draaien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht ‘Pelletfabrieken in North Carolina gesteund met Nederlandse miljarden‘

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether he was aware of reports that Dutch billions support US wood pellet factories, and questioned the sustainability and cost of imported biomass subsidies under the SDE+ scheme. The minister confirmed awareness, said the subsidy regime favours cost-effective techniques with up to 3.6 billion euro for imported pellets, defended the sustainability criteria and the accounting of emissions at the source, and refused to halt biomass or climate policy.
Imported wood pellets – which are not only imported from the United States – currently qualify for a subsidy of up to 3.6 billion euro.
Geïmporteerde houtpellets – die niet alleen uit de Verenigde Staten geïmporteerd worden – komen op dit moment in aanmerking voor maximaal 3,6 miljard euro subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Groene banen illusie – TNO blijkt te optimistisch te zijn geweest over effecten klimaatakkoord'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the government was misled by TNO, which revised its estimate of green job gains from the Climate Agreement to roughly zero in the long run, and whether the climate policy should be scrapped. The minister said TNO's internal complaint procedure worked well, that the study shows short-term job gains may not last, and rejected the claim that climate policy is unaffordable or senseless.
It is commendable that TNO has internal procedures whereby the complaint was taken seriously and that TNO subsequently also attached consequences to it.
Het valt te waarderen dat TNO interne procedures heeft waardoor de klacht serieus is opgepakt en dat TNO er vervolgens ook consequenties aan verbonden heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de schadelijke gezondheidseffecten van klimaatbeleid

An MP asked ministers whether municipal health service (GGD) warnings that climate policy such as wind turbines, biomass plants and home insulation may harm health, and claims of noise and biomass harms, are accepted. The minister says the GGD concerns are taken seriously, promises a letter in a few months on health and safety risks of the energy transition, and rejects claims that climate policy is harmful or that the government does not weigh health effects.
Therefore I will send your House a letter in a few months with a further response to those reports.
Daarom zal ik over enkele maanden uw Kamer een brief sturen met een nadere reactie op die rapporten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops vragen gesteld naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Biomassa veel vervuilender dan gas en kolen’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether biomass is a wasteful, polluting energy source and whether subsidies should stop, citing an EASAC report. The minister rejected that reading, said the report raises valid points rather than concluding biomass is wasteful, and committed to restraint in new biomass subsidy decisions if supply shortfalls are expected by 2030.
During that period the cabinet commits to exercise restraint in issuing new subsidy decisions to stimulate the use of sustainable biomass.
Gedurende die periode committeert het kabinet zich om terughoudend te zijn in het afgeven van nieuwe subsidiebeschikkingen ter stimulering van het gebruik van duurzame biomassa
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het tekort aan netcapaciteit

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the saturated electricity grid, which cannot yet connect new solar parks, wind farms and large companies, makes the renewable energy policy absurd, and whether the government would stop connecting renewables and subsidies. The minister rejected the framing, explained grid reinforcement, flexibility and transport-capacity requirements for SDE+ subsidies, and promised a progress letter in early 2020.
Early 2020 I will inform the House about the progress of these measures.
Begin 2020 zal ik de Kamer informeren over de voortgang van deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Emiel van Dijk over extra druk op de woningmarkt door nieuwe vluchtelingenstroom

Two PVV MPs asked whether the arrival of refugees adds pressure on the housing market and whether statushouders should be denied housing that Dutch citizens need. The minister answered that housing is allocated without nationality distinctions, that municipalities set urgency categories locally, and that pilots with flexible housing solutions are being funded.
No distinction is made in the Netherlands on the basis of nationality.
In Nederland wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer, Wilders en Kops (allen PVV) over een nog hogere bijdrage van Nederland aan de Europese meerjarenbegroting

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he agreed with Commissioner-designate Timmermans that rich EU states like the Netherlands should pay more into the EU budget for a climate agenda, and how he would reduce Dutch contributions. The minister answered that the government supports the Green Deal and a Just Transition Fund to be financed within the MFF framework, rejected the claim that the nomination harms the Dutch negotiating position, and committed to pressing for budget savings and possible corrections on contributions.
Once the Commission proposal for the fund has been published, the cabinet will inform your House further.
Zodra het Commissievoorstel voor het fonds is gepubliceerd zal het kabinet uw Kamer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over gasvrij wonen

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the ministers about SCP findings that public support for gas-free homes is narrow and that households feel imposed upon, and whether the policy should be abandoned. Minister Ollongren answered that support is important and taken seriously, that the policy will not be scrapped, that co-decision with residents is planned via neighbourhood pilots, and that nuclear energy is not excluded.
It is essential that measures in the built environment are implemented with good involvement of residents and building owners.
Het is essentieel dat de uitvoering van maatregelen in de gebouwde omgeving plaatsvindt met een goede betrokkenheid van bewoners en eigenaren van gebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Kops over het bericht 'Alarmerende klimaatstudie blijkt niet te kloppen’ in de Telegraaf van 30 september 201

PVV MPs Wilders and Kops asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether a retracted sea-level study and claims of climate scaremongering undermine government climate policy. The minister replied that correcting errors shows peer review works, that policy rests on the IPCC, that the retracted study used a method without broad consensus, and that sea-level rise and climate change are well documented.
There is no question of scaremongering.
Er is geen sprake van bangmakerij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over huurders met financiële problemen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that 800,000 tenants are in financial trouble, and whether rents should be lowered and social tenants protected. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to existing rent support, the rent-increase bill, planned tenant discount measures, and said integral rent reduction is not appropriate, while noting landlords may give individual or temporary discounts.
Integral rent reduction is not a solution for this and is therefore not appropriate.
Integrale huurverlaging is daarvoor geen oplossing en is dan ook niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht ‘Emoties lopen hoog op bij ontruiming recreatiewoning’

The PVV MP Kops asked the Minister of the Interior about the municipality of Zeewolde's enforcement against permanent residence in holiday bungalows, including fines, seizure of pensions, forced eviction, lock changes, and inspection methods, and asked about residents' remedies and about Polish migrant workers living there. The Minister replied that land-use and enforcement are decentralised, that residents can object, appeal to the courts or complain about conduct, and that the municipality sets its own enforcement priorities.
If the municipality enforces wrongly, the resident can object to the municipality or challenge the enforcement decision in court.
Indien de gemeente onterecht handhavend optreedt kan de bewoner bezwaar maken bij de gemeente of het handhavingsbesluit aanvechten bij de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht Hoofdpijn in je milieuhuis

PVV MPs asked whether residents of gas-free renovated homes in Zoetermeer's Palenstein district, who reported headaches and poor air, show that the energy transition harms health, and whether the gas-connection obligation and the gas-free programme should be reversed. The minister acknowledged ventilation problems that have been fixed, rejected reversing the gas-free policy and the pilot neighbourhoods, and defended the climate case while promising monitoring by GGD Haaglanden.
Based on these measurements, GGD Haaglanden classifies the ventilation (CO2 values) in the measured homes as good.
Op basis van deze metingen classificeert GGD Haaglanden de ventilatie (CO 2 -waarden) in de gemeten woningen als goed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht Paula (79) en Wiggert (82) in stress door ‘gedwongen’ verduur

A PVV MP asked the Minister of the Interior about elderly tenants in The Hague facing forced gas disconnection and renovation by housing corporation Vestia, with rent increases, no replacement housing and health concerns. The minister acknowledged the stress, described compensation and support measures, rejected the claim that Vestia should be called to order, and said no other similar cases are known.
I have no data on the number of these.
Over het aantal daarvan heb ik geen gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over stijgende nieuwbouwprijzen door klimaatregeltjes.
