An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior why new-build home prices rose 17% in a year, whether climate rules such as the removal of the gas connection obligation add unnecessary costs, which regional climate rules raise prices, and whether the minister will reverse these rules. The minister acknowledged the rising prices and the cost estimates for gas-free construction, promised further research and results by early 2020, but refused to reverse the abolition of the gas connection obligation.
I am not willing to reverse this.
Ik ben niet bereid dit terug te draaien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over drijvende zonnepanelen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a plan for floating solar panels on open water and the grid operator Liander's call to limit new solar parks due to grid capacity, including costs, subsidies, environmental risks and whether connections should be stopped. The Minister answered that the market will develop such projects under the technology-neutral SDE+ scheme, that effects on nature are uncertain but may offer opportunities, and that grid scarcity is being addressed through consultation with local governments, grid operators and market parties, referring to a letter on grid capacity.
It is still unclear how large the plans are exactly and whether they will be realised.
Het is nog onduidelijk hoe groot de plannen precies zijn en of ze gerealiseerd zullen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de Stuwmeerregeling Groningen

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister why the one-off Stuwmeer scheme keeps a 1 January 2019 cut-off for the variable compensation (up to 11,000 euro) while extending the 12 June 2019 deadline for the fixed 5,000 euro, creating unequal treatment, and asks whether damage recovery will speed up given that delayed claimants now face longer waits. The Minister replies that the independent TCMG advised against extending the 11,000 euro variant to everyone, that a hard cut-off is needed for an administrable one-off scheme, that claimants may choose between the scheme and the regular process, and that no claims will simply be written off.
It is therefore not appropriate to lightly depart from the TCMG's advice.
Het is dus niet gepast om lichtzinnig van het advies van de TCMG af te wijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Tony van Dijck over hypotheken voor ‘duurhuurders’

PVV MPs Kops and Tony van Dijck asked whether tenants paying high rents should be able to get mortgages based on actual monthly costs, and whether stricter income rules should be relaxed given lost wealth-building. The minister defended current income-based mortgage rules, saying individual case-by-case exceptions (the explain option) are possible and that the pilot by BLG Wonen is being monitored, while refusing a general loosening of income requirements.
I am not in favour of generally relaxing the income requirements for mortgage credit, because this would increase the risk of over-lending to consumers.
Ik ben geen voorstander van het generiek versoepelen van de inkomenseisen voor hypothecair krediet, omdat dit het risico van overkreditering van consumenten doet toenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kops over achterblijvende woningbouwplannen

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether housing construction plans are sufficient to reduce the housing shortage, why the National Housing Agenda has not met its target, and whether local sustainability requirements should be scrapped. The Minister acknowledges regional gaps and risks, says local and provincial authorities bear primary responsibility, and defends their sustainability standards as legally limited and acceptable.
Soon I will send the most recent figures on available planning capacity to the House with the State of Housing report.
Binnenkort zend ik met de Staat van de Volkshuisvesting de meest recente cijfers over de beschikbare plancapaciteit aan de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Kops over het bericht dat een bejaard Nieuwegeins stel dat al vanwege huisuitzetting uit het leven wilde stappen vrijdag opnieuw op straat staat

MPs Agema and Kops asked about an elderly Nieuwegein couple facing eviction and homelessness, questioning priority for status holders in social housing and the closure of care home places. The minister rejected the link to status holders, stated that no one should have to live on the street, and said the couple had found temporary housing.
The couple has thus not ended up on the street.
Het echtpaar is daarmee niet op straat komen te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over Amersfoort dat reeds in 2030 geheel van het gas af wil zijn

An MP from the PVV asks the ministers whether Amersfoort's plan to be fully off gas by 2030 is unrealistic, how municipalities can legally force homeowners off gas, and whether citizens should be protected. The minister rejects the criticism, explains that municipalities currently lack a legal basis to force disconnection but that the Rijk is considering one with legal safeguards and appeal routes, and refuses to withdraw the climate plans.
Municipalities currently have no statutory basis to force homeowners to disconnect from natural gas.
Gemeenten hebben nu geen wettelijke grondslag om huiseigenaren te dwingen van het aardgas af te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het woningtekort

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior about the projected housing shortage in 2030, disputed building permit trends, and whether municipalities and status holders' priority access are to blame. The minister rejects the ABN-AMRO pessimism, argues the shortage will narrow to about 2.4% by 2030 with 76,000 homes a year, points to woondeals and instruments with regional partners, and rejects ending priority for status holders.
I see it as our shared challenge to meet the need for housing, with due regard for all other spatial interests.
Ik zie het als onze gezamenlijke uitdaging om te voorzien in de behoefte aan woningen, met voldoende oog voor alle andere ruimtelijke belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over gasloze sociale huurwoningen

An MP from the PVV asks the ministers whether tenants of social rental housing really want gas-free renovation, questioning its costs of over 100,000 euro per dwelling and the burden on tenants, plus the use of energy coaches. Minister Ollongren rejects the premise, argues tenants can refuse renovation proposals, says the cost figures overstate the case, and defends energy coaching as awareness-raising.
Tenants have the option to reject a renovation proposal from their landlord.
Huurders hebben hierbij de mogelijkheid een renovatievoorstel van hun verhuurder af te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over tijdelijke huurcontracten

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior whether landlords who evict tenants at the end of temporary leases to avoid permanent tenancy rights should be condemned, whether the Housing Market Flow Act failed, and whether rents should be lowered. The Minister answered that temporary leases are known to tenants in advance, promised to report on their use before summer, defended the temporary lease options as serving real needs, and rejected a general rent reduction citing contractual freedom.
On this basis I will inform your House before the summer about the use of these temporary tenancy agreements by landlords.
Ik zal uw Kamer op basis hiervan vóór de zomer informeren over het gebruik van deze tijdelijke huurovereenkomsten door verhuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de vastgelopen woningmarkt

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about the cooling housing market, rising construction, buy-to-let competition, city housing deals, border closure, and priority for refugees in social housing. The Minister answered that prices are normalising, that she is investigating buy-to-let effects and will inform parliament before summer, that housing deals are a long-term Rijk-regio partnership, and that she will not close borders or prioritise nationals exclusively.
I am currently having this investigated and intend to inform your House about it before the summer.
Ik laat dit momenteel onderzoeken en ben voornemens uw Kamer hier voor de zomer over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Kops over het bericht 'Slob: leerplicht gaat vóór klimaatspijbelen'

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education whether the school-strike-for-climate absences should be treated as truancy and whether leerplichtambtenaren should register them as unauthorised absence. The Minister said truancy is never a solution, that schools decide whether absences are truancy and only report at 16 hours in four weeks, and declined to send truancy officers to school climate-strike days.
No, this is up to the leerplicht official in the municipality and the school.
Nee, dit is aan de leerplichtbeambte in de gemeente en aan de school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de stijgende prijzen van nieuwbouwwoningen

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of the Interior about rising new-build house prices, the gas-connection requirement, housing targets, and whether statushouders should give way to Dutch housing seekers. The minister responds that prices rose because of a shift to higher price segments, defends the sustainability policy, reports regional housing-acceleration efforts, and rejects nationality-based allocation.
In the Netherlands no distinction is made on the basis of nationality.
In Nederland wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de achterblijvende woningbouw

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether the government will deliver on its target of one million new homes by 2030, given industry warnings that only half will be finished on time, and why municipalities that resist building are not held to account. The minister answers that housing construction is a priority, cites regional housing deals and the Transformation Facility, notes that construction output rose to nearly 74,000 homes in 2018, and says the responsibility for acceleration lies with regional and local levels.
Accelerating housing construction has the highest priority for me.
Het versnellen van de woningbouw heeft voor mij de hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Kopers in de kou – Lang wachten op energieaansluiting in nieuwbouwwoning'

An MP (PVV) asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about buyers of new homes waiting weeks or months for energy connections, the 18-week legal deadline being missed, compensation, and the shortage of installers amid the energy transition. The minister acknowledged the problem, attributed delays to network operators, capacity shortages and complex projects, said compensation depends on the buyer-builder contract, and promised ongoing work with sector parties and the ACM without committing to a specific new measure.
The statutory 18-week period for connecting customers to electricity is regularly exceeded in practice.
De wettelijke termijn van 18 weken voor het aansluiten van klanten voor elektriciteit wordt in de praktijk regelmatig wordt overschreden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over frauduleuze bemiddelingsbureaus

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that fraudulent intermediary agencies duped desperate housing seekers, including how widespread the fraud is, whether statushouders' priority is unfair, and what will be done. The minister confirms criminal investigations into two suspects with several hundred files, but says it is unknown how many obtained homes, points to weak income verification, rejects the priority objection as a local matter, and promises digitisation exploration and further information in 2019.
There is an ongoing criminal investigation into the suspects and therefore the appropriate criminal measures will be taken.
Er is sprake van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de verdachten en er zal derhalve sprake zijn van de geëigende strafrechtelijke maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over gasimport en lange termijn contracten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the Netherlands has failed to secure gas imports, given GasTerra's warning about supply risks without more long-term contracts, and whether the Groningen gas field will be closed quickly enough. The minister answered that no additional policy is needed because the TTF hub provides ample gas, that the state holds no import contracts, and that Groningen closure will be accelerated via a measures package, without new import obligations.
My assessment is that for the time being no additional policy is needed to secure the necessary gas imports.
Mijn inschatting is dat er vooralsnog geen additioneel beleid nodig is om de benodigde import van gas veilig te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over verblijf op vakantieparken

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about permanent residence in holiday parks, including enforcement, the legal definitions of living versus recreating, and a case at Buitenplaats Horsterwold. The minister replied that these matters are decentralised to municipalities, which set zoning and enforcement, and declined to comment on the private contract or the alderman's statements.
Policy on spatial planning and the use of recreational homes has been decentralised.
Het beleid ten aanzien van ruimtelijke ordening en gebruik van recreatiewoningen is gedecentraliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat er ruim € 1 mln. aan boetes is uitgedeeld aan huiseigenaren die geen energielabel hebben aangevraagd

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior about reports that over 1 million euro in fines were issued to homeowners who did not obtain an energy label, questioning the label's necessity and reliability. The Minister defended the mandatory energy label as an EU-based obligation with high compliance, declined to compensate affected buyers, and rejected abolition.
I do not consider it possible or desirable to abolish the energy label, which is mandatory upon the transfer of a home.
Ik acht het niet mogelijk en niet wenselijk om het energielabel, dat verplicht is bij de overdracht van een woning, af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de vastgelopen woningmarkt

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the housing market is a mess under her watch, whether the national housing agenda is empty, why municipalities are slow to build, and whether social rental homes should go to Dutch applicants rather than refugees with status. The minister rejected the critique, pointed to new measures and regional agreements, and said local allocation choices and the equal-treatment principle apply.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over huurders die gedwongen worden tot werk (en statushouders niet)

An MP asked whether housing corporation Portaal forces tenants of its 'mixed living' homes to work four hours a week, while statushouders are exempt, and whether the Minister would stop this. The Minister answered that the activities are voluntary, carry no consequences for the lease, bring no rent reduction or payment, and that she sees no reason to ask the housing regulator to investigate.
There is no question of mandatory activities.
Er is geen sprake van verplichte werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de stagnerende woningproductie

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about stagnating housing production, falling building permits by municipalities, shortages of construction workers, and whether the 1 July 2018 gas connection ban delays projects. The minister disputes stagnation, cites rising CBS output and a long-term rise in permits, says there is no sign of municipalities obstructing, and outlines the national housing agenda, regional talks and the Crisis- en Herstelwet changes, while declining to reverse the Gaswet change.
I have no indications that there are municipalities that are obstructing.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat er gemeenten zijn die «dwarsliggen».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat statushouders nog altijd met voorrang een woning krijgen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior whether it is unacceptable that refugees with status still receive priority for social housing, and whether this can be stopped given that Dutch citizens wait years. The Minister answered that since 2017 municipalities decide locally whether to treat status holders as a priority category, that it reflects local housing conditions and the municipal housing obligation, and that everyone is treated equally regardless of nationality.

After the mandatory urgency status of status holders was removed from the Housing Act on 1 July 2017, municipalities can themselves determine which categories of housing seekers they wish to include as an urgency category in the housing ordinance.

Nadat de verplichte urgentiestatus van statushouders per 1 juli 2017 uit de Huisvestingswet is gehaald kunnen gemeenten zelf bepalen welke categorieën woningzoekenden ze als urgentiecategorie in de huisvestingsverordening wensen op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Kops en Fritsma over het bericht “Miljardairsfamilie Van der Vorm koopt huizen voor Syriërs (en jij betaalt mee)”

PVV MPs asked why a Rotterdam housing initiative by the SNTR foundation reserves 200 homes for Syrian status holders, calling it discrimination against Dutch citizens, and whether such schemes should be stopped. The minister answered that the scheme responds to housing needs of status holders, that whether it constitutes discrimination is for a court to judge, and that no comparable initiatives are known; he rejected the call to restrict social housing to Dutch nationals.
Whether in this case there is also discrimination is not for the cabinet but for a judge to assess.
Of in het onderhavige geval ook sprake is van discriminatie is niet aan het kabinet, maar aan een rechter om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over huiseigenaren die door de energietransitie op kosten worden gejaagd

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the government will stop municipal natural-gas-free pilot neighbourhoods that impose high costs on homeowners, and calls the energy transition undemocratic. The minister replies that the costs must be shared fairly, that financing instruments are being developed, and that the energy transition is necessary and affordable if proportionate, without committing to halt the projects.
The distribution of the burdens is one of the biggest issues I am currently dealing with.
De verdeling van de lasten is een van de grootste vraagstukken waar ik me op dit moment mee bezig houd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over ‘groene leningen’ voor het energieneutraal maken van woningen

An MP from the PVV asked the ministers about proposed green loans to make homes energy-neutral, including repayment terms, ownership of installations, and affordability. The government answered that a pilot in Heerhugowaard is voluntary, that details such as interest rates, terms and repayment consequences are still being studied, and that it rejects the claim that its climate policy has failed.
Details are still being worked out by the parties involved. I therefore have no insight at this stage into the interest rates, terms and other conditions.
Details worden door de betrokken partijen nog uitgewerkt. Ik heb derhalve in dit stadium geen inzicht in de rentepercentages, termijnen en andere voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Kops over het bericht dat Amsterdam krakende asielzoekers laat zitten

Two PVV MPs asked why undocumented asylum seekers in Amsterdam ('we are here') have been able to squat buildings for years, why the municipality does not enforce the squatting ban, and why they are not detained and deported. The State Secretary answered that the group is under a departure obligation, that forced return is not always possible due to missing travel documents and lack of cooperation by countries of origin, and that courts have largely upheld eviction orders, while referring to a separate letter for the specific case.
For more information on the case the news report concerns, I refer you to the letter the Minister of Justice and Security will send to your House alongside these questions.
Voor meer informatie over de casus waarop het nieuwsbericht van de Telegraaf betrekking heeft, verwijs ik u naar de brief die de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het woningtekort onder senioren

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about a reported shortage of around 100,000 suitable homes for seniors, safety risks for elderly people stuck in unsuitable homes, and government responsibility for the housing shortage. The minister disputes the 100,000 figure as unquantifiable, points to municipal duties under the Wmo and to planned national housing and care programmes, and rejects the claim that statushouders receive favoured treatment.
I do not recognise the figure of 100,000 homes.
Het getal van 100.000 woningen herken ik dan ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘Hypotheekkeurslijf nekt starters en senioren’

MPs Kops and Tony van Dijck asked whether mortgage lenders deliberately refuse maatwerk (tailored) mortgages to starters and seniors, whether strict rules deter lenders, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that lenders choose whether to offer maatwerk for commercial reasons, that the platform maatwerk has improved clarity, that about 43% of lenders now offer it, and promised to inform parliament before the summer after evaluating the outcomes with the sector.
I will inform you about this before the summer.
Ik zal u voor de zomer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Utrecht geeft Qatar 23 miljoen euro cadeau'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that Utrecht gave 23 million euros to Qatar and Credit Suisse via the sale of social rental homes in Kanaleneiland, including whether the sales of homes for 0 euro were acceptable and whether the Aw should investigate Mitros and Portaal. The Minister rejected the characterization of a 23 million euro gift, said the Aw found the sales served housing interests with no sale at 0 euro, and left further conditions and judgment of the municipal council's conduct to Utrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Kops over statushouders die sociale huurwoningen bezet houden

PVV MPs Fritsma and Kops asked how many social rental homes are occupied by status holders, whether the minister withheld this information, and whether that undermines MPs' right to ask questions. Minister Ollongren answered that the number is not centrally registered, offered only a theoretical estimate of about 38,000 homes for Syrian status holders, and said she has no exact figure.
I have no insight into how many social rental homes are currently occupied by status holders, not even after consultation with Aedes and COA.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoeveel sociale huurwoningen momenteel worden bewoond door statushouders, ook niet na afstemming met Aedes en COA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over schimmel in huurhuizen in Haarlem

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about mould and neglected maintenance in around 200 social rental homes in Haarlem owned by Ymere, and whether tenants should keep paying full rent. The minister acknowledged Ymere delayed renovation for about thirteen years, noted that tenants can take complaints to the Huurcommissie, and said she will raise mould problems with the housing association body Aedes and include the issue in the WoON 2018 survey.
Ymere subsequently chose, for various reasons including financial ones, to postpone the renovation.
Ymere heeft daarna echter om verschillende redenen, waaronder financiële, de keuze gemaakt om de renovatie uit te stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, Fritsma, De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht dat Nederlanders langer op de wachtlijst voor een sociale huurwoning moeten staan doordat statushouders en buitenlandse arbeidskrachten

PVV MPs asked whether Dutch social-rent applicants face longer waiting lists because statushouders, foreign workers and students get priority, and whether social housing should go only to Dutch nationals. The Minister said housing supply drives waiting times, that the automatic urgency status for statushouders was removed, that she has no data on how many social rentals statushouders occupy, and that allocation by nationality is ruled out under equal treatment.
I have no insight into how many social rental homes are currently occupied by statushouders.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoeveel sociale huurwoningen momenteel worden bewoond door statushouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Edgar Mulder over het bericht dat de huurtoeslag de komende jaren flink zal dalen

PVV MPs Kops and Mulder asked whether the government knows how many of the 1.4 million rent-allowance households are in debt and how many will fall into financial trouble from cuts to the allowance, and how it can claim households will be better off. The minister answered that the allowance is not being cut but rising slightly less, that debt has multiple causes, that removing the hard income limit and tax cuts leave households better off overall, and that statushouders are treated equally.
It is not known how many of these households receive rent allowance.
Niet bekend is hoeveel van deze huishoudens een huurtoeslag ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat klimaatmaatregelen de burgers klauwen met geld gaan kosten

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports that climate measures will cost households 50-60 euros per month by 2030, whether this is worthless and unaffordable, and why the government does not scrap the measures. The Minister answers that the figures are national additional costs of 49% CO2 reduction (about 3.5-5.5 billion euros), not household energy bills, that a global approach is needed, and that the government will pursue a cost-effective transition.
The Paris Climate Agreement is a breakthrough in the fight against further global warming, and it is our duty to do everything to realise the goals of this Agreement.
Het Klimaatakkoord van Parijs is een doorbraak in de strijd tegen de verdere opwarming van de aarde en het is onze plicht er alles aan te doen om de doelstellingen uit dit Akkoord te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat de NAM de omvang van de noodzakelijke woningversterking veel te laag inschat (Herdruk)

MP Kops asks why NAM estimates only 2,800 buildings need reinforcement in the Groningen earthquake area, questioning its good faith and payment capacity. The minister replies that NAM is liable for all necessary reinforcement regardless of earlier estimates, that inspections already show 3,300 buildings needing it, that TNO will independently review NAM's calculations, and that NAM is being phased out of decision-making in the damage process.
I have asked TNO to independently assess the calculations commissioned by NAM.
Ik heb aan TNO verzocht om de berekeningen in opdracht van NAM onafhankelijk te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Boeren multimiljonair dankzij subsidie'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why a wind farm on the IJsselmeer reportedly yields farmers millions on top of nearly 600 million euros in subsidies, and whether the project should be stopped. The minister defended the subsidies as compensating for innovation risks, said an overcompensation check is under way that could reduce payments, and refused to halt the project.
For this reason the decision provides that the Dutch authorities will carry out a cumulation test for the notified project one year after the installation is put into use.
Daarom is in de beschikking opgenomen dat de Nederlandse autoriteiten voor het aangemelde project een cumulatietoets uitvoeren één jaar na de datum van ingebruikname van de installatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het toenemend aantal gemeenten dat de permanente bewoning van vakantiehuisjes wil uitbannen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about municipalities cracking down on permanent residence in holiday homes, including high penalty payments and the risk of homelessness for residents. The minister answered that data on the number of municipalities and residents affected is not available, that enforcement is a municipal matter, and that the courts judge disputes while residents must find housing themselves.
It is not known how many municipalities permit or prohibit permanent residence in holiday homes.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel gemeenten permanente bewoning van vakantiewoningen toestaan of juist niet toestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat steeds minder starters een huis kunnen kopen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior about reports that fewer starters can obtain a mortgage, asking how many starters are excluded from both buying and renting and whether the LTV limit should be kept from falling further. The Minister replied that the government lacks data on starters who abstain from the market, reaffirmed that LTV will not be cut below 100 percent, and pointed to municipal planning and a mid-rent segment initiative.
Unfortunately I cannot make statements about people who, for various reasons, decide not to start on the housing market as a renter or buyer, as I do not have the relevant data.
Helaas kan ik geen uitspraken doen over mensen die vanwege diverse redenen besluiten om niet te starten op de woningmarkt als huurder dan wel koper, ik beschik niet over de relevante data.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de almaar stijgende huizenprijzen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about rising house prices, Moody's forecast of continued increases, and whether insufficient construction and regulation are to blame. The minister answered that price rises are concentrated in cities for structural reasons, declined to forecast prices, and outlined measures to boost construction and regional housing policy.
For that reason I make no statements about price developments over the next three years.
Daarom doe ik geen uitspraken over de prijsontwikkeling in de komende drie jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, De Graaf en Agema over het bericht dat senioren in Apeldoorn overdonderd zijn door de komst van Turkse leeftijdsgenoten

MPs from the PVV asked ministers whether it is acceptable that a housing corporation in Apeldoorn plans to let vacated flats in a senior complex to Turkish elderly receiving home care, without consulting current residents, and asked for the plans to be stopped. The minister replied that corporations are free to set allocation policy within the Housing and Tenancy Acts, that the corporation appears to have followed the legal consultation procedure, and that residents can complain to the independent complaints committee or the courts, but that the minister has no role in individual allocation policy.
As far as I can tell, the housing corporation has acted within the framework of the law.
Voor zover ik kan nagaan heeft de woningcorporatie binnen de kaders van de wet gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat verhuurmakelaars een manier hebben gevonden om huurders extra op kosten te jagen

MP Kops asked the Minister of Interior whether rental agents were relabelling banned intermediary fees as contract or administration costs and passing them on to tenants, and for what amounts. Minister Plasterk confirmed such practices occur, stated the law clearly prohibits these fees under any name, said no figures on frequency are held, and pointed to existing information for tenants and ACM enforcement against structural violations without proposing new rules.
I do not have figures on the number of intermediaries who wrongly charge disguised intermediary fees.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers van de aantallen bemiddelaars die onterecht verkapte bemiddelingskosten in rekening brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de permanente bewoning op vakantieparken

An MP asked the ministers about permanent residence on holiday parks, including whether residents are being steered there, whether municipal enforcement in the Veluwe leaves people homeless, and whether arbeidsmigranten get new housing while other residents do not. The minister says there is no national overview, that referrals were individual and temporary, that enforcement and housing are local matters coordinated through a municipal programme, and that gemeenten are responsible for their own housing policy.
At national level there is no overview of holiday parks where people live permanently in breach of the applicable zoning, or of the reasons they live there.
Op landelijk niveau is er geen overzicht van vakantieparken waar mensen permanent en in strijd met de geldende bestemming verblijven en om welke redenen zij hier verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over camping Fort Oranje

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the municipality of Zundert handled the closure of camping Fort Oranje, and the residents affected, adequately, including whether earlier, firmer action against criminality could have prevented it. The minister answered that the municipality, which is accountable to its council, concluded the situation was untenable and that it is not for the minister to comment on its policy; the municipality is now assessing individual solutions for residents.
It is not for the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to go further into the policy of the municipality of Zundert; the municipality accounts for this to the municipal council.
Het is niet aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties om verder op het beleid van de gemeente Zundert in te gaan, hierover legt de gemeente verantwoording af aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de huisvesting van vergunninghouders

An MP asked the Minister of Interior why the figures on rejected housing offers for refugee permit holders were given only for 2016, how rejections are judged as justified or not, and why COA rather than a court assesses refusals. The Minister answered that 2016 is the latest full year of data, that COA does not record reasons for rejections in general terms, that COA applies set criteria and can end reception, and that the Minister has no supervisory powers over COA.
The reason why a housing refusal is declared justified or unjustified is not registered by COA.
De reden waarom een woningweigering terecht of onterecht wordt verklaard wordt door het COA niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat het woningtekort nijpend wordt

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about reports of a worsening housing shortage, how many households cannot buy a home, how the price spiral will be stopped, whether municipalities should build more, and why new homes go to refugees. The minister said regional differences exist, that responsibility for matching demand and supply lies with local government, that housing production is expected to average about 70,000 units a year, and that the government will report on regional talks this autumn.
I have therefore taken various measures to support local parties in realising more rental homes in the middle segment.
Ik heb daarom diverse maatregelen genomen om lokale partijen te ondersteunen om meer huurwoningen in het middensegment te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat de woningbouw in de knel komt door gebrek aan bouwgrond

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior about reports that housing construction is constrained by a shortage of building land, including the size of the shortfall and the expected number of homes. The Minister answered that national plan capacity is sufficient but some regions fall short, that the responsibility lies locally and regionally, and that he will report on regional talks in the autumn.
At the General Consultation of 7 June 2017 I committed to your House to report on the regional talks this autumn.
In het Algemeen Overleg van 7 juni 2017 heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd dit najaar verslag uit te brengen van de regiogesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Madlener over het bericht dat de ombouw naar gasloze woningen al snel € 60.000 per woning kost

MPs Kops and Madlener asked the minister whether the reported cost of around EUR 60,000 per home to convert a Nijmegen neighbourhood to gas-free was acceptable, what infrastructure costs and payback period to expect, how residents would be protected from these costs, and whether the money would be better spent on housing. The minister answered that the municipality of Nijmegen is responsible for weighing acceptable costs, that cost predictions are not yet possible, and that a labelling obligation for housing corporations will be explored, leaving final choices to a future cabinet.
At this moment it is not possible to predict when converting to gas-free neighbourhoods will become profitable.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk om te voorspellen wanneer het ombouwen naar gasloze wijken rendabel is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Kops over het bericht “Banken rekenen nog steeds te veel boeterente bij hypotheek”

PVV MPs asked the Finance Minister whether banks still charge excessive early-repayment penalties on mortgages despite the AFM guidance, how many people are affected, what compensation is planned, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges possible overcharging since July 2016, says lenders have pledged proactive compensation, and sees no need for further measures on competition and mobility.
I consider it important that all customers who after 14 July 2016 paid too high a fee under the new rules and the AFM guidance are compensated with retroactive effect.

Ik vind het belangrijk dat alle klanten met terugwerkende kracht worden gecompenseerd die na 14 juli 2016 op grond van de nieuwe regels en de leidraad van de AFM een te hoge vergoeding hebben betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Beertema over het bericht dat studenten te veel huur betalen

MPs Kops and Beertema asked the minister whether 73% of students overpay rent and how many landlords ignore the housing valuation system, and whether the government will act against this. The minister answered that the 73% figure comes from an LSVb survey of self-selected users that is not representative, that rent is freely negotiable, that the government is improving awareness of the rent-tribunal route and will inform parliament before summer.
It is not known in how many rentals the rent deviates from the rent based on the housing valuation system.
Het is niet bekend bij hoeveel verhuringen de huurprijs afwijkt van de huurprijs op basis van het WWS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het rapport ‘De woningmarkt in de grote steden’ van De Nederlandsche Bank

Amendement van het lid Van Raan c.s. over het toetsen en aanpassen van de doelstellingen
Requires a five-yearly review of whether the climate target is met, with targets adjusted if it is not.
Once every five years it is checked whether the target referred to in the first paragraph is being achieved.
Eens in de vijf jaar wordt getoetst of de doelstelling, bedoeld in het eerste lid, wordt behaald.
Amendement van het lid Van Raan c.s. over een doelstelling primair energiegebruik
Adds a 2030 target that primary energy use be 40% lower than in 1990.
Primary energy use in 2030 is at a level 40% lower than in 1990.
Het primaire energiegebruik ligt in 2030 op een niveau dat 40% lager ligt dan in 1990.
Amendement van het lid Van Raan c.s. over het emissiebudget
Adds a national emissions budget to the climate plan, requires a sector-by-sector budget and measures, and has the minister report any overshoot, which the House must monitor.
The House must then monitor this.
De Kamer moet hier vervolgens op toezien.
Amendement van het lid Van Raan c.s. over het vervangen van de term co2- neutral elektriciteitsproductie
Replaces the CO2-neutral electricity goal with a renewable-only electricity goal, so that 100% renewable generation is required by 2050.
This amendment provides that the share of renewable energy will be 100% by 2050.
Dit amendement regelt dat het aandeel hernieuwbare energie per 2050 100% is.
Amendement van het lid Van Raan c.s. over het gebruiken van het begrip brede welvaart bij verantwoording
Amends the climate act so that government accountability reporting must also address broad welfare, including effects on future generations and other countries.
whereby attention is also paid to broad welfare
waarbij tevens aandacht wordt besteed aan brede welvaart
Amendement van het lid Van Raan c.s. over het uitsluiten van bedrijven die voornamelijk fossiele brandstoffen produceren
Excludes companies mainly producing or using fossil fuels from the definition of 'relevant parties' that the ministers must consult on the energy transition law.
with the understanding that parties mainly producing fossil fuels are excluded
met dien verstande dat uitgesloten zijn partijen die voornamelijk fossiele brandstoffen produceren
Motie van het lid Kröger c.s. over een plan B voor de A27 bij Amelisweerd
Asks the government to develop a contingency plan B for the A27 widening at Amelisweerd, with containment measures and agreements on liability and repair costs.
requests the government to develop a plan B, with containment measures
verzoekt de regering, om een plan B te ontwikkelen, met containmentmaatregelen
Motie van het lid Teunissen over een moratorium op stikstofuitstotende MIRT-projecten bij natuurgebieden
Asks the government to impose a moratorium on nitrogen-emitting MIRT infrastructure projects near nature areas until the nitrogen approach is revised.
requests the government to introduce a moratorium on nitrogen-emitting MIRT projects near nature areas
verzoekt de regering, een moratorium in te stellen op stikstofuitstotende MIRT-projecten in de buurt van natuurgebieden
Motie van de leden Teunissen en Kröger over afzien van de verbreding van de A27 bij Amelisweerd
Motion asking the government to abandon widening the A27 at Amelisweerd and redirect the funds to sustainable transport.
requests the government to refrain from the planned widening of the A27 at Amelisweerd.
verzoekt de regering, af te zien van de voorgenomen verbreding van de A27 bij Amelisweerd
Motie van het lid Teunissen over een temperatuurstijging van 1,5°C als sturende voorwaarde bij het Mobiliteitsfonds
Asks the government to make a 1.5°C warming target the guiding condition when designing the Mobility Fund.
requests the government, when shaping the Mobility Fund, to include a climate target with 1.5°C warming as the starting point as a guiding condition
verzoekt de regering, bij het vormgeven van het Mobiliteitsfonds een klimaatdoelstelling met 1,5°C temperatuurstijging als uitgangspunt als sturende voorwaarde op te nemen
Motie van het lid Teunissen over de WHO-normen voor luchtkwaliteit als sturende voorwaarde bij het Mobiliteitsfonds
Motion asks the government to include WHO air quality standards as a steering condition in designing the Mobility Fund.
requests the government, when designing the Mobility Fund, to include the WHO air quality standards as a steering condition
verzoekt de regering, bij het vormgeven van het Mobiliteitsfonds de WHO-normen voor luchtkwaliteit als sturende voorwaarde op te nemen
Motie van het lid Laçin c.s. over de gevolgen van de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie
Motion asks the government to inventory infrastructure projects that may be affected by the ECJ ruling on nitrogen policy and to avoid irreversible steps in those projects.
not to take irreversible steps in these projects.
geen onomkeerbare stappen te nemen in deze projecten
Motie van het lid Teunissen over een verbod op het uitstrooien van rubberkorrels op kunstgrasvelden
Motion asking the government to ban spreading rubber granules on artificial grass pitches to reduce microplastics.
requests the government to ban spreading rubber granules on artificial grass pitches
verzoekt de regering, het uitstrooien van rubberkorrels op kunstgrasvelden te verbieden
Motie van de leden Laçin en Teunissen over het handhaven van het principe "nee, tenzij"
Asks the government to amend the Environment Act so that the 'nee, tenzij' principle for discharges is kept instead of changing to 'ja, mits'.
noting that with the new Environment Act the starting point for discharges changes from 'no, unless' to 'yes, provided'
constaterende dat met de nieuwe Omgevingswet het uitgangspunt ten aanzien van lozingen verandert van «nee, tenzij» naar «ja, mits»
Motie van het lid Teunissen over een verbod op het oplaten van gasgevulde ballonnen
Asks the government to bring deliberate release of gas-filled balloons under the ban on littering.
requests the government to bring deliberate pollution of the environment, such as releasing gas-filled balloons, under the ban on spreading litter
verzoekt de regering, het bewust vervuilen van het milieu, zoals het geval is bij het oplaten van gasgevulde ballonnen, onder het verbod op het verspreiden van zwerfafval te brengen
Motie van het lid Teunissen c.s. over het stimuleren van vergroening
Asks the government to make greening a criterion for climate adaptation measures funded under the Bestuursakkoord Klimaatadaptatie.
requests the government to stimulate greening by including it as one of the criteria for the climate adaptation measures
verzoekt de regering, vergroening te stimuleren door het als een van de criteria op te nemen voor de klimaatadaptiemaatregelen
Motie van het lid Kröger c.s. over aandacht voor het ontstaan van ZZS-stoffen
Asks the government to pay special attention, in its approach to emerging substances, to very persistent substances formed during production processes that enter the environment.
requests the government to pay special attention to the formation of (potential) very persistent substances when addressing emerging substances
verzoekt de regering, om bij de aanpak opkomende stoffen speciale aandacht te besteden aan het ontstaan van (potentiële) ZZS-stoffen
Motie van het lid Laçin c.s. over het controleren van meer dossiers over chemische stoffen door de ILT
Motion asks the government and the ILT to inspect more chemical substance dossiers and refuse permits where crucial information is missing.
requests the government, together with the ILT, to develop a way of working in which the ILT can check more dossiers on registered chemical substances
verzoekt de regering, om samen met de ILT tot een werkwijze te komen waarin de ILT meer dossiers over geregistreerde chemische stoffen kan controleren
Motie van het lid Van Brenk c.s. over het onderzoek naar de verspreiding van legionella
Asks the government to have RIVM prioritise its research on legionella spread from industrial wastewater plants and inform the House quickly of results and next steps.
to inform the House as soon as possible about the outcomes and next steps
de Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over de uitkomsten en vervolgstappen te informeren
Motie van het lid Kwint c.s. over de muziekbeheersing in Nederland
Asks the government to investigate the state of music education and music mastery (muziekbeheersing) in the Netherlands.
requests the government to conduct research into the state of music mastery in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering, een onderzoek te doen naar hoe het staat met de muziekbeheersing in Nederland
Motie van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. over de behoefte aan atelierruimte en creatieve broedplekken
Motion asks government for a quick scan of demand for artist studios and creative hubs and to explore other parties managing studios as social property, including vacant buildings.
requests the government to carry out a quick scan of the need for studio space and creative hubs
verzoekt de regering, een quick scan uit te voeren naar de behoefte aan atelierruimte en creatieve broedplekken
Motie van het lid Kwint c.s. over kunst- en cultuuronderwijs door gediplomeerde vakdocenten
Asks the government to ensure arts and culture education is taught by qualified subject teachers.
requests the government to ensure that arts and culture education is provided by qualified subject teachers
verzoekt de regering, ervoor zorg te dragen dat het kunst- en cultuuronderwijs wordt verzorgd door gediplomeerde vakdocenten
Motie van het lid Geluk-Poortvliet c.s. over behoud en ontsluiting van het muzikaal erfgoed
Motion asks government to investigate how preservation and access to musical heritage can be improved and report to the Chamber.
requests the government, in consultation with the institutions involved, to investigate how the preservation and accessibility of musical heritage can be promoted
verzoekt de regering, in overleg met de betrokken instellingen te onderzoeken op welke wijze het behoud en de ontsluiting van het muzikaal erfgoed
Motie van het lid Ellemeet c.s. over meer vrije programmeringsruimte voor instellingen
Asks the government to consider more flexible programming for cultural institutions, such as institutional rather than activity subsidies, in the advisory request to the Raad voor Cultuur.
requests the government, to consider the possibility of more free programming space for institutions
verzoekt de regering, om de mogelijkheid van meer vrije programmeringsruimte voor instellingen
Motie van het lid Laçin c.s. over effectief optreden tegen milieucriminaliteit
Asks the government, together with the ILT, to investigate how to act more effectively against environmental crime and inform the House in Q1 2019.
requests the government, together with the ILT, to investigate how effectively action can be taken against environmental crime
verzoekt de regering, samen met de ILT te onderzoeken hoe effectief tegen milieucriminaliteit kan worden opgetreden
Motie van het lid Teunissen over het percentage verplichte bijmenging van biobrandstoffen niet verhogen
Asks the government not to raise the mandatory blending percentage of biofuels because PBL found a shortage of sustainable biomass and the risk of more unsustainable biofuel.
requests the government not to raise the mandatory blending percentage of biofuels
verzoekt de regering, om het percentage verplichte bijmenging van biobrandstoffen niet te verhogen
Motie van het lid Kröger c.s. over scenario's voor fiscalisering van mobiliteit
Asks the government to consult sector and civil society on ideas for taxing mobility by use and to map scenarios for fiscalising mobility towards 2030.
also requests the government to map out scenarios for the design of fiscalising mobility towards 2030
verzoekt de regering tevens om scenario's in kaart te brengen voor de inrichting van de fiscalisering van mobiliteit richting 2030
Motie van het lid Teunissen over invoeren van het concept "Carnivoor? Geef het door!" op het ministerie van IenW
Asks the government to introduce the 'Carnivoor? Geef het door!' concept at all meetings organised by the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management.
to introduce the concept 'Carnivoor? Geef het door!' at all meetings the ministry organises
het concept «Carnivoor? Geef het door!» in te voeren op alle bijeenkomsten die het ministerie organiseert
Motie van de leden Dik-Faber en Teunissen over afvalscheiding uitbreiden naar ten minste alle IC-stations
Asks the government to hold ProRail and NS to the green deal and extend waste separation at stations to at least all InterCity stations.
requests the government to hold ProRail and NS to the agreements of the green deal
verzoekt de regering, ProRail en NS aan te spreken op de afspraken uit de green deal
Motie van het lid Teunissen over gebruik van nascheidingsinstallaties voor hoogwaardige recycling
Asks the government to investigate how companies such as NS and ProRail can use post-separation sorting installations for high-grade recycling for separately collected waste.
requests the government to investigate how companies such as NS and ProRail can use post-separation installations for high-grade recycling for separately collected waste
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe bedrijven zoals NS en ProRail met gescheiden ingezameld afval gebruik kunnen maken van nascheidingsinstallaties voor hoogwaardige recycling
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht ‘Nederland is een ontbossingsland’

MP Teunissen asked the government about reports that the Netherlands contributes to global deforestation via finance, ports and consumption, including Rabobank's ranking and the adequacy of EU deforestation rules. The minister answered that companies and financial institutions must follow OECD and UN standards, that existing EU sustainability rules apply but are being simplified, and that the EUDR enforcement details remain uncertain pending final EU text.

How a financial institution gives effect to compliance with these international guidelines, and what choices it makes regarding investments or engaging with companies, is the responsibility of the institutions themselves.

Hoe een financiële instelling invulling geeft aan de naleving van deze internationale richtlijnen, en welke keuzes zij maakt ten aanzien van investeringen of het aangaan van gesprekken met bedrijven, is de verantwoordelijkheid van de instellingen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht ‘Kabinet negeert alarmbellen rond nieuwe Zeeuwse kerncentrales’

An MP asks the minister why warnings about once-through cooling risks for new nuclear plants in the Westerschelde (Deltares, Commissie mer reports) were not shared with parliament, and whether cooling-tower alternatives, costs, ecological risks and irreversible steps like founding NEO NL are being properly disclosed. The minister answers that the reports were already public, that intermediate studies are not published, that the full location picture and the decision will come to parliament after summer 2026, and that NEO NL's establishment is planned in Q1 2026 in parallel with the plan-MER.
It is not customary, and not useful for overview, to publish every interim step or send it to the House.
Het is niet gebruikelijk, en voor het overzicht niet zinvol, om elke tussentijdse stap te publiceren of naar de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Teunissen, Dobbe, Piri en Hirsch over berichten in de uitzending Pauw & De Wit op NPO1 van 6 oktober 2025 over het Global Sumud Flotilla

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports on mistreatment of Dutch participants in the Global Sumud Flotilla intercepted by Israel, and whether the Netherlands would support an independent investigation, file an ICC complaint, or seek legal justification for the interception. The minister answered that the government raised detention conditions with Israel, requested Israel's legal basis for the interception (still awaited), declined to take further steps such as an ICC complaint, and promised no new concrete action beyond continued diplomatic pressure.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has asked the Israeli authorities for a justification of the legal basis for Israel's actions following the interception of the ships.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft de Israëlische autoriteiten verzocht om een onderbouwing van de juridische basis voor het Israëlische handelen naar aanleiding van de onderschepping van de schepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de herbeoordeling van F-35-export Israël

Teunissen (PvdD) asked whether the re-assessment of F-35 parts exports to Israel applied the EU Common Position criteria, why the Israel exclusion under AV009 is maintained, why a six-month re-review was set, and whether F-35 parts transferred via the Netherlands to other partners must also be withheld from Israel. The government answered that the EU criteria were applied, that the detailed assessment is not shared beyond standard reporting because it contains sensitive information, that a re-review within six months was chosen given the evolving situation, and that the Supreme Court order does not cover onward transfers to other F-35 partners.
In addition, the re-assessment contains sensitive information that could be harmful to the Netherlands' bilateral relations.
Daarnaast omvat de herbeoordeling gevoelige informatie die schadelijk kan zijn voor bilaterale relaties van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de Nederlandse klimaatfinanciering aan ontwikkelingslanden

An MP asked whether Dutch climate finance to developing countries includes projects not primarily aimed at climate, how the climate share is set, how much is grants versus loans, and whether Dutch contributions are additional and comparatively low. The Secretary of State confirmed that broad programmes are counted using OECD Rio markers and estimates, reported 2024 totals of EUR 1.07 billion mostly grants, rejected the claim that the Netherlands lags other donors, and pointed to an online climate dashboard instead of a separate overview.
I am happy to refer you to the online climate dashboard.
Ik verwijs u graag naar het online klimaatdashboard.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Thijssen, Kröger, Kostić en Teunissen over de Joint Letter of Intent met Tata Steel, de fors hogere uitstoot van Tata Steel, staalslakken en de forse salarisverhogingen van direc

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA and the Partij voor de Dieren asked about Tata Steel's higher emissions in 2024, the Joint Letter of Intent with the state, executive pay rises amid job cuts, and steel slag use across the Netherlands. The government answered that the emission rise may reflect new measurements and reporting, that the permit procedure is still pending, that a steel slag taskforce and a reporting obligation are being set up, and that pay policy is for the company to decide, though the JLoI requires a reasonable pay policy to be specified later.
The cabinet understands that this article and its headline raise questions.
Het kabinet snapt dat dit artikel en deze kop vragen oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Van der Lee en Teunissen over de exportkredietverzekeringen voor een LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs Hirsch, Van der Lee and Teunissen asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about export credit insurance for the Mozambique LNG project, including resumed dredging by Van Oord, security risks in Cabo Delgado, monitoring of harms and whether the state's obligations are fulfilled. Minister Heinen answered that the state is bound by the issued policies under Dutch insurance law, that the dredging was Total's own decision, that the government sees no breach of environmental and social standards, and that Total has since dropped the Dutch-insured financing so no reassessment remains.

As previously set out in answers to parliamentary questions of 1 and 29 September 2025 and in my letter of 11 November 2025, it is correct that Van Oord, on behalf of Total and anticipating a project restart, carried out preparatory dredging works.

Zoals eerder uiteengezet in de beantwoording van Kamervragen op 1 en 29 september 2025 en in mijn brief van 11 november 2025 klopt het dat Van Oord in opdracht van Total, anticiperend op een herstart van het project, voorbereidende baggerwerkzaamheden heeft uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de situatie in Soedan

Teunissen (PvdD) asked whether the Netherlands, as a party to the Genocide Convention, must act to prevent genocide in Sudan, what preventive steps it takes, how it deals with UAE support to the RSF (arms export licences, trade deal, gold imports, sanctions), and whether it will implement parliamentary motions. The government answers that genocide requires a high evidentiary bar, describes diplomatic, humanitarian and EU-level efforts, states that arms licences to the UAE are assessed case by case with no diversion risk found, and says the EU trade negotiations continue under a mandate that considers compliance with international law, without committing to suspend them.
The cabinet assesses all licence applications for the export of military goods case by case and carefully under the EU Common Position on arms export control.
Het kabinet toetst alle vergunningaanvragen voor de uitvoer van militaire goederen per geval en zorgvuldig conform het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt inzake wapenexportcontrole
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over opgelegde dwangsommen voor het niet halen van klimaatdoelen uit het Klimaatfonds betalen

An MP asked whether Climate Fund money could be used to pay possible court-imposed penalties for missing 2030 climate targets, and questioned the government's legal analyses and its view of those targets as non-binding. The minister denied that such payments are lawful or intended, declined to publish an internal legal memo citing litigation interests, and said the 2030 target is a non-directly enforceable goal.
The cabinet has not made this note public because it contains information that could harm the State's litigation interests, then and now.
Het kabinet heeft deze notitie niet openbaar gemaakt, omdat die, toen en nu, informatie bevat die het procesbelang van de Staat kan schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over Bonaire en klimaatmaatregelen

Teunissen (PvdD) asks the ministers about the climate crisis on Bonaire, including protection measures, consultation with local bodies, Dutch emission targets, fossil subsidies and climate policy for the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom. The government answers that climate adaptation work is ongoing, including a Bonaire climate plan due in early 2026, the national adaptation strategy being revised, and various flood and ecological projects, while stating it will not prevent every flood but will prepare better.
The cabinet is working on climate policy for the Caribbean Netherlands, just as it is for the European Netherlands.
Het kabinet werkt – net als in Europees Nederland – aan klimaatbeleid voor Caribisch Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Koekkoek over de Israëlische aanval op de Global Sumud Flotilla

MPs Teunissen and Koekkoek asked the government about reported drone attacks on the Global Sumud Flotilla, the treatment of Dutch participants, and whether to condemn Israel, press for EU/UN action, or seek sanctions. The Foreign Minister says the government abhors violence against peaceful activists, cannot confirm Dutch citizens were aboard the attacked ships, has asked Israel for a legal justification and is awaiting it, and has pressed for safe passage and humanitarian access without committing to sanctions or a formal condemnation.
The cabinet rejects any form of violence against peaceful activists.
Het kabinet keurt elke vorm van geweld tegen vreedzame actievoerders af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de Global Sumud Flotilla

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government condemns the Israeli interception and attacks on the Global Sumud Flotilla in international waters, and whether it will pursue sanctions and raise the matter in the EU and UN. The minister replied that insufficient facts were known for a definitive judgment, that the ministry asked Israel to substantiate its legal basis, and that sanctions were not currently on the table.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has asked the Israeli authorities to substantiate the legal basis for Israel's actions.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft de Israëlische autoriteiten verzocht om een onderbouwing van de juridische basis voor het Israëlische handelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Dassen over “de gelekte brief waarin Tata Steel 685 miljoen euro moet betalen vanwege trage verduurzaming”

MPs Teunissen and Dassen asked about a leaked letter saying Tata Steel must pay 685 million euros for emissions rights due to slow decarbonisation, and whether subsidies undermine the ETS incentive, the company's risks and competitiveness, and the financial prudence of the support. The minister answered that the costs were foreseeable but affected by delayed Hoogoven 6 work, that the Dutch policy mix is intended, that the business case uses current 2025 forecasts validated by the state and the European Commission, that subsidies are tranched with clawback, and that the Chamber will be informed about maatwerk talks.
Because of commercial confidentiality, no statements can be made about specific figures or, in this case, provisions.
Vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan over specifieke cijfers of, in dit geval, voorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de ratificatie van het VN-oceaanverdrag (BBNJ-overeenkomst)

MP Teunissen asked whether the Netherlands' delayed ratification of the UN high seas (BBNJ) treaty undermines its credibility on ocean protection, and whether it will avoid supporting harmful activities meanwhile. The government answered that domestic implementing legislation is still being prepared, that ratification documents may reach parliament only in late 2026, and that it will attend the first COP while not facilitating harmful activities under international law.
Due to the time limits for the various phases of these procedures, the expectation is that the approval documents can be submitted to the House of Representatives at the earliest by the end of 2026.
Vanwege de termijnen die voor de verschillende fasen in deze procedures staan, is de verwachting dat de goedkeuringsstukken op zijn vroegst eind 2026 aan de Tweede Kamer aangeboden kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de laatste stand van zaken aangaande de Nederlandse inzet op de humanitaire crisis in Soedan

The MP Teunissen asked the government about steps taken on documentation of humanitarian law violations in Sudan, humanitarian access, peace process support and periodic reporting to parliament. The minister answered that Nederland supports the Fact Finding Mission's mandate, pushes for humanitarian access and EU diplomacy, and commits to inform parliament periodically, including a forthcoming letter on El Fasher.
On major developments regarding the humanitarian situation in Sudan and humanitarian aid and diplomatic efforts, the cabinet will inform the House.
Bij grote ontwikkelingen rondom de humanitaire situatie in Soedan en humanitaire hulp en diplomatieke inspanningen zal het kabinet uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Koekkoek over de beschietingen van humanitaire reddingsschepen door de Libische kustwacht

MPs Teunissen and Koekkoek asked the government about Libyan coast guard shootings at humanitarian rescue ships (Ocean Viking and Sea-Watch 5), Dutch involvement, EU funding of the Libyan coast guard, and Dutch steps on accountability, rules of engagement and NGO criminalisation. The minister answered that the government has no independent information, condemned the violence, urged Libyan authorities to investigate through the embassy and EU delegation, and said it would inform parliament on request.
The cabinet does not have independent information about this.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het mijnbouwbedrijf dat sneller wil beginnen met het mijnen in de Stille Oceaan

MP Teunissen asked the government about commercial deep-sea mining plans in the Clarion Clipperton Zone, the ecological risks, Dutch involvement (Allseas), sanctions for unlicensed mining, and critical metals supply. The government answered that the science is not yet sufficient, that Dutch involvement is not known beyond Allseas which it cannot comment on individually, that it opposes licences before a mining code exists, and that it has discussed the integrity of UNCLOS with Allseas without committing to specific sanctions.
Of course, the cabinet will, should developments give rise to it, consider possible steps to take, within the framework of the Authority.
Uiteraard zal het kabinet zich, wanneer de ontwikkelingen daar aanleiding toe geven, beraden op eventuele te nemen stappen, binnen de kaders van de Autoriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Ceder, Dassen, Van Baarle en Teunissen over dat Nederland moet meewerken aan overbrengen ambassadebewakers

Six MPs asked the ministers whether the Dutch state must help transport 42 Afghan embassy guards after a summary-judgment ruling that the state acted unlawfully by not evacuating them. The minister contests the ruling, says the guards were not state employees, has appealed on an urgent basis, and says the appeal court suspended enforcement pending its decision, so no further transport steps are being taken.
On 12 September the appeal court suspended the State's obligation to immediately implement the judgment until it has ruled on the appeal.
Het gerechtshof heeft op 12 september jl. de verplichting voor de Staat geschorst om per direct uitvoering te geven aan het vonnis totdat het hof in het hoger beroep over deze zaak heeft geoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over ‘de opslag van miljoenen door Israël afgeluisterde Palestijnse belgesprekken in Nederland’

An MP asked whether Dutch Microsoft datacenters store intercepted Palestinian phone calls from Israeli military intelligence, and what the government will do about it. The minister said he cannot confirm the storage, has no legal basis to investigate data held by third parties, sees no complicity, and refers to Microsoft's own inquiry and to EU and criminal law enforcement by the authorities.
Government investigation of data stored by third parties in a datacenter requires a legal basis. I do not have one.
Voor het van overheidswege onderzoeken van door derden opgeslagen data in een datacenter is een wettelijke grondslag nodig. Ik beschik daar niet over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Kröger en Teunissen over de verplichtingen van staten met betrekking tot klimaatverandering

MPs Hirsch, Kröger and Teunissen asked the government how the ICJ's July 2025 climate advisory opinion affects Dutch fossil fuel subsidies, corporate regulation, adaptation finance, loss and damage funding, and EU climate commitments. The government answered that the opinion does not create new obligations, that its fossil support and climate policies comply with international law, that it sees no need for a new analysis of fossil support, and that it will share a fuller legal reaction later.
The ICJ advisory opinion requires a careful legal analysis, which is currently taking place.
Het advies van het IGH vergt een zorgvuldige juridische analyse, die momenteel plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over Nieuwe fossiele boringen op de Noordzee en het sectorakkoord gaswinning

The MP Teunissen (PvdD) asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about new fossil drilling in the North Sea and the 2025 gas extraction sector agreement, including its compatibility with the Paris Agreement, the ICJ advisory opinion, legal risks, EBN's role and stranded-asset risk. The minister rejected the claim of incompatibility, argued that expanded North Sea production stays within the most progressive gas demand reduction scenario, defended EBN's public role and said the questions could not be answered within the requested timeframe.
No, no further analysis has been made of the legal aspects you mention.
Nee, er is geen verdere analyse gemaakt op de juridische aspecten die u benoemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Thijssen, Rooderkerk, Bamenga, Postma, Gabriëls, Wingelaar, Teunissen en Koekkoek over de MER Tata Steel en misleidende communicatie over uitstootcijfers

MPs asked the government about the Tata Steel HeraCless environmental impact report (MER), including rising fine particulate, NOx and dioxin levels, unclear emission reduction figures, EAF slag risks, CO2 reduction claims, the pending health impact assessment, job cuts and conditions for state subsidy. The state secretary largely deferred to the competent authority (Province of Noord-Holland) and the ongoing procedure, while stating that negotiations on the maatwerk agreement continue and that binding, enforceable terms and monitoring will be included.
The national government cannot yet take positions, because the competent authority still has to interpret and assess the MER.
Er zijn door de Rijksoverheid nog geen stellingen in te nemen, omdat het bevoegd gezag de MER nog moet interpreteren en beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het politieoptreden tijdens de Extinction Rebellion-demonstratie bij de A12 in Den Haag tijdens de NAVO top

Teunissen (PvdD) asks the Justice Minister about reported police use of batons and broken arms at an XR demonstration on the A12 during the NATO summit, and about proportionality, the right to peaceful protest, chilling effects and identity checks. The Minister defers to local authority and ongoing investigation, states that existing rules guarantee demonstration rights and sees no need for additional measures, and only commits to 'lessons learned' review via the triangle.
At present the incident on the A12 and the way the police acted are being investigated.
Op dit moment wordt het voorval op de A12 en de wijze waarop de politie heeft opgetreden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het volgen van Duitsland in een wapenexportboycot naar Israël

MP Teunissen asked whether the Netherlands will follow Germany in halting arms and dual-use exports to Israel that could be used in Gaza, and about the status of a motion on exports of attack dogs. The minister says the Netherlands already refuses such licences, has withdrawn three navy spare-parts licences, and refers to an earlier letter on the dog motion.
For the answer to these questions I therefore refer you to the relevant letter.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u dan ook naar desbetreffende brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het opzeggen van de Culturele Overeenkomst met Israël n.a.v. moord journalisten

MP Teunissen asked the government whether it would suspend the cultural agreement with Israel after the killing of journalists in Gaza, and whether it would press Israel on press freedom, war crimes, genocide prevention and the EU-Israel Association Agreement. The minister answered that the government is concerned about civilian and journalist deaths, urges both sides to respect international humanitarian law, and pursues pressure and dialogue, but declined to suspend the cultural agreement, leaving cultural cooperation decisions to institutions and pointing to EU measures already being pursued.
Severing cultural ties does not form part of that.
Het doorsnijden van culturele banden maakt daarvan geen deel uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Dobbe, Teunissen en Piri over het bericht 'Nederland schrapt marineleveringen aan Israël, 'risico op ongewenst eindgebruik’

MPs Dassen, Piri, Dobbe and Teunissen asked the Foreign Minister about the withdrawal of three export licences for naval parts to Israel and related licensing and reporting questions. The government answered that the licences were revoked because the transactions no longer passed EU arms-export review given the risk of use in Gaza, while providing lists of remaining and refused licences and acknowledging some reporting delays.
The government will provide the relevant licences with a short explanation of the revocation.
Het kabinet zal de betreffende vergunningen voorzien van een korte toelichting op de intrekking.
Antwoord op de leden Hirsch, Van der Lee en Teunissen over de stand van zaken omtrent een exportkredietverzekering (ekv) voor een LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs asked about the status of an independent review of security and human rights risks behind an export credit guarantee for the Mozambique LNG project, whether Van Oord resumed work under force majeure, and related questions on Rwandan troop payments, UK Export Finance, NGO involvement, UN investigation and corruption. The Minister says the external analysis is not yet complete and expected after summer, the Dutch decision on amending the financing policy is pending, the export policy remains in force for Van Oord's exporter policy, and the government will not commit to a UN-led investigation, referring to Mozambique's own prosecutor.
I expect to be able to share the final report with your House after the summer, except for any confidential elements.
Ik verwacht het definitieve rapport, behoudens eventuele vertrouwelijke elementen, na de zomer met uw Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over Israël dat verdere stappen neemt in etnische zuivering

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would condemn Israel's plans to confine and expel Gazans as ethnic cleansing, act on the ICJ genocide case, and support an international protection mechanism. The minister replied that such a plan would violate international humanitarian law, that the government uses pressure and dialogue with Israel, and that joining the ICJ case as a party is not possible, while giving no concrete new sanctions or commitments.
What urgent actions and sanctions will you take to pressure Israel to stop the expulsion, further ethnic cleansing and genocide, now that it is still possible?
Welke spoedacties en sancties gaat u ondernemen om Israël onder druk te zetten om de verdrijving, verdere etnische zuivering en genocide te stoppen, nu het nog kan?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Paternotte, Boswijk, Dassen, Dobbe en Teunissen over het artikel 'Europese Unie stelt in gelekt rapport zèlf oorlogsmisdaden in Gaza vast, toch blijft het stil over sancties tegen Is

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a leaked EU report on alleged war crimes in Gaza and the lack of sanctions against Israel. The minister answered that the report does not itself draw the conclusions, but the government considers bombing civilian objects and starvation as methods of warfare violations of humanitarian law, has initiated an evaluation of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the Association Agreement, and supports suspending the trade part of the agreement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht ‘EU-ministers nemen geen maatregelen tegen Israël, houden opties op tafel’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister what the Netherlands pushed for at the 15 July EU Foreign Affairs Council on Israel, whether it proposed sanctions, what concrete humanitarian aid commitments were agreed with Israel, and what action follows if Israel fails to comply. The minister answered that the Netherlands backed implementation of the EU-Israel humanitarian access deal, announced national measures (ambassador summoned, two ministers declared persona non grata, support for trade measures and a third sanctions package), and listed the agreed access commitments, though the answer on the source of the truck figures was vague and did not address military operations.
