As announced in the letter to the House of 28 July, the cabinet has decided to proceed to concrete measures.
Zoals aangekondigd in de Kamerbrief van 28 juli jl. heeft het kabinet besloten over te gaan tot concrete maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de economische belangen met Israël en het uitblijven van actie tegen genocide tegen de Palestijnse bevolking

Teunissen (PvdD) asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch and EU economic ties with Israel, whether these sustain alleged genocide, and why the government does not use its influence or impose trade and arms restrictions. The minister rejected the claim that Netherlands is the largest investor, said the government supports suspension of the trade part of the EU-Israel Association Agreement and discouragement of settlement activity, but declined to halt trade or impose a full arms embargo, citing existing EU frameworks and Israel's right to self-defence.
As explained in the letter to parliament of 28 July 2025, the cabinet is working at EU level for a suspension of the trade part of the EU-Israel Association Agreement.
Antwoord 11 Zoals aangeven in de Kamerbrief van 28 juli 2025, spant het kabinet zich in EU-verband in voor een opschorting van het handelsdeel van de Associatieovereenkomst tussen de EU en Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Teunissen over de detentie van mensenrechtenverdediger Inés Estela Pérez Arregoces

MPs asked why Colombian human rights defender Inés Estela Pérez Arregoces was held over 20 hours at Schiphol and then removed, and how this fits with protection of human rights defenders, interpreter and legal assistance rights, and privacy. The minister declined to discuss the individual case citing privacy, described the general Schengen Border Code framework and appeal options, and said he saw no reason for policy changes.
I cannot, also in connection with privacy considerations, go into the individual circumstances of this case.
Ik kan, ook in verband met privacyoverwegingen, niet ingaan op de individuele omstandigheden van dit geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Piri, Teunissen, Van Baarle, Paternotte en Dassen over het Nederlandse busbedrijf EBS en banden met de illegale bezetting van de Palestijnse Gebieden

MPs asked the government about Dutch bus operator EBS, owned by Israel's Egged Transportation, which the UN lists in connection with settlements, and whether Dutch public money paid through student travel products and provincial concessions amounts to assistance to the occupation. The government confirmed the facts, restated its discouragement policy on economic ties with settlement businesses, said it has no insight into the financial flows between EBS and Egged, and declined to take concrete steps beyond encouraging decentralised authorities to follow the policy.
The cabinet has no insight into the business relationship and financial flows between EBS and Egged Transportation Ltd. and therefore cannot make statements about them.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de zakelijke verhouding en financiële stromen tussen EBS en Egged Transportation Ltd. en kan hier dus geen uitspraken over doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het chilling effect van acties van de politie n.a.v. onder meer de bevindingen van de podcast 'RADIO BOOS' van 30 januari 20251 inzake aangiftes tegen de politie

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether citizens can really file complaints against police officers, given reports of a chilling effect, and asks about the independence of police investigation units, protest rights, and police home visits to demonstrators. The Minister answers that citizens can file complaints and criminal reports, that the internal VIK units and the Rijksrecherche investigate independently under prosecutorial authority, and that home visits are lawful when necessary and proportionate.
I see no reason to assume that the accessibility and independence of criminal complaint procedures against police officers need to be improved.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om aan te nemen dat de toegankelijkheid en onafhankelijkheid van aangifteprocedures tegen politiefunctionarissen moet worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Piri en Teunissen over het bericht dat het Internationaal Strafhof hard geraakt is door de sancties

MPs Dobbe, Piri and Teunissen asked the Foreign Minister whether the government's claimed effectiveness in supporting the International Criminal Court holds, given US sanctions reportedly crippling its work, and what concrete steps it has taken including EU blocking statute activation and asylum for affected staff. The minister answered that the Court continues most of its work, that Nederland is lobbying the US and EU partners and banks, but declined to detail confidential mitigation measures and deferred the EU anti-boycott decision to the Commission and Council.
To be successful, this work must take place in a confidential context, and therefore it cannot be discussed in much detail.
Om succesvol te kunnen zijn, is het noodzakelijk dat dit werk in een vertrouwelijke context plaatsvindt en daarom kan hier niet teveel over in detail worden getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Teunissen en Dassen over de uitzetting van Nederlandse deelnemers aan de Mars naar Gaza

MPs from SP, PvdD and Volt asked the Foreign Minister about the Egyptian expulsion of Dutch participants in the March to Gaza, including passport confiscation, legal grounds, Israeli involvement, detention of demonstrators and consular assistance. The minister said the expulsion is a sovereign Egyptian matter, consular help was given, privacy prevents confirming detentions, and the government urges Israel to allow humanitarian aid.
Because of the privacy of those involved, I cannot say whether Dutch demonstrators have been detained.
Vanwege de privacy van betrokkenen kan ik niet mededelen of er Nederlandse demonstranten zijn vastgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over genocide in Gaza

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government recognises growing calls that Israel is committing genocide in Gaza, what obligations the Genocide Convention imposes on the Netherlands, and what concrete steps it has taken since October 2023. The minister answered that the government is reluctant to qualify situations as genocide, affirmed the duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and listed diplomatic and export measures, while referring to earlier letters for detail and giving no full overview of the measures asked for.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Dassen, Piri, Paternotte, Dobbe, Teunissen en Van Baarle over het gehouden rondetafelgesprek over de situatie in Gaza en bijbehorende position papers

MPs from Volt, GroenLinks-PvdA, D66, SP, PvdD and DENK asked the Foreign Minister whether there is a serious risk of genocide in Gaza, when the Dutch state became aware of it, and what concrete steps the Netherlands has taken to prevent or end it under the Genocide Convention, including on arms exports, sanctions and an EU association agreement review. The minister answered that the Netherlands is cautious about qualifying situations as genocide, that the duty to prevent arises upon knowledge of a serious risk without a court ruling, and listed diplomatic steps taken such as the EU review of Israel's association agreement, sanctions on two ministers, and the arms export policy, while declining to join the South Africa case.
The Netherlands is generally cautious about qualifying situations as genocide.
Nederland is in de regel terughoudend met het kwalificeren van situaties als genocide.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht dat Israël burgers op het schip De Madleen associeert met terroristen en zegt alle nodige maatregelen te nemen tegen het schip en zijn passagiers

Teunissen (PvdD) asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's threat to intercept the Madleen aid ship bound for Gaza, the Dutch citizen aboard, and possible Dutch diplomatic and legal responses. Minister Veldkamp answered that consular assistance is being provided, the ship was intercepted and taken to Ashdod, and that the government urges land access for professional aid organisations, while declining detail on the individual case for privacy reasons and saying the interception needs investigation before judgement.
For reasons of the privacy of the person concerned, the cabinet cannot go further into the substance of the case at this time.
Vanwege de privacy van betrokkene kan het kabinet dit moment niet verder ingaan op de inhoud van de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de plannen voor nieuwe kerncentrales, kosteninschattingen en veiligheid Borssele

MP Teunissen (PvdD) asked the government about its plans for new nuclear plants, cost estimates versus other studies, and the safety implications of dropping the Borssele benchmark. The ministers defended nuclear power as a necessary part of a robust energy mix, acknowledged cost uncertainty pending TNO studies, and argued that dropping the benchmark does not reduce safety requirements, with no new MER needed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de investeringsplannen van staatsdeelneming Schiphol en het besluit om geen dividend uit te keren aan de Staat over het jaar 2024

Teunissen (PvdD) asked the Finance Minister about Schiphol's investment plans, whether shareholder approval was required, and the decision not to pay a dividend for 2024. The Minister said the investment thresholds are €200 million, that no shareholder approval has yet been given for the planned investments, that the dividend policy change was agreed unanimously with shareholders, and that a 30% payout applies for five years, with fiscal impact considered limited.
Schiphol's concrete investment plans are classified as commercially confidential information and therefore cannot be shared with your House.
De concrete investeringsplannen van Schiphol worden aangemerkt als bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kunnen daarom niet worden gedeeld met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Kostić over geweld tegen klimaatdemonstranten

MPs Teunissen and Kostić asked whether the government condemns a provincial councillor who drove into a peaceful Extinction Rebellion demonstrator and whether it will act against calls for violence against demonstrators. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, noting a police report had been filed and the OM is investigating, and said responsibility for demonstration safety lies with local government while any suggestion of violence against demonstrators is unacceptable.
It is not for me, as Minister of Justice and Security, to make statements about individual and ongoing cases.
Het is niet aan mij, als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, om uitspraken te doen over individuele en lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het versterken van meldpunt 144 tegen dierenmishandeling

An MP asked the government how it is strengthening animal-abuse reporting line 144 after its tasks were scaled back, including the €2 million budget, the 24/7 availability motion and the business case. The minister confirmed the police are drafting an implementation plan with options such as outsourcing the line, and promised to inform parliament before Prinsjesdag.
I aim to inform you further about this implementation plan before Prinsjesdag.
Ik streef ernaar om u vóór Prinsjesdag nader te informeren over dit uitvoeringsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de megaboete die Greenpeace moet betalen aan de eigenaar van een Amerikaanse oliepijpleiding

An MP asked the State Secretary about a large US court damages award against Greenpeace International, the risk of chilling effects on protest and free expression, and protections against SLAPP suits. The government declined to assess the individual case, noted the Dutch framework for recognising foreign judgments and the anti-SLAPP directive, and said it would not raise the matter diplomatically with the United States.
The government refrains from a substantive assessment of individual cases.
Het kabinet onthoudt zich van een inhoudelijke beoordeling van individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen, Paternotte, Dobbe en Van Baarle over het bericht 'No humanitarian aid will enter Gaza, Israel defence Minister says'

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether she condemns Israel's blocking of humanitarian aid to Gaza, whether this constitutes collective punishment or a war crime, whether UN Resolution 2417 is being ignored, whether Israel violates the ICJ provisional measures, and whether she will push for EU sanctions. The minister condemns the blockade as contrary to international law, notes the legal framework and Dutch diplomatic steps, and says a review of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the EU-Israel Association Agreement has been requested, while stating that sanctions require EU unanimity.
The cabinet condemns the blocking of humanitarian aid and basic services such as electricity.
Het kabinet veroordeelt het blokkeren van humanitaire hulp en basisvoorzieningen zoals elektriciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Paternotte, Boswijk, Dobbe, Dassen, Van Baarle en Teunissen over de catastrofale humanitaire situatie in Gaza

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza, including whether Israel is starving the population, the risk of famine, the proposal for US-linked security firms to distribute aid, and what the government is doing. The minister answered that Israel's blockade violates international humanitarian law, that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Israel to lift it and has asked the EU to review Israel's compliance with the Association Agreement, but that it cannot deliver aid by sea or air without Israeli consent.
Pending this, the Netherlands will not agree to extending the EU-Israel Action Plan.
In afwachting hiervan zal Nederland niet instemmen met verlenging van het EU-Israël Actieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Dassen en Teunissen over het telefoongesprek met Marco Rubio

MPs Piri, Dassen and Teunissen asked Minister Veldkamp about US policy toward Ukraine and Russia under Trump, including paused military and intelligence aid, Crimea, NATO membership, sanctions, security guarantees, minerals deal, UN votes and war crimes documentation. The minister answered each question, confirming several reported developments while stating the Netherlands' own positions and noting that many matters are for the United States to decide.
Whether or not to recognise Crimea as Russian territory is up to the United States itself.
Het al dan niet erkennen van de Krim als Russisch grondgebied is aan de Verenigde Staten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de betrokkenheid van multinationals bij omstreden fracking-operaties voor de productie van plastic verpakkingen

An MP asked the ministers about multinationals such as Unilever, Coca-Cola and Nestlé allegedly linked to fracking for plastic packaging feedstock in Texas, and about Dutch measures on fossil plastics, EU and global rules, transparency and a fracking ban. The government said it promotes recycled and bio-based plastic, points to EU packaging rules and the CSRD/CSDDD for transparency, maintains the ban on shale gas, and wants an ambitious global plastics treaty.
The cabinet is currently not considering additional national obligations.
Het kabinet overweegt op dit moment geen aanvullende nationale verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het artikel 'Local fossil fuel ad ban as a catalyst for global change' gepubliceerd in Nature Climate Change op 21 maart 2025

An MP (Teunissen, PvdD) asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a Nature Climate Change article arguing that a ban on fossil fuel advertising can catalyse climate action, and why such a ban was left out of the final Climate Plan 2025-2035 despite the government's earlier acknowledgement of its role. The Minister replies that a ban is not yet feasible without a workable, legally robust definition, that a standalone ban is insufficient so an 'aanpak duurzaam leven' will examine measures, and that the government does not recognise the claim that it misused the researchers' advice.
It is therefore premature to state, as the authors do, that a ban would come with relatively low costs and implementation requirements.
Het is dus prematuur om, zoals de auteurs doen, te stellen dat een verbod met relatief lage kosten en implementatie-eisen gepaard zal gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Hirsch over het EU-Mercosur-akkoord

MPs Teunissen and Hirsch asked the minister about the EU-Mercosur agreement's content and decision-making, including pesticides, deforestation, the rebalancing mechanism, labour rights and the Dutch appraisal. The minister replied that a full cabinet appraisal will come in spring 2025 after the final texts, and answered several technical points (EUDR scope, the EUR 1 billion fund, mixed-agreement procedure) while deferring most substantive questions to that appraisal.
The Chamber is expected to receive a cabinet appraisal of the EU-Mercosur agreement in the spring, based on the draft texts of the negotiated agreement of 6 December 2024.
Naar verwachting ontvangt uw Kamer in het voorjaar een kabinetsappreciatie van het EU-Mercosur akkoord op basis van de conceptteksten van het onderhandelaarsakkoord van 6 december 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de uitvoer van honden door defensie

An MP asked the Minister of Defence whether the ministry supplies service dogs to foreign armed forces, including Israel, and whether dog use by Israeli forces against civilians implies Dutch complicity. The minister answered that defence supplies no dogs to third parties, that retired dogs go under strict contracts to individuals with a VOG, and that there is no cooperation with Israel on dog training or activities.
Defence does not supply dogs to third parties.
Defensie levert geen honden aan derden.
Antwoord op vragen aan van het lid Teunissen over de uitvoer van honden door het ministerie van Defensie

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether Customs records exports of live animals, including dogs, by destination and exporter, and how many dogs were exported to Israel and whether the Ministry of Defence exported dogs since October 2023. The government answered that Customs holds export declarations but dogs fall under a general animal code, reported 4,435 dogs exported worldwide in 2024 (93 to Israel), found no Defence dog exports, and declined to give exporter or recipient details citing privacy rules.
Due to privacy regulations, Customs unfortunately cannot provide data concerning the exporter or recipient.
Vanwege privacy voorschriften kan de Douane u helaas geen gegevens verstrekken die zien op de exporteur of ontvanger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Kostić over “de onbetrouwbaarheid van de inschatting van saneringskosten voor de grond vanTata Steel”

MPs Teunissen and Kostić asked the government about the reliability of the estimated remediation costs of up to 12 billion euros for Tata Steel's land, including the assumptions, possible bankruptcy liability and the absence of a parent company guarantee. The minister answered that the underlying analysis is confidential, that remediation costs depend on future land use, that the polluter-pays principle applies, and that a maatwerkafspraak is being pursued to avoid a bankruptcy scenario.
No. Wijers and Blom, supported by BCG, conducted independent research.
Nee. Wijers en Blom hebben, ondersteund door BCG, onafhankelijk onderzoek gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Dassen, Boswijk, Paternotte, Teunissen en Ceder over de aanhouding van de burgemeester van Istanbul

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the detention of Istanbul mayor Imamoglu and about a hundred others appears politically motivated, whether it should have consequences, and whether the Netherlands will raise it with Turkey and push for EU measures. The minister supports the EU statement calling for transparency and rule of law, says he raised concerns by phone with his Turkish counterpart and via the ambassador, and notes the EU has postponed thematic consultations with Turkey while it considers whether further measures are appropriate.
It is crucial that the legal process against mayor İmamoğlu and others takes place with transparency.
Het is cruciaal dat het juridische proces tegen burgemeester İmamoğlu en anderen in transparantie plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Rooderkerk en Teunissen over extra klimaatmaatregelen naar aanleiding van de Klimaat- en Energieverkenning 2024

MPs asked whether extra climate measures are being drafted, whether any measures fall outside the IBO report, and whether ministry fiches and PBL/TNO reflections on the Meerjarenprogramma can be shared before the KEV debate. The Minister answers that the cabinet is still deciding alternative policy for the spring Voorjaarsnota, that it draws on many sources including the IBO and a pricing study, and that fiches and PBL/TNO reflections will be shared with the concept-Meerjarenprogramma.
The cabinet will share these fiches with the Chamber when it presents the draft Meerjarenprogramma.
Deze fiches zal het kabinet bij het aanbieden van het concept-Meerjarenprogramma met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over “de toenemende klimaatschade in Nederland”

Teunissen (PvdD) asked the minister about rising climate damage in the Netherlands, including sector-level damage estimates, regional risk, fair distribution of costs and how economic policy weighs climate damage. The minister answered that no sector-level overview of past damage exists, pointed to PBL and climate damage estimates, said a new adaptation strategy and a second Climate Plan are coming, and described existing tools for weighing well-being and climate costs.
No overview is available of the estimated climate damage over the past five years, broken down by sector.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van de geschatte klimaatschade over de afgelopen vijf jaar, uitgesplitst per sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk, Teunissen en Stultiens over het rapport 'Takers, not makers'

MPs Dijk, Teunissen and Stultiens asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about the Oxfam report 'Takers, not makers' on billionaire wealth, inheritance, wealth inequality, tax avoidance, global extraction and wealth taxes. The minister rejected the report's framing, arguing Dutch income inequality is low and stable and wealth inequality has fallen, while pointing to box 3 reform, existing tax measures and a planned review of anti-dividend-stripping options, without committing to higher taxes on wealth or inheritance.
This cabinet is not considering further raising the gift and inheritance tax rates for multi-million euro inheritances.
Dit kabinet overweegt niet de tarieven in schenk- en erfbelasting verder te verhogen voor miljoenenerfenissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Eerdmans over het nieuws dat Russische geheim agenten met vissersschepen naar Nederland kunnen reizen

MPs asked whether the NVWA can fully inspect Russian fish imports, impose fines or seize cargo, and whether the government will push for a ban on Russian whitefish, sanctions on Norebo, restrictions on Russian crews and measures against financing of Russia via Dutch ports. The minister answered that inspections are risk-based within EU benchmarks, that the NVWA lacks powers over catch quotas, that no fines were issued, and that the government favours exploring a whitefish import ban while leaving options open and withholding details of its negotiating position.
It is not in the interest of the Dutch negotiating position, nor of the surprise effect necessary for sanctions to be effective, to go into more detail on the Dutch negotiating position.

Het is niet in het belang van de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie en van de voor de effectiviteit van sancties noodzakelijke verrassingseffect om in meer detail op de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van den Burg, Teunissen, Ceder, Boswijk, Van der Lee en Kahraman over de acuut dreigende uitzetting van Oeigoeren in Thailand

Seven MPs asked the ministers about the imminent deportation of 48 Uyghurs held in Thailand to China and what the Netherlands was doing to prevent it. The Foreign Minister answered that the Netherlands has urged Thailand, bilaterally and within the EU, to respect non-refoulement and not deport the group, and is monitoring third-country resettlement options.
The Netherlands has made the urgent appeal to the Thai authorities, orally and in writing, both bilaterally and within the EU, not to extradite the 48 Uyghurs.

Nederland heeft op verschillende manieren, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk en zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband de dringende oproep aan de Thaise autoriteiten gedaan om de 48 Oeigoeren niet uit te leveren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de implementatie van REDIII ten aanzien van het onderdeel 'biomassaverbranding voor energie'

MP Teunissen asked the minister why the EU's REDIII is implemented purely without stricter national rules on biomass burning for energy, how cascading use and phase-out of wood combustion will be ensured, and related questions on subsidies, BECCS and carbon sinks. The minister answered that the government sees no need for stricter national criteria, that pure implementation was chosen to meet EU deadlines, and that cascading and subsidy phase-out measures are still being worked out, with further information to follow.
This means that the implementation does not include any rules beyond those strictly necessary for implementation.
Dit betekent dat bij de implementatie geen andere regels worden opgenomen dan voor de implementatie strikt noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Westerveld, Paulusma, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Teunissen over de gevolgen van de overwinning van Trump voor vrouwen wereldwijd

Six MPs asked the ministers how Trump's return and the expanded Mexico City Policy (Global Gag Rule) would affect women's health and abortion access worldwide, and what the Netherlands would do to fill any gap. The minister confirmed awareness of the policy and Project 2025 but declined to speculate on US changes, pointing instead to a forthcoming development policy letter and continued Dutch commitment to partners.
The cabinet is not anticipating that.
Het kabinet loopt daar niet op vooruit.
Beantwoording op vragen van de leden Kröger c.s. over het gaswinningsproject bij Ternaard

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, SP, PvdD and D66 asked why the government will not share TNO and Mijnraad advice, the official appraisal of those advice, the Wnb permit, and why not all relevant documents were published under Awb 3:11 and the Aarhus Convention, plus questions on Waddenzee World Heritage Outstanding Universal Value. The minister refused to publish the advice before the decision, citing negotiating position with NAM and protection of a careful decision-making process, offering only confidential inspection by the Kamer, and asserted procedures were correctly followed.
Once the decision-making is complete, the cabinet will of course make the advice public and inform the Kamer about it.
Zodra de besluitvorming is afgerond zal het kabinet de adviezen uiteraard openbaar maken en de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Teunissen over toenemende investeringen en leningen in sectoren die verantwoordelijk zijn voor tropische ontbossing

MPs Kostić and Teunissen asked the government about rising financing of sectors linked to tropical deforestation, whether Dutch financial institutions should be held to account, and how the EUDR and other instruments could regulate financial flows. The minister answered that financial institutions are expected to follow OECD and UN due diligence standards, that the EU will assess in December 2025 whether to bring financiers under the EUDR (which the cabinet considers unsuitable in its current form), and that supervisors already apply climate and nature risk expectations, while declining to commit to a binding ban on such investments.

The cabinet is of the view that the EUDR in its current form is not suitable for checking financial institutions and financial flows, because it is aimed at checking the production and supply chains of physical products and goods.

Het kabinet is van mening dat de EUDR in de huidige vorm niet geschikt is om financiële instellingen en geldstromen te controleren, omdat deze is gericht op het controleren van de productie en toeleveringsketens van fysieke producten en goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen, Teunissen en Rooderkerk over de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof over de rechtszaak tussen Milieudefensie en Shell

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, PvdD and D66 asked the minister how the Hague appeal court's ruling in the Milieudefensie v. Shell climate case affects climate targets, corporate duties, and whether new oil and gas fields should be restricted. The minister replied that the case is a private civil dispute, that corporate responsibility is addressed through EU CSDDD and existing climate policy, and that no new measures on new fossil licences will be taken.
This concerns a civil case between private parties. The government is not a party to this case.
Het betreft een civielrechtelijke zaak tussen private partijen. De overheid is geen partij in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Beckerman, Rooderkerk en Teunissen over gaswinning bij Ternaard

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, SP, D66 and PvdD asked whether the gas extraction permit at Ternaard was properly re-tested in light of SodM advice, Waddenacademie and UNESCO warnings, MER commission input and undisclosed advice, and whether all studies would be shared. The minister replied that the permit was granted in February 2024 under the Nature Protection Act, that the relevant advice gave no reason to revoke or amend it, that the Landsadvocaat advised UNESCO's position falls outside the legal test, and that the government would share some advice confidentially and publish others after final decision-making.

In line with my commitment in the debate of 11 December, I am willing to make the advice of TNO, SodM and Mijnraad available confidentially for inspection, so that committee members can read the content of this advice.

Conform mijn toezegging in het debat van 11 december, ben ik bereid de adviezen van TNO, SodM en Mijnraad vertrouwelijk ter inzage te leggen, zodat de commissieleden van de inhoud van deze adviezen kennis kunnen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over ‘De verduurzaming Rotterdamse haven en fossiele lock-in

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth how the Rotterdam port will phase out fossil activities, whether the planned measures and SDE++ subsidy rules avoid fossil lock-in from CCS, and what concrete steps will be taken. The Minister answers that NOVEX Rotterdamse haven is preparing a development perspective and investment agenda, that a letter on fossil phase-out follows in Q2 2025, and that CCS remains necessary while lock-in risks are limited, but gives few specific figures or firm commitments.
In addition, the House will receive a letter in Q2 2025 addressing the overall responsible phase-out of fossil energy carriers in the energy system.
Daarnaast ontvangt de Kamer in Q2 2025 een brief die in zal gaan op de algehele verantwoorde afbouw van fossiele energiedragers in het energiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Bamenga, Dobbe, Teunissen, Koekkoek en Van Baarle over de appreciatie van de Minister van het amendement Stoffer/Eerdmans

Six MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Aid whether her opposition to the Stoffer/Eerdmans amendment, which proposed cutting the Dutch UNRWA contribution from 19 million to zero or 9 million euro, still holds given the legal obligation to pay 19 million. The minister confirmed the amendment was revised to 15 million in 2025, and referred the substance of the appreciation questions to a letter of 6 December while declaring the timing questions no longer applicable.
On this matter your House has been informed by means of the letter of 6 December.
Hierover is uw Kamer geïnformeerd middels de Kamerbrief van 6 december jl.
Antwoord op vagen van het lid Teunissen over de oproep van Amnesty voor een verbod op gezichtsherkenning om mensen te identificeren tijdens demonstraties

Teunissen (PvdD) asked the Minister of Justice and Security how he assesses Amnesty International's findings on police use of facial recognition and biometric surveillance at protests, and what safeguards, transparency and independent oversight exist. The minister defers substantive answers to the upcoming police half-year report of December 2024, while pointing to existing police deployment frameworks and privacy-by-design and data protection impact assessment practices.
In the next police half-year report I will go into the recommendations of Amnesty International in more detail.
Ik ga in het eerstvolgende halfjaarbericht politie nader in op de aanbevelingen van Amnesty International.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Teunissen over het voornemen van dit kabinet om Tata Steel in de verduurzaming te ondersteunen en de benodigde investeringen daarvoor

MPs Kostić and Teunissen asked the minister why the state should subsidise Tata Steel IJmuiden's decarbonisation given the company's weak finances, low investment and limited emissions cuts before 2045. The minister answered that a maatwerk agreement is under negotiation to accelerate decarbonisation and health gains beyond legal requirements, that the terms are confidential, and that viability and subsidy amounts cannot yet be disclosed.
As indicated, I cannot publicly discuss the ongoing negotiations and any possible contribution from the state.
Zoals aangegeven kan ik niet in het openbaar ingaan op de lopende onderhandelingen en een eventuele bijdrage van de staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de investeringsclaim die ExxonMobil indient vanwege het dichtdraaien van de Groningse gaskraan

An MP asked the government about ExxonMobil's investment arbitration claim under the Energy Charter Treaty over the closure of the Groningen gas field, including damages, transparency, third-party participation and parliamentary information. The government answered that it cannot yet disclose the claim amount, will seek maximum transparency subject to agreement or a tribunal decision, will keep parliament informed at key procedural moments, and rejects the claim as unfounded and overbodig.
The cabinet will inform the House at important procedural moments, as has also happened in earlier investment arbitration procedures against the State.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer op belangrijke procesmomenten informeren, zoals ook in eerdere investeringsarbitrageprocedures tegen de Staat is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Kröger en Rooderkerk over de kosten van de bouw van twee kerncentrales die volgens experts aanzienlijk hoger uitpakken dan de kostenraming van het kabinet

MPs Teunissen, Kröger and Rooderkerk asked the minister why cost estimates for two new nuclear plants (potentially 35-40 billion euro according to Follow the Money) differ from the cabinet's figure, and about financing, risk allocation and cost comparisons. The minister replied that no construction cost estimate has been made, only a reservation for the state share, that a cost indication will follow in spring 2025 after third-party review, and that cost commitments and risk allocation will be settled only in contract negotiations, while largely deflecting comparisons and the sunk-cost question.
The cabinet has not estimated costs for the construction of the nuclear power plants, but has set aside money for the government contribution to financing the total costs.
Het kabinet heeft geen kosten geraamd voor de bouw van de kerncentrales, maar heeft geld gereserveerd voor de overheidsbijdrage in de financiering van de totale kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Bushoff, Kröger, Bamenga en Teunissen over een werkbezoek van Tweede Kamerleden aan Drenthe

MPs from SP, GroenLinks-PvdA, D66 and PvdD asked the government about damage handling for Groningen gas-extraction damage in Drenthe, including the vibration tool, expert independence, the presumption of causation, and the Norg gas storage and Schoonebeek projects. The government answered that improvements are underway, that the presumption of causation covers the Norg area, that the Raad van State ruling is under review, and that it will monitor implementation costs and review the Schoonebeek consultation process.
The cabinet considers it important to emphasise that the cabinet only consents if gas extraction can take place safely.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk om te benadrukken dat het Kabinet alleen instemt als de gaswinning veilig kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het klimaatrapport onderschreven door meer dan 15000 klimaatwetenschappers

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a 2024 scientific report on climate tipping points, the lack of progress despite decades of climate action, and whether Netherlands will tighten its climate targets and adopt more radical measures. The minister answered that the government will keep to existing climate targets aligned with Paris, pointed to international initiatives and EU-level steps, and said further attention to circularity would appear in the new climate plan.
The cabinet is sticking to implementing the existing climate targets.
Het kabinet houdt vast aan de uitvoering van de bestaande klimaatdoelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Teunissen over het EU-Mercosur-verdrag

MPs Ouwehand and Teunissen asked how the government gives effect to the 'don't import what we may not produce' commitment, the 2023 motion to block any EU-Mercosur deal including agriculture, and what Nederland is doing on the deal. The minister replied that the cabinet will only take a position once negotiations conclude and the deal goes to the Council, that it has repeatedly signalled sensitivity over agriculture, and that the Commission's current focus is deforestation and the Paris Agreement rather than reopening agricultural market access.

The cabinet will only determine a position on a possible EU-Mercosur agreement once the negotiations have concluded and all necessary documents are submitted by the European Commission to the Council for decision-making.

Het kabinet zal pas een positie bepalen over een mogelijk EU-Mercosur akkoord wanneer de onderhandelingen zijn afgerond en alle daartoe noodzakelijke stukken door de Europese Commissie ter besluitvorming aan de Raad worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Rooderkerk en Teunissen over het bericht 'Klimaatminister voorspelt dat haar eigen beleid niet voldoende is'

MPs Kröger, Rooderkerk and Teunissen asked the climate minister about a newspaper report that her own policy would not be sufficient to meet the 2030 climate target, and why this was not stated in parliament, and about the expected CO2 effects of several scrapped or retained measures. The minister confirmed the warning, said the impact of individual measures cannot be quantified separately, deferred the full assessment to the KEV projection and the Klimaatnota, and declined to name new measures before the spring decision-making.
The cabinet does not want to anticipate the political decision-making in spring 2025 on possible alternative climate measures.
Het kabinet wil niet op de politieke besluitvorming in het Voorjaar 2025 over mogelijke alternatieve klimaatmaatregelen vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de Nederlandse inzet op bij de Energieraad ter bepaling van de Europese inzet op de COP29

An MP asked the minister about Dutch positioning on climate goals, deforestation, gender and climate finance ahead of COP29 and the Energy Council, including whether Netherlands will pursue Oil Change International's financing options. The minister replied that the government follows the regular climate cycle, is committed to its 2030 goals and the deforestation pledge, but declined to pursue most of the listed financing options and deferred the deforestation-law question to a separate letter.

On the cabinet's position regarding the European Commission's proposal to postpone application of the Deforestation Regulation by twelve months, you will be informed by the State Secretary for LVVN and the Minister for BHO by Wednesday 16 October.

Over de kabinetspositie aangaande het voorstel van de Europese Commissie om de toepassing van de Ontbossingsverordening met twaalf maanden uit te stellen wordt u door de Staatssecretaris van LVVN en de Minister voor BHO voor woensdag 16 oktober geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over Nederlandse leveranciers van gevechtshonden aan het Israëlische leger

Teunissen (PvdD) asked the Minister whether Dutch firms supply attack dogs used by the Israeli military in Gaza, whether such exports are regulated and monitored, and whether they should be banned. The government answered that dogs are not controlled as strategic goods, it has no overview of dog exports and does not comment on individual firms, and a ban would require international agreement, as a 2016 study concluded.
Information on the export declarations of individual companies is commercially sensitive and therefore confidential.
Informatie over de exportaangiftes van individuele bedrijven is bedrijfsgevoelig en daarom vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Maatoug, Stultiens, Grinwis, Teunissen, Dijk, Van Baarle, Vijlbrief en Dassen over de kosten van het afschaffen van de belasting op de inkoop van eigen aandelen

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary of Finance about a SOMO study criticising the revenue estimate for abolishing the share buyback tax facility, including its data basis, behavioural assumptions and whether a new CPB estimate should be requested. The State Secretary answered that the estimate used the best available data at the time, explained the 70% behavioural discount, noted the cabinet has since kept the facility so no new study is needed, but will discuss updating the research with SOMO and SEO.
I will discuss this with both SOMO and SEO.
Ik zal hiervoor met zowel SOMO als SEO in gesprek treden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Teunissen over aanvullende sancties tegen de grootste Israëlische landinname op de Westelijke Jordaanoever sinds de Oslo-akkoorden en de erkenning van vijf illegale nederzettin

Opposition MPs Ouwehand and Teunissen asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands did not condemn Israel's largest land seizure on the West Bank since Oslo and the legalisation of five illegal settlements, and pressed on EU sanctions against violent settlers, the minister's stance, and the UN resolution 2334 on settlements. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the land seizure and legalisations as contrary to international law, raises concerns bilaterally, supports EU sanctions on settler violence, and rejects claims of a softer line while preferring non-public diplomacy.
The Netherlands condemns both this land confiscation and the legalisation of the five illegal outposts, including under Israeli law.
Nederland veroordeelt zowel deze landconfiscatie als de legalisatie van de vijf, ook onder Israëlisch recht, illegale buitenposten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Hirsch, Van der Lee en Koekkoek over de exportkredietverzekering voor het LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs Teunissen, Hirsch, Van der Lee and Koekkoek asked the ministers about the export credit insurance for Total's LNG project in Mozambique, including the re-assessment process, independence of security information, Total's role, the Palma attacks, and compliance with the Thijssen motion. Minister Heinen answered that the re-assessment is not finished, that all Proximities report recommendations were implemented, that the government will not postpone the decision as the motion asked, and that delayed Woo requests led to penalty payments.
As long as the assessment process is ongoing, I cannot make statements about its content in order to ensure a careful process.
Zolang het beoordelingsproces loopt, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de inhoud daarvan om zo een zorgvuldig proces te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over aandringen bij de Deense regering op het vrijlaten van walvissenredder Paul Watson

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would press Denmark to free whale activist Paul Watson, who faces possible extradition to Japan, and asked about Japan's whaling and the IWC. The minister answered that extradition is a matter for Danish authorities, that the Dutch embassy is monitoring the case, and that the Netherlands opposes whaling and will press for an EU resolution at the IWC.
It is up to the Danish authorities whether or not to act on this and to make statements about it.
Het is aan de Deense autoriteiten om hier al dan niet uitvoering aan te geven en om daar uitspraken over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Burg, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht “Rusland zet onafhankelijke krant The Moscow Times op zwarte lijst”

MPs from several parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Asylum and Migration about Russia placing the independent Moscow Times on a blacklist and the risks to Russian journalists working for it. The minister confirmed awareness of the report and said that emergency visas are possible in exceptional cases within existing policy frameworks, reaffirming support for press freedom.
This entails that within existing policy frameworks, and carefully tested against the Visa Code, visas can in exceptional cases be issued where there are compelling or humanitarian reasons.

Daar hoort bij dat binnen de bestaande beleidskaders, en daarbij zorgvuldig getoetst aan de Visumcode, het in uitzonderlijke gevallen mogelijk is visa te verstrekken als daar zwaarwegende of humanitaire redenen voor zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de brief 'Stand van zaken openstelling SDE++ 2024 en resultaten SDE++ 2023

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth why the SDE++ 2024 letter does not mention the scope RED-III gives member states to tighten biomass rules, why BECCS is presented as a route to negative emissions, and how the Netherlands will meet targets if that route fails, among other questions about biomass subsidies and ETS financing. The government answers that it chose pure implementation of RED-III without additional national rules, that negative emissions are needed and BECCS is one route supported by PBL and others, and that subsidies for biomass power plants will not be reopened in SDE++ 2025 while a biomass strategy is developed.
This was not taken into account in the decision-making, because pure implementation was chosen.
Dit is niet meegenomen in de besluitvorming, omdat is gekozen voor zuivere implementatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Piri en Teunissen over het opzeggen van het verdrag inzake clustermunitie door Litouwen

Three MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs whether he knew of Lithuania's withdrawal from the Convention on Cluster Munitions, whether he shared the coalition's concerns, and whether he would urge Lithuania to reverse its decision. The minister confirmed the withdrawal, said the Netherlands regrets it, and reported that the government has already raised concerns with Lithuania, which points to its security situation, while noting that the withdrawal takes effect after a six-month period following notification to the UN.
The cabinet has already had contact with Lithuanian authorities about the withdrawal from the convention.
Het kabinet heeft reeds contact gehad met Litouwse autoriteiten over het opzeggen van het verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´, Teunissen, Koekkoek, Thijssen, Gabriëls, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Zeedijk over de analyse van de toekomstplannen van Tata Steel door CE Delft

MPs from several parties asked the government to respond to a CE Delft analysis (commissioned by Greenpeace) comparing Tata Steel's transition plans with the Gezondheidsultimatum scenario on health, CO2, costs and feasibility. The government answered that the Gezondheidsultimatum is not feasible, that it will pursue a negotiated maatwerkafspraak based on Tata's plan with accelerated nuisance reduction, and that many details remain confidential due to ongoing negotiations.
The cabinet cannot make negotiated agreements on unfeasible plans and has chosen to pursue Tata Steel's plans with accelerated nuisance reduction.
Het kabinet kan geen maatwerkafspraken maken over onhaalbare plannen en heeft gekozen om in te zetten op de plannen van Tata Steel met versnelde overlastreductie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´ en Teunissen over dierlijk vet in biobrandstof

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about animal fat used in biofuel, its links to intensive livestock farming, palmoil deforestation and fraud in imported used cooking oil. The state secretary answered that the fat is a low-value waste product, that limits apply and that Dutch oversight by independent certifiers and the Netherlands Emissions Authority is robust, while promising to press the Commission on inspections in Asia.
The Netherlands has a robust system that oversees the supply chain of biofuels.
Nederland staat voor een robuust systeem dat toeziet op de toeleveringsketen van biobrandstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Teunissen inzake het toepassen van de Wet aanpak dierenmishandeling

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked whether the Animal Mistreatment Act's new powers (lifetime keeping bans, NVWA business closures, prosecutor conduct orders, RVO educational measures) are being used, how often, and about a suspected pig farm case in Twente. The government confirmed the powers exist, reported very few imposed measures, said the educational measure cannot yet be applied, and declined to comment on the individual farm inspection.
The NVWA does not make statements about its inspection findings at individual companies.
De NVWA doet geen uitspraken over haar inspectiebevindingen bij individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over ernstig dierenleed bij de training en inzet van politiehonden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Justice Minister about a police dog shot during an arrest, the mistreatment of dogs at a Schiedam training school, and whether police dog use should be phased out. The minister said the shooting is under internal investigation and not discussed in detail, that no central figures on dog injuries are kept, that the training school involved was a different association and an investigation is ongoing, and that phasing out police dogs is not on the table but animal welfare is being improved.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to make statements about individual cases, nor about the final results of internal police investigations into a specific incident.

Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om uitlatingen te doen over individuele gevallen en evenmin over uiteindelijke resultaten van intern politieonderzoek naar een concreet incident.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht ‘Nederland stuurt toch minister naar Hongarije’

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA, PvdD and Volt asked whether the government would send ministers to informal EU Council meetings in Hungary after PM Orbán's Moscow visit, and how this relates to EU sanctions and Hungary's presidency. Minister Veldkamp answered that the government condemned Orbán's visit, that Nederland does not undermine sanctions, and that after the Hoge Vertegenwoordiger moved the informal meetings to Brussels no ministerial delegation will go to Budapest.
The Netherlands is not undermining sanctions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Teunissen over het gebruik van dwangmiddelen bij begeleide terugkeer

MPs Koekkoek and Teunissen asked about the use of restraints (body cuffs, tie wraps) and force during forced returns, including a May 2024 Dublin transfer to Bulgaria, medical incidents, oversight and whether an independent inquiry is needed. The minister answered that restraints were justified by a prior risk assessment, that oversight by the Public Prosecution Service and the Inspectorate exists, and that no independent investigation is warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service supervises the use of restraint aids for removal and the use of force.
Het Openbaar Ministerie houdt toezicht op de inzet van hulpmiddelen ten behoeve van uitzetting en op het gebruik van geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht 'U.S. expected to sanction IDF unit for human rights violations in West Bank'

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister how she assesses the IDF Netzah Yehuda battalion, which the US planned to sanction over human rights abuses in the West Bank, and whether the Netherlands would follow suit. The minister called the reports very concerning, said Israel must prevent settler violence, and declined to follow the US measure, which she described as a Leahy Law restriction rather than a sanction, while pointing to EU settler sanctions the Netherlands supports.

Because the Netherlands only cooperates with Israel within the internationally recognised 1967 borders, the Netherlands has no relationship with the Netzah Yehuda battalion and there is no sanction in the sense of entry bans or asset freezes, the Netherlands does not follow the American example.

Omdat Nederland alleen met Israël binnen de internationaal erkende grenzen van 1967 samenwerkt, Nederland geen relatie met het Netzah Yehudabataljon heeft en er geen sprake is van een sanctie in de zin van inreisverboden of tegoedbevriezingen, volgt Nederland het Amerikaanse voorbeeld niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over financiering van de vee-industrie door de Rabobank

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Finance Minister about Rabobank's financing of intensive livestock farming, its links to JBS and the National Pork Producers Council, and the role of banks in the transition to animal-welfare-compliant farming. The minister acknowledges shared responsibility, expects banks to apply OECD and UNGP standards and to weigh such relationships in financing decisions, but leaves the concrete choices on the JBS relationship to Rabobank itself.
It is up to Rabobank itself to weigh maintaining a customer relationship with JBS in this light.
Het is aan Rabobank zelf om het onderhouden van een klantrelatie met JBS in dit licht te wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht dat de schade van weerextremen in 2023 in Europa 13,4 miljard euro bedroeg

An MP asked the Finance Minister about Copernicus/WMO estimates that weather-related damage in Europe in 2023 reached 13.4 billion euro, and whether funding for weather-extreme damage and climate adaptation is sufficient. The government agrees that investing in climate and nature is preferable to repairing damage, points to ad hoc, unbudgeted schemes (Wts, financial hardship policy for 2021 floods) under evaluation, and says additional climate policy is for the next cabinet.
Additional climate policy is currently a matter for the next cabinet.
Aanvullend klimaatbeleid is op dit moment aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Ouwehand, Teunissen en Tseggai over het bericht ' Yeşilgöz haalt uit naar Tim Hofman na X-bericht over ME'

MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether her social media post questioning journalist Tim Hofman about police treatment of ME (riot police) demonstrators harmed press freedom and journalist safety, and whether she would retract it. The minister answered that press freedom is a great good, that her post was a counter-question about possible police incidents and did not limit press freedom, and that any alleged improper police conduct is investigated.

I also indicated in my post that if there were questions about, or if there were improper conduct by the police, an investigation is always conducted and appropriate measures are taken where necessary.

Ik heb in mijn bericht ook aangegeven dat wanneer er vragen zouden zijn over, of sprake zou zijn van onjuist handelen van de politie, daar altijd onderzoek naar wordt gedaan en waar nodig passende maatregelen worden getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over “de verdubbeling van Europese subsidies voor vleesreclames”

An MP asked the government whether it accepts that EU subsidies for meat and dairy advertising, which doubled for 'eat more meat' campaigns, conflict with climate goals and the cabinet's protein-transition plans, and whether it will speak out against such subsidies in Europe. The minister answered that the cabinet favours abolishing EU promotion policy for regular agricultural products, supports the Wassenberg/Van Raan motion excluding meat promotion, and will speak out when the opportunity arises.
As long as the EU promotion policy exists, however, the cabinet is of the view that this policy must be fully aligned with other EU policy
Zolang het EU-Promotiebeleid echter bestaat, is het kabinet van mening dat dit beleid volledig in lijn moet zijn met ander EU-beleid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Veldkamp, Paternotte en Teunissen over de Tent of Nations in de buurt van Bethlehem

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the Tent of Nations peace farm near Bethlehem, including land registration delays, a road built on the family's land, restricted access, and whether the government will press Israeli authorities. The minister answered that the access restrictions and road works are illegal under international law and should stop, that the Dutch mission raises the matter regularly and will keep pressing, and that the case is typical of pressures on Palestinian farmers in Area C.
The Netherlands will continue to press on this.
Nederland zal hier op blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Kostic´ over het gebruik van onnodig geweld tegen vreedzame klimaatdemonstranten

MPs Teunissen and Kostić asked the Minister of Justice and Security about alleged excessive police force against peaceful climate protesters, including a broken elbow and alleged sexual touching, and about press freedom, UN criticism and the right to protest. The Minister declined to comment on individual cases, stated that force is a last resort governed by strict rules and oversight by the public prosecutor and courts, and announced an independent study into protests that push legal boundaries.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Teunissen over het artikel 'Nederland vormt belangrijke spil in illegale handel bedreigde diersoorten'

MPs Eerdmans and Teunissen asked the ministers how the government responds to a SPOTS/IUCN/Bears in Mind/ELI report that the Netherlands is a hub for illegal trade in endangered species used in traditional Chinese medicine, and what enforcement steps follow. The government answered that one suspect has been arrested by the NVWA investigation service, that enforcement is ongoing, that budgets and capacity are constrained but not quantified, and that it will pursue EU and international coordination while declining to give operational details of ongoing investigations.
In the interest of the investigation, the NVWA-IOD does not make statements about ongoing investigations.
In het belang van de opsporing doet de NVWA-IOD geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Teunissen over het rapport 'Death, Despair and Destitution: The Human Costs of the EU’s Migration Policies' van Artsen zonder Grenzen

MPs Koekkoek and Teunissen asked the government to react to a Médecins Sans Frontières report on the human costs of EU migration policy, including externalisation, violence at borders, Libya and Tunisia cooperation, Malta and Italy sea rescue, and legal routes. The State Secretary answered at length, mostly by restating EU and Dutch frameworks, citing monitoring mechanisms, and declining to commit to suspending cooperation or launching new investigations.
On this subject, questions were asked on 21 February by MP Piri (GroenLinks-PvdA). The cabinet refers to the answers to those questions for a comprehensive response on detention centres in Libya.

Over dit onderwerp zijn op 21 februari jl. vragen gesteld door het lid Piri (GroenLinks-PvdA). Graag verwijst het kabinet naar de beantwoording op deze vragen voor een uitgebreide reactie over detentiecentra in Libië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het steeds verder naar voren schuiven van de Nederlandse Overshoot Day

An MP asked why the Dutch Earth Overshoot Day has moved earlier each year, now to 1 April, and what the government will do to reduce the Dutch ecological footprint and curb consumption. The minister acknowledges the trend, attributes it partly to rising imports and biomaterial land use, and points to existing targets, the forthcoming biodiversity action plan, food and circular economy policies, and the upcoming Climate Plan.
Our society faces the task of substantially reducing that footprint.
Onze samenleving staat voor de opgave om die voetafdruk substantieel terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de rol van EBN in het stimuleren van nieuwe fossiele projecten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about EBN's role in promoting new fossil projects, including gas extraction in the North Sea, its consistency with climate advice, the lack of a phase-out plan, and the 2040 extraction horizon. The minister answers that gas will remain needed for some time, that domestic production is preferable to imports, that an extraction phase-out path is being monitored with a 2045 end date, and that a larger EBN role in exploration is only being explored, with a Mining Act change required.
In weighing extraction and imports against saving gas, the policy is therefore to maximise savings.
In de afweging tussen het winnen en importeren versus besparen van gas, wordt dus ingezet op een zo groot mogelijk aandeel besparen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Teunissen over exportkredietverzekeringen voor de baggersector

MPs Hirsch and Teunissen asked the government about export credit insurance for dredging projects in Brazil, Egypt, the Philippines, the Maldives, Mozambique and Indonesia, including harms to fishers and farmers, the Mozambique LNG reassessment, human rights risks, withdrawal of cover, compliance with a 2018 motion, and transparency of ESAPs. The government answered that it does not recognise the report's picture, that a reassessment of Mozambique LNG is underway with results to be communicated, that it will not withdraw the policies, and that OECD and ADSB transparency rules limit publication of contract documents.
The cabinet is not considering withdrawing the export credit insurance for these projects.
Het kabinet overweegt niet om de exportkredietverzekeringen in te trekken voor deze projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht dat Shell honderden miljoenen heeft verdiend aan het ETS-systeem

Teunissen (PvdD) asked whether Shell's large profits from surplus free EU ETS allowances, and the speculation in emission rights, undermine the polluter-pays principle and should be curbed. The minister agreed free allocation is undesirable in principle but defended ETS trading, rejected retroactive repricing of allowances and a statutory emissions duty, and pointed to the tightened Fit-for-55 rules.
I agree that it is undesirable for companies to earn money from an emissions trading system to the extent that this results from too many freely allocated emission allowances.
Ik ben het eens dat het onwenselijk is als bedrijven geld verdienen aan een emissiehandelssysteem voor zo ver dat het gevolg is van te veel gratis toegewezen emissierechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Teunissen en Beckerman over belastingontwijking door bedrijven zoals Chemours

Three MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance by Chemours, including whether its low corporate tax payments reflect transfer pricing and whether the Tax Authority supervises it. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual tax files under confidentiality rules, explained loss offset and arm's-length transfer pricing in general terms, and set out measures against tax avoidance and conduit companies.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de AWR kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het verstrekken van een toegangspas voor COP28 aan GasLog

An MP asks why GasLog, an LNG shipping company, received a COP28 access pass through the Dutch government, and questions whether LNG is compatible with the energy transition and whether passes should be withheld from fossil fuel companies. The minister explains the pass was tied to a liquid hydrogen project with Oman and Port of Amsterdam, acknowledges LNG is not clean but temporarily necessary, and says passes may go to companies that demonstrably contribute to the transition.
Companies that demonstrably contribute to this, for or on behalf of the Netherlands during a COP, may be eligible for an access pass through the Dutch government.
Bedrijven die daar voor of namens Nederland tijdens een COP aantoonbaar een bijdrage aan leveren kunnen in aanmerking komen voor een toegangspas via de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over exportkredietverzekeringen in veehouderij.

MP Teunissen asks why export credit insurance was granted since 2021 for poultry and intensive livestock projects despite the animal welfare policy excluding battery cages and high-density broiler houses, and questions the lack of welfare screening for several cases and the category M exception. The government answers that all projects were subjected to environmental and social assessment including animal welfare, that the state does not facilitate animal suffering, and that a study on a motion to halt insurance for lower-welfare projects is underway.
The cabinet is currently researching the scope and consequences of the adopted Teunissen et al. motion, and the results will be shared with the House.
Het kabinet doet momenteel onderzoek naar de reikwijdte en consequenties van de aangenomen motie Teunissen c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de antwoorden op eerdere schriftelijke vragen over fossiele subsidiesen de beprijzing van CO2-uitstoot

The MP asks the government to justify fossil fuel subsidies to major polluters, the choice of EUR 130/ton CO2 as a damage-cost reference versus German figures, and progress on phase-out paths. The minister defends the preventive-cost approach, lists recent carbon pricing measures, and says phase-out scenarios will be delivered around February 2024.
The cabinet has asked the independent chair of the Building Blocks report for a better and simpler tax system to develop the requested phase-out scenarios for fossil subsidies.

Het kabinet heeft aan de onafhankelijk voorzitter van het ambtelijk rapport Bouwstenen voor een beter en eenvoudiger belastingstelsel verzocht om de gevraagde afbouwscenario's voor «fossiele subsidies» uit te werken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over “het bericht dat het verbranden van hout niet is uitgesloten van de doelstelling voorhernieuwbare energie op de klimaattop in Dubai en dat Nederlandsekolencentrales een vergu

Teunissen (PvdD) asks whether wood burning counts toward the COP28 renewable energy tripling goal, whether the Netherlands should exclude it, and whether coal plants converting to wood pellet BECCS should get permits or subsidies. Minister Jetten answers that biomass counts toward the goal, that the government is critical of bioenergy and ends subsidies for electricity use, but that BECCS is a useful negative-emissions option whose permits lie with municipality and province and whose national incentive design is still being worked out.
Any permits that may be requested will have to be assessed and granted or refused by the competent authority concerned, which is not me but the municipality and province.
De eventueel aan te vragen vergunningen zullen door het desbetreffende bevoegd gezag moeten worden beoordeeld en al dan niet afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de veroordeling van Nobelprijswinnaar Muhammad Yunus in Bangladesh

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the conviction of Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus in Bangladesh, the concern of world leaders over threats to democracy, whether the upcoming elections will be fair, whether the cases amount to political retaliation, and whether the Netherlands has publicly spoken out. The minister answers that the Netherlands monitors the situation and raises it bilaterally and in the EU, but does not intervene in other countries' judicial processes and has not publicly condemned the conviction.
The Netherlands does not intervene in the judicial proceedings of other countries.
Nederland intervenieert niet in de rechtsgang van andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Teunissen, Alkaya, Dassen en Thijssen over fossiele subsidies

MPs asked the government about a report estimating fossil fuel subsidies at 37.5 billion euro per year, the reconciliation with the Miljoenennota annex, EU constraints, revenue use, and effects on competitiveness and the budget. The minister answered that the annex gives a range of 39.7 to 46.4 billion euro, that concrete tax measures were proposed in Belastingplan 2024, and that further proposals await a cabinet with full powers.
Given its caretaker status, the cabinet will not make further proposals for phasing out fossil fuel advantages.
Het kabinet zal, gezien zijn demissionaire status, geen verdere voorstellen doen voor afbouw van fossiele voordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk, Boswijk, Ceder, Belhaj, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Sylvana Simons, Dassen en Christine Teunissen over de evacuatie van lokale oud-medewerkers van de Nederlands

MPs from many parties asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the evacuation and resettlement of local former Afghan Security Guards and other local staff, including whether guards were excluded and why EUPOL staff were refused. The government answered that individual requests are assessed under the 2014 interpreter arrangement and special scheme, that criteria were not tightened, and that the resettlement project was folded into the ministries' standing organisations while the remaining group of about 100 people is still being pursued.
Defence aims to take current insights into account in implementing policy and will therefore examine these signals further.
Defensie streeft ernaar actuele inzichten te betrekken bij de uitvoering van beleid en zal deze signalen derhalve nader onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omtzigt, Piri, Boswijk, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Christine Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Eppink, Van der Lee, Ephraim, Van Haga, Baudet, Ceder, Dassen, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Simons

MPs asked the government whether it recognises the expert opinion of Luis Moreno Ocampo that the Lachin blockade amounts to ongoing genocide against Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to prevent genocide and enforce the ICJ interim measures. The minister answers that the Netherlands is very concerned, follows the situation via EUMA and other sources, describes its duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and states that the EU and the Netherlands continue to call on Azerbaijan to comply with the ICJ order.
The Netherlands and the EU will continue to call on Azerbaijan to do so.
Nederland en de EU blijven Azerbeidzjan hiertoe oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Van Baarle, Eerdmans en Omtzigt over de voordracht van Wopke Hoekstra als Eurocommissaris

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister how Wopke Hoekstra was nominated as Dutch European Commissioner, including the procedure, any candidate profile, whether parliament was informed, and whether his departure leaves the Foreign Ministry without political direction. The government replied that the nomination followed the standard Article 246 TFEU procedure after consultation within cabinet and with the Commission President, that no candidate profile was drawn up, that parliament was not informed beyond the standard procedure, and that ministerial responsibility for the Foreign Ministry is secured.
No. The procedure was followed in line with standing policy on earlier appointments, see the answers to questions 1 and 2.
Nee. De procedure is conform staand beleid van eerdere benoemingen gevolgd, zie de antwoorden op vraag 1 en 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Christine Teunissen over de Nederlandse bilaterale investeringsakkoorden

MP Teunissen asked the minister, citing a SOMO/TNI/Both ENDS report, whether the Netherlands will end or renegotiate its roughly 75 bilateral investment treaties, particularly given risks to public-interest regulation and the energy transition, and about withdrawal from the Energy Charter Treaty. The minister rejects terminating the treaties, describes a renegotiation track (Ghana, Nigeria) based on the 2019 model text, and states the ECT withdrawal is pending with expected end in late 2024 while denying that treaties hinder climate policy.
The cabinet is committed to reforming the investment protection system.
Het kabinet zet in op hervorming van het investeringsbeschermingssysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Wassenberg over ‘de grootschalige verzameling van data over demonstranten door de politie’

MPs Teunissen and Wassenberg asked whether police mass-query personal data of demonstrators in the BRP population register, and whether this is proportionate and lawful. The minister answers that such queries are used for risk assessment and only when necessary and proportionate under the Wet politiegegevens, that internal training exists, and that no supervisory referral to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is planned.

Under article 3.2 of the Wet basisregistratie personen, the police have been issued an authorisation decision allowing them to obtain data from the BRP for performing their duties under article 3 of the Police Act 2012.

Op grond van artikel 3.2 Wet basisregistratie personen is aan de politie een autorisatiebesluit afgegeven waarin wordt bepaald dat de politie voor de uitvoering van artikel 3 Politiewet 2012 gegevens uit de BRP mag verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over de verlengde VN-sessie over het wereldzeeënverdrag

Two PvdD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Nature and Nitrogen about the extended UN session on the high seas biodiversity treaty (BBNJ), including whether RFMOs and fisheries interests would be bound and whether EIAs apply to RFMO-regulated vessels. The minister confirmed agreement on the treaty text on 4 March 2023, explained that the treaty coordinates with existing bodies without undermining them, and apologised for missing the requested answer deadline.
Unfortunately it was not possible to answer the questions within the set deadline.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de vragen binnen de gestelde termijn te beantwoorden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Mutluer, Teunissen, Sylvana Simons en Ellemeet over het bericht 'politie keek heimelijk mee in chatgroepen van Extinction Rebellion'

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether police secretly monitored Extinction Rebellion chat groups, under which legal powers, and how this relates to the right to demonstrate. The Minister declined to comment on the specific case pending a court ruling, described general police information-gathering powers, and said the proportionality assessment lies with the police and the mayor.
I cannot address this specific question because the court is still considering the case concerning the suspicion of incitement.
Op deze concrete vraag kan ik niet ingaan omdat de rechter zich nog buigt over de zaak betreffende de verdenking wegens opruiing.
Antwoord op vragen va de leden Jasper van Dijk en Teunissen over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie parlementen buitenspel wil zetten inzake het Mercosur verdrag

MPs Van Dijk and Teunissen asked whether the European Commission plans to split the EU-Mercosur agreement to bypass national parliaments and whether the government will insist national parliaments have the final say on full trade agreements. The minister rejects the premise: under the Lisbon Treaty the Council must approve signature and conclusion, usually with European Parliament consent, and the Commission has not yet decided the form of the agreement, with no decision expected before 2024; the government will take a position only once the full documents are submitted and will push in the EU for an integral association agreement.

As with any treaty, the cabinet will only determine a position on a possible agreement between the European Union and the Mercosur countries once all necessary documents are submitted by the Commission to the Council for decision-making.

Zoals bij ieder verdrag, zal het kabinet pas een positie bepalen ten aanzien van een mogelijk akkoord tussen de Europese Unie en de Mercosurlanden op het moment dat alle daartoe noodzakelijke stukken door de Commissie ter besluitvorming aan de Raad worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Vestering over het feit dat diepzeemijnbouw onnodig blijkt te zijn

MPs Teunissen and Vestering (Partij voor de Dieren) asked whether deep-sea mining is unnecessary given circular economy options, whether the Netherlands has an official position, and how the precautionary principle applies before the ISA Council meeting. The government answers that it has not yet formed a definitive position, will inform parliament before summer 2023, is conducting an exploratory study on deep-sea mining's contribution to critical raw material supply, and that exploitation should only proceed strictly within the ecosystem's carrying capacity.

The cabinet is still deliberating on a further substantive position on deep-sea mining and expects to inform the House shortly, and no later than before summer given the July meeting of the Authority's Council.
