Het kabinet beraadt zich momenteel nog op een nader inhoudelijk standpunt over diepzeemijnbouw en verwacht Uw Kamer hier op korte termijn, en uiterlijk voor de zomer gelet op de juli bijeenkomst van de Raad van de Autoriteit, over te informeren.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over de explosieve uitkomsten van het onderzoek van het Amerikaanse House Committee on Oversight and Reform naar de klimaatontwrichtende investeringsplannen van de li

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the ministers whether they know of, and how they will respond to, US House Oversight Committee findings that major fossil fuel firms plan to keep investing in oil and gas and engage in greenwashing, and whether the government will hold these companies to account, demand Paris-aligned investment plans, or investigate similar conduct in the Netherlands. The ministers answered that the government expects firms to meet Paris goals through binding bilateral agreements and carbon pricing, cannot dictate strategies to international companies, will not summon them or investigate Dutch conduct, and will not make Paris alignment a condition for subsidies.
I will not summon these companies following the American investigation.
Ik zal deze bedrijven naar aanleiding van het Amerikaanse onderzoek niet op het matje roepen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Marijnissen Grinwis, Palland, Kathmann, Teunissen, Pouw-Verweij, Stoffer, Van der Plas, Van Haga en Den Haan over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder h

MPs asked the government how couples on social assistance and single-earner households with disability benefits can end up with less net income plus allowances than a benefit couple, and what will be done after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the undesirable outcome and roughly 10,000 affected households, but offered no finished fix, only options under study and no compensation decision yet.
We want to do everything we can to find a solution to this.
We willen er alles aan doen om hier een oplossing voor te vinden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Staaij, Ceder, Piri, Van der Lee, Koekkoek, Teunissen, Eppink en Van der Plas over de uitspraak van het Internationaal

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands will ensure Azerbaijan complies with the ICJ provisional measures order to reopen the Lachin corridor, and whether it has raised this with Azerbaijan. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Azerbaijan to comply through bilateral talks, the ambassador, and EU and multilateral channels, but gives no new concrete commitment beyond continued advocacy.
Following this ruling, the Netherlands called on the Azerbaijani authorities to comply with the ruling.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak de Azerbeidzjaanse autoriteiten opgeroepen om de uitspraak na te leven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Kröger, Van Esch en Teunissen over het bericht ‘Vervuilende Kooksfabriek 2 van Tata Steel blijkt verkeerd gebouwd: rookt en lekt vanaf eerste dag 'aan alle kanten'’

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdD asked the government about reports that Tata Steel's Coke Plant 2 was built with defects and emits pollutants, and about enforcement, permit revision, closure and related subsidies. The State Secretary answered that the competent authority (province and Omgevingsdienst NZKG) is investigating defects, has issued a third penalty payment order, and is examining permit withdrawal, while closure would be discussed in the maatwerk negotiations; several questions were referred to other bodies or withheld for tax confidentiality.
The OD NZKG asked EenVandaag and the reporters for further information; the information provided in the broadcast is insufficient to establish whether there are actually construction defects.

De OD NZKG heeft EénVandaag en de melders verzocht om nadere informatie; de in de uitzending aangereikte informatie is onvoldoende om vast te kunnen stellen of er daadwerkelijk sprake is van constructiefouten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Wassenberg over het demonstratierecht

Two MPs from the Animal Party asked about the mass arrests of 768 Extinction Rebellion protesters in The Hague on 28 January, use of force, detention of journalists, pre-emptive arrests for incitement, and unequal treatment compared with farmer protests. The Minister answered that the mayor and police acted to end an unlawful motorway blockade, that the protest right is a fundamental right but does not justify crimes, that pre-emptive arrests were for incitement and courts upheld some restrictions, and that the government will send a letter on the protest right before summer.
Sometimes it is unavoidable for the police to use force in carrying out their duties. The police only do so when it is absolutely necessary.
Het is voor de politie soms onvermijdelijk om bij het uitvoeren van haar taak geweld te gebruiken. Dit doet de politie alleen als het absoluut noodzakelijk is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van der Lee, Ceder, Teunissen, Piri, Kuzu en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de overdracht van Singh aan Nederland gebaseerd is op politieke onwil

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Foreign Ministers whether the government has done enough to bring detained Dutch national Jaitsen Singh from the United States to the Netherlands, and why a transfer (WOTS procedure) was not pursued after a parole denial. The government answers that a WOTS transfer does not meet the policy criteria because of insufficient ties to the Netherlands, that a pardon route on humanitarian grounds remains open, and that the family's willingness to take him in does not change the assessment.
The cabinet continues to make efforts to bring Mr Singh to the Netherlands on humanitarian grounds because of his advanced age and fragile health, provided he poses no danger to society.
Het kabinet blijft zich inspannen om de heer Singh op humanitaire gronden vanwege zijn hoge leeftijd en fragiele gezondheid naar Nederland te brengen, mits hij geen gevaar voor de samenleving vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Westerveld en Kwint over Wob documenten aangaande de aanschaf van De vaandeldrager en de informatiepositie van de Staten-Generaal

MPs Teunissen, Westerveld and Kwint asked why the 2018 Call Option Agreement for De Vaandeldrager, the expired 165 million euro option, was not shared with parliament, why parts of documents were redacted, and whether parliament was fully informed before approving the purchase. The State Secretary answered that the option had already expired, the agreement was confidential and not a state contract, the redactions protected the state's negotiating position, and parliament was informed as fully as possible.
Therefore the Sale and Purchase Agreement will be placed confidentially for inspection shortly so committee members can still take note of it.
Daarom zal de Sale and Purchase Agreement op korte termijn vertrouwelijk ter inzage worden gelegd zodat de commissieleden hier alsnog kennis van kunnen nemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Akerboom over de Catshuissessie met het bedrijfsleven over de IMVO-wet en het vestigingsklimaat

Two MPs asked whether the Prime Minister's Catshuis session with business on the investment climate would target the IMVO due diligence law, which companies attend, and whether sustainable firms and OECD guidelines would be on the agenda. The minister answered that the session is broader than IMVO, covers the investment climate and geopolitics, lists the attending companies, and that a level playing field with neighbouring countries, including OECD guidelines, is important.
This Catshuis session is not specifically about (I)MVO, but broadly about the investment climate.
Deze Catshuissessie gaat niet specifiek over (I)MVO, maar breed over het vestigingsklimaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Van Raan en Sylvana Simons over het bericht ‘Nederland doet te weinig om Bonaire te beschermen tegen bedreiging klimaatverandering’

MPs Teunissen, Van Raan and Simons asked whether the government will do enough to protect Bonaire, Saba and Sint Eustatius from climate change, citing a VU report, and questioned the lack of adaptation strategies, water safety standards and Rijk funding for the islands. The State Secretary replied that climate scenarios for the Caribbean Netherlands are being developed by KNMI with results expected end 2023, that the public bodies bear primary responsibility for adaptation with Rijk support in knowledge and tools, and that no specific Rijk adaptation programme or new funding is planned.
On the basis of the outcomes of these studies it will be determined in which area further research is needed.
Op basis van de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken zal bepaald worden op welk vlak vervolgonderzoek nodig is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Teunissen over het feit dat de mondiale biodiversiteitsdoelen alleen te behalen zijn door het hervormen van voedsel- en energiesystemen en een sterke beleidsinzet op natuurhers

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked ministers how the government will act on PBL findings that global biodiversity targets require transforming food and energy systems and stronger nature and climate policy, including on protein transition, financial-sector investment and COP negotiations. The minister acknowledges the urgency, points to the coalition agreement, national protein strategy, a forthcoming subsidy review and an inter-departmental biodiversity study, but largely restates existing policy and defers concrete steps to later.
The cabinet acknowledges that there is no time to lose and that a joint approach is required to tackle the climate and biodiversity crisis.
Het kabinet erkent dat er geen tijd te verliezen is en dat een gezamenlijke aanpak vereist is om de klimaat- en biodiversiteitscrisis aan te pakken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Van der Plas en Jasper van Dijk over het plan van de Europese Commissie om het Mercosur-verdrag geïmplementeerd te krijgen door nationale parlementen te omzeilen

MPs Teunissen, Van der Plas and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the Commission is splitting the EU-Mercosur agreement to avoid national parliamentary ratification and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that talks with Mercosur continue without new developments, that the form of any agreement is not yet decided, and that national democratic procedures will apply once a proposal reaches the Council.

As the cabinet has repeatedly indicated, it will only take a position on the agreement with the Mercosur countries once the Commission has submitted the necessary decision-making documents to the Council.

Zoals herhaaldelijk door het kabinet aangegeven zal het kabinet pas een standpunt innemen over het akkoord met de Mercosur-landen wanneer de Commissie de benodigde documenten voor besluitvorming aan de Raad heeft aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het EU-handelsverdrag met Nieuw-Zeeland

Teunissen (PvdD) asks the government about the EU-New Zealand trade agreement: its sustainability claims, transport emissions, lobbying by Zespri, sector impacts on dairy, beef and sheep, food safety, enforcement of labour and Paris commitments, fossil fuel subsidy reform and gender provisions. The minister answers largely by describing the negotiated text and impact studies, stating the cabinet will form a final view when the Council decides, and committing to updated cumulative agricultural impact studies and a more detailed fossil subsidy policy letter before COP27.
It is up to the New Zealand government to provide information about the organisations it contacted during the negotiation of the trade agreement.
Het is aan de overheid van Nieuw-Zeeland om informatie te verstrekken over de organisaties waarmee door deze overheid contact is geweest tijdens de onderhandeling van het handelsakkoord.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Kuzu, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Brekelmans, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons en Piri over het bericht dat waarnemers van de Organisatie voor Veiligheid en Samenwerkin

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about two Ukrainian OSCE staff members sentenced to over ten years by courts in the unrecognised Luhansk region, asking about their detention conditions, pressure on Russia, evacuation of local staff, and whether Turkey could help secure their release. The minister confirmed the sentences, said detention location is unknown, listed joint EU and OSCE calls for release, and said the OSCE Secretary General is working on their release.
At this time it is not known where the detainees are being held.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend waar de gevangenen worden vastgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de impact van Nederlandse import op natuurverlies wereldwijd

An MP asked the government about the worldwide nature loss caused by Dutch imports of commodities such as soy, palm oil, cocoa, timber and beef, and what the government will do about it, including the EU deforestation regulation. The minister acknowledged the high land footprint, pointed to EU regulation and national targets such as halving the footprint by 2050, and promised to set out concrete steps in the NBSAP in 2023 while declining to answer one question in full.
As previously announced, I am therefore willing to make clear which steps are needed to reduce the Dutch footprint and how the cabinet intends to address this.

Zoals eerder aangekondigd (Kamerstuk 2022Z06909 ) ben ik dan ook bereid om inzichtelijk te maken welke stappen nodig zijn om de Nederlandse voetafdruk te verkleinen en hoe het kabinet dit wil aanpakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over investeringsplannen van de fossiele industrie

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the government about fossil fuel companies' investment plans (the 'carbon bombs' reported by The Guardian) and whether the government would act internationally to stop them, given the Paris Agreement. The minister acknowledges the climate risks, says the plans are incompatible with Paris if the figures hold, and lists existing policy and coalitions, but declines to provide an overview of Dutch-linked investment plans and does not join the Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance.
That data is not public and the cabinet therefore does not keep track of it.
Die data zijn niet openbaar en houdt het kabinet dus ook niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over de VN-conferentie over het wereldzeeënverdrag

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked how the Netherlands is pushing, at the UN conference on the high seas treaty (BBNJ), for ambitious and effective marine protection, including binding area-based measures, mandatory environmental impact assessments and a scientific body. The minister replied that the EU and member states negotiate with one voice, that no agreement was reached on the full package in August 2022, and that the Netherlands supports binding area protection, mandatory EIAs with a two-tiered threshold approach, and access and benefit sharing for marine genetic resources.
The Netherlands, together with the EU and the other member states, will again actively work toward finalising an effective and future-proof treaty at the next UN conference.
Nederland, gezamenlijk met de EU en de andere lidstaten, zal zich tijdens de volgende VN-conferentie wederom actief inzetten voor de afronding van een effectief en toekomstbestendig verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Vestering en Teunissen over investeringen in de intensieve veehouderij door ABP

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether ABP's investments in intensive livestock farming conflict with animal welfare, climate and Paris goals, and what the government can do to steer the pension fund. The government replied that the ABP board is independently responsible for investment policy, that the government has no formal control over it, and pointed to existing voluntary IMVB and climate commitments with review later.
The cabinet, as one of the sector employers involved with ABP, has no formal means to steer the implementation of the pension scheme.
Het kabinet heeft, als één van de sectorwerkgevers betrokken bij het ABP, geen formele mogelijkheden ter sturing op de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het rapport 'What is a fair emissions budget for The Netherlands'

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the government to respond to an NCI report arguing that the Netherlands' fair share of the carbon budget requires near-zero emissions by 2030, and whether current climate targets are consistent with the Paris Agreement. The minister rejected the report's conclusions and methodology, maintained that the national targets are in line with the 1.5°C goal and the Paris Agreement, and committed to aligning public export credit support with the COP26 declaration without giving a firm new date.

No. According to the cabinet, the tightened Dutch climate targets for 2030 (at least 55% and aiming for 60% reduction) and 2050 (climate neutral, i.e. net-zero greenhouse gas emissions) are, based on the IPCC, in line with the 1.5-degree goal of the Paris Agreement.

Nee. Volgens het kabinet zijn de aangescherpte Nederlandse klimaatdoelen voor 2030 (ten minste 55% en streven naar 60%-reductie) en 2050 (klimaatneutraal oftewel netto-nul-broeikasemissies) op basis van het IPCC in lijn met het 1,5 gradendoel van het Akkoord van Parijs.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over oliewinning in het Virunga Nationaalpark in de Democratische Republiek Congo en de dreiging daarvan voor het voortbestaan van berggorilla’s

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked whether oil extraction in Virunga National Park threatens the mountain gorillas, whether EU/CAFI funding to Congo should be conditioned or frozen, and what Dutch companies and the state did regarding oil exploration there. The minister acknowledges the risks to the park and gorillas, says oil licences have not yet been issued and CAFI donors will press Congo, but declines to freeze Dutch funds, says the state had no role in the exploration study, and lists existing gorilla protection support.
Ik houd de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over ecocide door Russische militaire agressie in Oekraïne

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked the Foreign Minister about ecocide and environmental damage from Russia's aggression in Ukraine, including whether the ICC investigation covers the Rome Statute's environmental clause and whether Nederland will support evidence gathering. The minister answered that the government respects ICC independence, offers forensic support on request, and maintains its earlier position against a standalone ecocide crime, while saying it has no information on the reported number of environmental complaints.
The Dutch government respects the independence of the International Criminal Court and therefore does not interfere substantively with criminal investigations by the ICC Prosecutor.

De Nederlandse regering respecteert de onafhankelijkheid van het Internationaal Strafhof en bemoeit zich derhalve niet inhoudelijk met strafrechtelijke onderzoeken van de Aanklager van het Internationaal Strafhof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the minister why no companies are named under the gas protection plan, how much gas the 60 largest consumers and the flower sector use, whether a gas-saving tender was discussed, and why the plan's shutdown step is not applied and CO2 emissions rise. The minister answered that no specific companies are named, consumption data is confidential or outdated, a gas-saving tender is being studied, shutdown is only possible in an emergency, and a productie restriction was withdrawn to protect gas supply, with supplementary measures promised by Prinsjesdag.
Due to the commercially confidential nature of information on gas consumption, I cannot make any statement about individual connections to the gas network.
Vanwege het bedrijfsvertrouwelijke karakter van informatie omtrent gasverbruik kan ik geen uitspraak doen over individuele aansluitingen op het gasnet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over “de door Nederland uitgesproken steun aan diepzeemijnbouw”

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked about Dutch support for deep-sea mining, scientific uncertainty about deep-sea ecosystems, how the Dutch position was formed and who was involved, and the timeline for ISA decisions. The government answered that Dutch aims are environmentally strict conditions and a precautionary approach before exploitation, that the final position will be sent to parliament in Q3 2022, and gave partial detail on the process.
The cabinet will inform the House further about the Dutch position in the third quarter of 2022.
Het kabinet zal Uw Kamer in het derde kwartaal van 2022 nader informeren over het Nederlands standpunt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van der Werf, Van Strien, De Hoop, Westerveld, Teunissen, Van der Graaf, Van Baarle, Koekkoek en Gündoğan over het verspreiden van een extreemrechtse omvolkingstheorie bij de om

MPs asked the government how the public broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland could broadcast the 'great replacement' conspiracy theory unchallenged, and what risks and sanctions follow. The Secretary of State answered that the NPO Ombudsman found Ongehoord Nederland breached the journalistic code, that the NPO intends to impose a sanction, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media and NPO, not the minister, are responsible for judging compliance with the Mediawet.
It is for the Commissariaat to assess the broadcast of Ongehoord Nieuws in light of the requirements the Mediawet places on broadcasters.
Het is aan het Commissariaat om de uitzending van Ongehoord Nieuws te beoordelen in het licht van de eisen die de Mediawet aan omroepen stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over de VN-conferentie over de VN-conferentie over het wereldzeeënverdrag

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked whether slow BBNJ treaty negotiations threaten the 30% ocean protection target, and about Dutch positions on MPAs, RFMOs, EIA thresholds, and genetic resources. The minister answered that negotiations are complex and ongoing, that the Netherlands seeks an ambitious outcome coordinated within the EU, and that no final decisions have been taken, while declining to commit to specific positions beyond general ambitions.
The process must ultimately lead to adoption of the treaty text by the UN General Assembly.
Het proces moet uiteindelijk leiden tot vaststelling van de verdragstekst door de AVVN.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Piri, Kuzu, Teunissen, Stoffer, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Brekelmans en Dassen over het gebrek aan humanitaire toegang in de Tigray-regio in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the lack of humanitarian access to Tigray, Ethiopia, including calls for UN investigations, sanctions, safe zones and press freedom. The minister answered that Nederland supports independent investigation and humanitarian access, has pressed for sanctions and an arms embargo within the EU without sufficient support, and will raise press access with the EU Special Envoy.
The Netherlands will continue to press, in EU and international contexts, on the three priorities mentioned above.
Nederland zal zich in blijven zetten, in EU- en internationaal verband, op de hierboven genoemde drie prioriteiten.
Antwoord op op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over exportsteun uit Nederlands Belastinggeld voor een omstreden project op de Filipijnen (deel 2)

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the Finance and Foreign Trade ministers about Dutch export credit insurance (ekv) for the contested New Manila International Airport project, covering biodiversity, flood and subsidence risks, the Boskalis dredging role, the absence of independent review and the lack of an environmental impact assessment. The state secretary answered most questions by defending the ekv due diligence, stating that the project's ESIA was adequate and that mangrove loss and forced resettlement are considered acceptable if mitigated, while committing to no new action.
I am of the view that the CSR assessment and testing against the CSR standards for the ekv was carried out carefully.
Ik ben van mening dat de IMVO-beoordeling en toetsing aan de IMVO-standaarden voor de ekv zorgvuldig heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over de dag van het Natuurlijk Kapitaal

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked the government about the Dutch Natural Capital Day, Dutch ecological footprint overshoot and how to reduce it. The minister answered that the footprint is too high, that the Netherlands cannot be self-sufficient but is working on transitions, and promised further information in later letters.
It goes too far to list all the cabinet's measures here.
Het voert te ver om hier alle maatregelen van het kabinet op te sommen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over misbruik van coronasteun door Berts Animal Verhuur

Two MPs asked whether the government would reclaim NOW wage subsidy paid to an animal rental company that used it for building work, and how enforcement by the NVWA and municipalities failed despite repeated complaints since 1998. The minister said NOW subsidy is adjusted only if wage sums fell, that building and dog-keeping limits are municipal matters, and that the NVWA has acted regularly and the company is now under intensified supervision.
For information on building works that may conflict with the zoning plan or other building permits, I refer you to the municipality of West Maas en Waal.
Voor informatie over bouwwerken die eventueel strijdig zijn met het bestemmingsplan of andere bouwvergunningen verwijs ik u naar gemeente West Maas en Waal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Jasper van Dijk over een nieuw kritisch rapport over het EU-Mercosur handelsverdrag

MPs Teunissen and Jasper van Dijk asked the minister to respond to a critical Handel Anders! report on the EU-Mercosur trade agreement, including claims of a democratic deficit, consultation failures with indigenous peoples, the delayed sustainability impact assessment, and possible splitting of the deal. The minister replied that the government does not share several of the report's assumptions, describes the EU and national consultation and parliamentary involvement, acknowledges the late SIA while noting its partial use of recent data, and defends the trade policy against the report's proposals.
Your House is regularly informed about the progress of negotiations on trade agreements, including through the regular progress report.
Uw Kamer wordt regelmatig geïnformeerd over de voortgang van onderhandelingen over handelsakkoorden, onder andere via de reguliere voortgangsrapportage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over het toekennen van een groot bedrag aan NOW-steun aan een meermaals veroordeeld bedrijf, dat weigert dwangsommen te betalen

Two MPs asked why a company that rents out animals, has repeated court-imposed penalties and enforcement history, received about 170,000 euro in NOW wage subsidy and remains an approved training company. The ministers answered that the NOW scheme does not test animal welfare, that subsidy amounts are advances pending final settlement, and that SBB and the NVWA are monitoring the company.
Animal welfare is not part of these conditions.
Dierenwelzijn is geen onderdeel van deze voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over het exporteren van hamsters naar Hongkong

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked whether the government would share its exchanges with Hong Kong authorities after hamsters exported from the Netherlands tested positive for the Delta variant, and whether it would halt live rodent exports. The minister said the correspondence was shared with parliament via the health minister, that existing EU and OIE rules were followed without a SARS-CoV-2 requirement, and that no direct reason for a ban exists while exports stay within those rules, with a national zoonosis action plan to follow.
As long as the trade in live rodents to other member states or export to third countries takes place within the framework of this regulation, I see no direct reason to ban the trade.
Zolang de handel van levende knaagdieren naar andere lidstaten of export naar derde landen binnen de kaders van deze regelgeving plaatsvindt, zie ik geen directe aanleiding de handel te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Teunissen, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Simons en Dassen over het lot van de Afghaanse ambassadebewakers

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Afghan guards employed by an external contractor at the Dutch embassy in Kabul were not evacuated, when the Belhaj motion called for evacuating those who assisted the Dutch government, and whether the contractor was informed of the decision. The minister answered that the guards were not embassy employees and guarded other states' diplomatic missions, so they fell outside the evacuation criteria; he acknowledged the contractor received no timely written reply and that the lists and correspondence are shared only confidentially.
The request of 15 August and both reminders are shared with you on a confidential basis.
Het verzoek van 15 augustus en beide rappels worden op vertrouwelijke basis met u gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de inzet van Nederland voor de VN-Biodiversiteitstop

An MP asked the government about Dutch preparations for the UN biodiversity summit (CBD COP-15), including timelines, binding targets, the 30% protection goal, financing gap, and stakeholder involvement. The minister answered at length, committing to stronger monitoring and reporting and ratcheting-up mechanisms, but largely described existing positions and processes without concrete new institutional changes.
Due to the privacy of the involved civil society organisations and companies, no statement can unfortunately be made about who participated in the online stakeholder consultations.
Vanwege de privacy van de betrokken maatschappelijke organisaties en bedrijven kan helaas geen uitspraak worden gedaan over wie deelnamen aan de online stakeholderconsultaties
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over het Energy Charter Treaty

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked the government about the modernisation of the Energy Charter Treaty, arbitration claims by RWE, Uniper and Riverstone over Dutch coal-phase-out policy, and whether investor claims threaten climate policy. The government answered that the EU seeks to align the treaty with the Paris Agreement, that it is still negotiating and will reconsider options such as withdrawal after the next negotiation rounds, and that it has made the arbitration procedures and subsidy documents partly transparent while withholding confidential commercial information.
Due to commercially confidential information, I cannot make the subsidy decision and the underlying advice public.
Vanwege bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie kan ik het subsidiebesluit en de onderliggende adviezen niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het bericht dat de CCS-installatie bij een waterstofproject van Shell meer broeikasgassen uitstoot dan het afvangt

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked whether the Scotford hydrogen CCS plant emits more CO2 than it captures, whether CCS is a sound use of public subsidy, and related questions on risks, leakage and subsidy recovery. The minister disputes the report's conclusion, says the plant captures more than it emits after correcting for energy use, defends subsidies for hard-to-abate industry under the ETS and a cost-correction mechanism, and rejects stopping or reclaiming CCS funding.
No, that is not correct. The article refers to a specific project in which the CO2 released in hydrogen production is captured.
Nee, dat klopt niet. Het artikel refereert aan een specifiek project, waarbij de CO 2 die vrijkomt bij de productie van waterstof wordt afgevangen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Ellemeet, Van der Graaf, Piri, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu en Teunissen over het bericht 'Polish coalition dynamics complicate rule-of-law talks, says EU’s justi

MPs asked the government whether the EU rule-of-law conditionality mechanism would be activated before Hungary's April 2022 elections and why it had not yet been used, and urged the Netherlands to press the Commission. The minister replied that the Commission had delayed the mechanism pending guidelines and a Court of Justice ruling (issued 16 February 2022), that the procedure takes at least three months so cannot be finished before the Hungarian vote, and that the Netherlands continues to urge swift guidelines and activation.

The government continues to urge the Commission to fully use the MFK rule-of-law regulation by establishing guidelines as soon as possible and starting the procedure to suspend or stop payments of EU funds.

Het kabinet blijft er bij de Commissie op aandringen om de MFK-rechtsstaatverordening volledig te benutten, door nu zo snel mogelijk richtsnoeren vast te stellen, en de procedure om tot de opschorting of stopzetting van uitkering van EU-middelen te komen, te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van der Lee over hoe Nederlandse vlees-, zuivel- en veevoerbedrijven ontbossing, landroof en corruptie stimuleren

MPs Teunissen and Van der Lee asked how Dutch meat, dairy and feed companies contribute to deforestation, land grabbing and corruption via soy supply chains, and whether soy traceability, certification and due diligence are adequate. The minister answers that OESO guidelines do not require full supply-chain transparency, that mixed trade models make soy origin hard to trace, that certification has been effective, and that mandatory IMVO legislation is planned but left to a new cabinet.
The cabinet therefore welcomes the European Commission's proposed law to keep products, including soy, linked to deforestation and forest degradation off the European market.

Het kabinet verwelkomt daarom dat er nu een voorstel van wet van de Europese Commissie voorligt om producten, waaronder soja, van de Europese markt te weren die gerelateerd zijn aan ontbossing en bosdegradatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over een door FMO gefinancierd bedrijf dat is veroordeeld voor een moordcomplot in Honduras

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the ministers about FMO's financing of the company behind the Agua Zarca project in Honduras, whose CEO was convicted of involvement in the murder of activist Berta Cáceres, and whether FMO and the ministry ignored repeated civil-society warnings and how to improve FMO's due diligence and transparency. The minister answered that a civil lawsuit against FMO is pending so no judgement is given on FMO's role, that the ministry has pressed for improvements, and that FMO's transparency and IMVO policies have been and are being tightened.
Pending this procedure, I make no statements about FMO's role.
Hangende deze procedure doe ik over de rol van FMO geen uitspraken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu, Teunissen, Simons, Van der Plas en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse Zaken weigert Afghaanse bewakers ambassade Kabul te evacueren’

MPs asked why Dutch embassy security guards employed via a subcontractor in Kabul were not evacuated while Hungarian guards were, and whether a new direct-employment criterion was introduced without informing parliament. The government answered that the criteria for evacuation (Belhaj motion) were unchanged, that embassy guards fall under host-state responsibility and their employer is responsible, and gave figures on remaining interpreters and Afghans awaiting transfer.
There is no question of a new criterion.
Er is geen sprake van een nieuw criterium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Jasper van Dijk en Teunissen over de onveilige situatie in Georgië voor asielzoekers met een LHBTI-achtergrond

MPs Kröger, Van Dijk and Teunissen asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether Georgia remains unsafe for LHBTI asylum seekers and whether it should stop being treated as a safe country of origin for this group, including whether removals should be halted. The State Secretary replied that the designation of Georgia as a safe country of origin continues, with heightened attention for LHBTI cases, that no change in the situation is seen, and that no halt to removals is warranted, while declining to comment on individual cases.
I do not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Ellemeet, Koekkoek en Teunissen over het bericht over mogelijke push back van een groep van 27 vluchtelingen op het Griekse eiland Lesbos

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary about reports of a group of 27 refugees hiding on Lesbos to avoid alleged pushback, including claims of a pushback of a minor, unlawful strip searches of detained activists, Greek laws criminalising aid and restricting lawyers, and the status of an independent EU monitoring mechanism. The government answered that it awaits findings from Greek and EU investigations, supports an independent monitoring mechanism, notes the Commission is responsible for enforcement, and does not accept that pushbacks are normal practice.
In the absence of independent information, I await the results of such investigations.
Bij het ontbreken van eigenstandige informatie wacht ik de resultaten van dergelijke onderzoeken af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Teunissen over de productie en export van zeer schadelijke landbouwgiffen die in Nederland verboden zijn

MPs Vestering and Teunissen asked whether pesticides banned in the EU but exported from the Netherlands, and residues of them on imported food, should be stopped and whether MRLs should be set at zero. The minister reported about 16,000 tonnes of chemicals exported outside the EU in 2018 and noted that other countries set their own rules, that the Commission plans green diplomacy and to reconsider import tolerances, and that MRLs cannot automatically be set to the detection limit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over het aankomende staatsbezoek in Noorwegen en het aankaarten van de Noorse walvisjacht

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked whether the King knows that Norway killed 575 whales this year, whether IMF findings on whale carbon storage are known, and whether he would raise whaling with Norway during the state visit. The government confirms awareness of the figures and findings, says the climate-whaling link was not discussed but will feed into Dutch positions at the IWC, and reports that the Dutch position for a whaling ban was raised by other delegation members and by the Prime Minister by phone.
This subject was not raised by the King during the state visit, but it was raised by other members of the delegation.
Dit onderwerp is niet aangekaart door de Koning tijdens het staatsbezoek, maar wel door andere leden van de delegatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over de massale dolfijnslachting op de Faeröer eilanden

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked the government about the mass dolphin slaughter on the Faroe Islands, including whether Denmark and the Faroese government have been pressed and whether the topic will be raised in EU forums. The minister replied that the Netherlands opposes the hunt, that the ambassador has raised it with Faroese representatives, that the Faroe Islands are responsible for their own marine resources, and that the issue will be discussed in the EU Council working group on whaling.
As an autonomous part of the Kingdom of Denmark, the Faroe Islands are themselves responsible for managing their natural resources, including the hunting of cetaceans.
Als autonoom onderdeel van het Koninkrijk Denemarken zijn de Faeröer Eilanden zelf verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van hun natuurlijke hulpbronnen, met inbegrip van de jacht op walvisachtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Esch over de aanhoudende onvrede, acties en voorgenomen rechtszaken tegen ambtenaren- en lerarenpensioenfonds ABP

MPs Teunissen and Van Esch asked the ministers about public and legal pressure on pension fund ABP over fossil-fuel and animal-suffering investments, and whether public employers should tender the scheme, and whether conscientious objectors can opt out. The government answered that ABP's board independently manages investments, that ABP has decided to divest from fossil fuel producers, that tendering is not required under the Dutch statutory system, and that individual opt-out for investment objections is not possible.
The ABP board is responsible for implementing the pension scheme, including the investment policy.
Het ABP-bestuur gaat over de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling, inclusief het beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Teunissen over de drukte bij de Formule 1 in Zandvoort

MPs Van Esch and Teunissen asked the health and education ministers about crowding at the Formula 1 event in Zandvoort, the rules for seated versus unseated events, and whether this was foreseen and would be evaluated. Minister De Jonge answered that the event followed the rules in force, that seated and unseated events differ in risk, that about 90 infections were traced to the event, and that the government aims to lift restrictions when the epidemiological situation allows.
It turned out that this was not possible at all times.
Het is gebleken dat dat niet op alle momenten mogelijk was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over de publicatie van de juridische definitie van ecocide door een internationaal panel van experts

Two MPs (Van Raan and Teunissen, PvdD) asked the government for its view on an expert panel's proposed legal definition of ecocide and whether the Netherlands would engage with it. Minister Knapen replied that the proposal is a useful starting point for discussion but that ecocide is not recognised in international law, there is no current negotiation or consensus, and the government will follow developments and participate in relevant fora while focusing on other interventions for nature and biodiversity.
The government closely follows further developments and discussions on this.
Het kabinet volgt de verdere ontwikkelingen en discussies hierover nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over aandacht voor de eiwittransitie op internationale conferenties

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether plant-based menus should be the default at international climate conferences such as COP26, and how Dutch meat and dairy exports and feed imports would be raised there. The government said it would raise protein transition and sustainable catering with the UK host and pursue sustainable agriculture and deforestation-free supply chains, without committing to a default vegetarian menu.
The cabinet will raise the importance of a healthy and sustainable offer in preparatory talks for COP26 with the United Kingdom.
Het kabinet zal het belang van een gezond en duurzaam aanbod in voorbereidende gesprekken op COP26 bij het Verenigd Koninkrijk onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het gebrek aan duurzaam herstel uit de coronacrisis

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked why COVID-19 recovery support flowed to fossil firms without green conditions, why investment in sustainable energy is insufficient, and what the government will do about rising emissions. The Secretary of State answered that support aims to preserve jobs and income, that green conditions are costly and better handled through regular climate policy, that the amount invested in renewable energy cannot be determined, and that the government will present additional climate measures in the autumn Klimaatnota.
The primary aim of the support is to preserve business activity, employment and income, not to drive sustainability.
Het primaire doel van de steun is behoud van bedrijvigheid, werkgelegenheid en inkomen, niet het aanjagen van duurzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over exportsteun uit Nederlands belastinggeld voor een omstreden project op de Filipijnen

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked whether the government will grant an export credit insurance (ekv) to Boskalis for a contested airport project in Manila Bay, citing forced relocations and mangrove destruction. The state secretary confirmed a conditional coverage commitment ('mvo-mits') pending an unfinished environmental and social risk assessment, declined to disclose the amount, and said no policy is yet determined on the allegations.
I cannot yet make statements about the amount that may be insured. This concerns business, competition and price-sensitive information.
Over het eventueel te verzekeren bedrag kan ik op dit moment (nog) geen uitspraken doen. Dit betreft namelijk bedrijfs-, concurrentie- en koersgevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het rapport 'AR6 Climate Change 2021: The Physical Science Basis' van het Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC)

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the government about the IPCC AR6 Working Group I report on climate change, including its attribution of warming to humans, sea-level rise, extreme weather, tipping points, and Dutch fossil-fuel and climate policy. The Secretary of State mostly answered 'yes' or deferred, promising an appreciation letter in October and leaving further national climate targets to a future cabinet.
The demissionary cabinet considers the discussion on possibly adjusting Dutch climate targets a matter for a next cabinet.
De discussie over eventuele aanpassing van Nederlandse klimaatdoelen acht het demissionaire kabinet een zaak voor een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de oorzaken van de actuele watersnood in delen van Nederland, België en Duitsland

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether climate change caused the July 2021 flooding in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany, and questioned flood-return-period assumptions and emissions policy. The minister confirmed a link between the extreme rainfall and climate change, said flood-probability estimates are periodically updated, and pointed to a planned policy table and the damage quick scan.
The current expectation is that extreme weather conditions and high Meuse water levels will occur more and more often.
De huidige verwachting is dat extreme weersomstandigheden en hoge waterstanden van de Maas steeds vaker zullen voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Teunissen over turf-vrije potgrond

MPs Vestering and Teunissen asked the government about peat extraction for potting soil, its CO2 and biodiversity impacts, import volumes, and bans in other countries. Minister Schouten answered that peat extraction harms peatlands, that RPP certification aims for 100% certified peat by 2025, that England alone plans a sales ban, and that the minister will work toward fully peat-free potting soil for private consumers and study phase-out in the professional sector, reporting before the budget debate.
Yes, I have been called upon by your House through a motion to work toward fully peat-free potting soil for private consumers
Ja, ik ben door uw Kamer per motie opgeroepen toe te werken naar volledig turfvrije potgrond voor particulieren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over de exportkredietverzekering voor het omstreden gasproject in Mozambique

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan ask whether export credit insurance granted for the Total Mozambique LNG project was justified given escalating violence, human rights abuses and climate concerns, and why the policy was not withdrawn. The government answers that the risk assessment was careful and based on the information then available, that the force majeure situation was not foreseen, that the policy is not currently withdrawn, and that a new security, human rights and environmental review plus remedial action plan will be required before the project resumes.
The cabinet asks the multilateral development banks to systematically test for Paris alignment from 2023 onwards.
Het kabinet vraagt de multilaterale ontwikkelingsbanken om uiterlijk vanaf 2023 systematisch te toetsen op Paris alignment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Teunissen over een brandbrief van KDS over de hoge slachtsnelheid in slachthuizen

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about a letter from the works council of KDS, the meat inspection body, complaining that high slaughter line speeds prevent proper inspection and threaten food safety and worker safety. Minister Schouten answered that the government takes the concern seriously, has frozen line-speed increases pending an investigation due at year-end, and that legally it cannot order a structural reduction in speed immediately.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over een exportkredietverzekering voor een baggerschip van IHC in Myanmar

Two MPs (Van Raan and Teunissen, PvdD) asked why the Dutch state gave export credit insurance for an IHC dredger to a Myanmar ministry after the 2021 coup and given the Rohingya genocide allegations, and whether due diligence and the parliamentary motion against such cover were respected. The state secretary answered that the deal was insured before the coup, that the risks were judged acceptable under OECD and IFC standards, that Myanmar's country policy was tightened to exceptional cover in May 2021, and that the insurance was not retroactively withdrawn.
Legally it is not possible to retroactively withdraw a cover commitment as a result of a change in country policy.
Juridisch gezien is het niet mogelijk om met terugwerkende kracht een dekkingstoezegging in te trekken als gevolg van een wijziging van het landenbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over ernstige misstanden bij 'duurzame' palmoliebedrijven in Liberia

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan ask the government about serious abuses on palm oil plantations in Liberia (Golden Veroleum, MOPP) that are linked to RSPO membership and FMO financing, including land grabs, labour and environmental violations, and FMO's due diligence. The minister answers that FMO applies due diligence standards, RSPO is a private initiative outside government, FMO's action plan for SIFCA/MOPP is being monitored with an independent review planned, and the government is pursuing broader mandatory due diligence rules at EU level.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies, including those in the palm oil sector, to apply due diligence in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.

Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse bedrijven, waaronder bedrijven in de palmoliesector, dat zij gepaste zorgvuldigheid (due diligence) toepassen in lijn met de OESO-Richtlijnen voor Multinationale Ondernemingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het klachtenmechanisme voor de naleving van duurzaamheidsafspraken in handelsverdragen

An MP asked the foreign trade minister about the Single Entry Point complaint mechanism for sustainability commitments in trade agreements, questioning its enforceability, timelines, transparency, and the consultation process. The minister replied that the mechanism strengthens monitoring of binding sustainability chapters, that complaints are all taken up by the Commission, and that timelines, publication practice and an evaluation are still being worked out.
The complaints mechanism is not toothless.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Teunissen over het loslaten van oranje ballonnen voor TeamNL

Two Partij voor de Dieren MPs asked whether the Dutch embassy in Japan releasing orange plastic balloons over water near the Olympic Village was harmful to the environment and contrary to Dutch environmental policy. The minister replied that balloon release is not banned at national level, that biodegradable balloons were chosen after consultation with Japanese authorities, NOC*NSF and the ministry, and that the embassy will not repeat the one-off action.
In that sense, the embassy's event in Japan was not in conflict with Dutch environmental policy.
In die zin was het event van de ambassade in Japan niet in strijd met het Nederlandse milieubeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de Nederlandse deelname aan een militaire oefening in de Westelijke Sahara

An MP asked whether Dutch participation in the military exercise African Lion 21 takes place partly in Western Sahara, whether this conflicts with the Dutch neutral stance, whether the Sahrawi population was consulted, and whether parliament was informed in advance. The government answered that the exercise is organised by USAFRICOM and, according to them, does not take place in Western Sahara, that Dutch participation has no consequences for the Dutch position, that Morocco was notified by note verbale, that parliament is not usually informed about exercises, and that participation will be assessed per exercise.
The cabinet does not comment on the deployment of partners.
Het kabinet laat zich niet uit over de inzet van partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over het manifest ‘Klimaat in de Klas’

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked the Minister of Education about the 'Klimaat in de Klas' manifesto, including curriculum climate content, student and teacher involvement, objectivity, and corporate influence such as Shell's festival and sponsorship in schools. The Minister answered that the government is open to dialogue, is pursuing stronger sustainability content in curriculum proposals, but says schools are autonomous and the government's ability to restrict corporate materials is limited by freedom of education and expression.
It is not centrally recorded how often and by what means companies or other parties try to influence education.
Er wordt niet landelijk bijgehouden hoe vaak en waarmee bedrijven of andere partijen proberen het onderwijs te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het Kinderklimaatakkoord

An MP asked ministers about the Children's Climate Agreement, its proposals (dike and dune strengthening, eating less meat, replacing felled trees), rising meat consumption and forest loss, and what further measures will be taken. The state secretary answers that the government is willing to meet the children's delegation, points to existing climate and nature policy and youth consultation, and says further tree-planting ambitions are for a future cabinet to decide.
Are you willing to talk with the delegation coming to The Hague to present the Children's Climate Agreement to national politics?
Bent u bereid om in gesprek te gaan met de afvaardiging die naar Den Haag komt om het Kinderklimaatakkoord aan te bieden aan de landelijke politiek?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Teunissen over laagvliegende vliegtuigen die vogels verstoren tijdens het broedseizoen

MPs Vestering and Teunissen asked whether low-flying military transport aircraft disturb breeding birds and whether this complies with nature protection law, and why military exercises cannot be moved abroad during COVID measures. The State Secretary answers that a 2018 preliminary assessment found military flights above 3,000 ft not disturbing, that low-level flights are conditional on avoiding important breeding areas, and that permit applications for some areas are in preparation, while refusing to halt exercises during the breeding season.
For temporary restricted areas that are regularly used for an exercise, a permit application is being prepared.
Voor tijdelijke gebieden met beperkingen die met regelmaat in gebruik zijn voor een oefening is een vergunningaanvraag in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over mensenrechtenschending, milieuvervuiling en belastingontwijking door oliebedrijf Pluspetrol

Two MPs asked the Dutch government about alleged human rights violations, pollution and tax avoidance by Pluspetrol, including its refusal to cooperate with the Dutch OECD National Contact Point and whether business misconduct should be sanctioned or made legally enforceable. The ministers answered that OECD guidelines are voluntary, that CSR policy is being strengthened toward a due diligence obligation (preferably at EU level), and that enforcement options are still being worked out.
The cabinet is currently developing building blocks for CSR legislation.
Het kabinet werkt op dit moment bouwstenen uit voor IMVO-wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het Klimaatcrisis Beleid Team

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister why the government has not adopted an independent climate commission or treated the climate crisis as a crisis, as advised by the Council of State, Rli and WRR. The state secretary replied that the Council of State already fulfils an advisory role, that the outgoing cabinet will not give a full response on the KBT advice, and that choices on climate governance are for the new cabinet.
I am of the view that the Council of State fulfils its role well. It is for the new cabinet to make any changes to governance, including any amendment of the Climate Act.

Ik ben van mening dat de Raad van State haar rol goed vervult. Daarbij is het aan het nieuwe kabinet om eventuele wijzigingen in de governance, waaronder een eventuele wijziging van de Klimaatwet, aan te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het bericht dat Duitsland haar broeikasgasreductiedoelen gaat aanscherpen

Two MPs (Teunissen and Van Raan, PvdD) asked the government about Germany's tightened 2030, 2040 and 2045 greenhouse gas targets, which follow a Constitutional Court ruling on Germany's climate law. The State Secretary answered that the targets are binding and cover all greenhouse gases, that Germany responded to the court ruling, and that the Netherlands will leave its own ambition for 2030 and 2050 to a next cabinet while welcoming the EU's higher target.
The Netherlands has in recent years repeatedly worked for ambitious European climate policy, including through the European Climate Ambition group.
Nederland heeft zich de afgelopen jaren veelvuldig ingezet voor ambitieus Europees klimaatbeleid, onder meer via de Europese klimaatkopgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Wassenberg over CO2-uitstoot van bodemberoerende visserij, die even hoog is als de luchtvaartindustrie

MPs Teunissen and Wassenberg asked whether CO2 released from bottom trawling is counted in national emissions, whether it can be quantified, and whether the government will protect 30% of Dutch seas. The minister replied that seabed disturbance emissions are not counted nationally because IPCC rules provide no method and the CO2 share is unknown, and that protection follows the Noordzeeakkoord targets (13.7% rising to 15% by 2030) rather than 30%.
I will explore, with the State Secretary of EZK and Dutch knowledge institutions, the options for characterising the nature and severity of seabed disturbance as a source of CO2 emissions.
Ik zal in overleg met de Staatssecretaris van EZK met Nederlandse kennisinstellingen de mogelijkheden verkennen om de aard en ernst van bodemberoering als bron van CO 2 -uitstoot te duiden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over exportkredietverzekeringen voor omstreden gasprojecten in Mozambique

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked the Dutch government about export credit insurance for the contested Mozambique LNG gas project in Cabo Delgado, including security, human rights, status of policies and climate compatibility. The government answered that policies were issued in March 2021 after financial close, that the state would not recover losses from Mozambique, that a new security analysis would be needed for any restart, and that the project was assessed against OECD/IFC standards.
We therefore cannot provide you with information on this, insofar as it is not already public.
Wij kunnen u hierover dus geen informatie verstrekken voor zover niet reeds openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het bericht dat volgens de secretaris-generaal van de Verenigde Naties de wereld op de rand van de afgrond staat door de klimaatcrisis

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the minister about UN and IEA warnings on climate change and CO2 emissions, and whether the Dutch COVID recovery packages sufficiently support a green recovery. The minister acknowledges the urgency, says the packages aimed to preserve employment rather than break with fossil business as usual, and points to the Klimaatakkoord, the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility, and a decision left to the next cabinet.
Implementing reforms was an important condition for the cabinet to agree to establish the RRF.
Het doorvoeren van hervormingen was een belangrijke voorwaarde voor het kabinet om in te kunnen stemmen met de oprichting van de RRF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de toename van het bosverlies in het afgelopen jaar

MP Teunissen asked the minister about rising deforestation, Dutch soy imports from Brazil, the Netherlands' role as a transit hub for agricultural commodities, FMO investments in the Congo basin, and whether the Netherlands should impose a boycott. The minister answered that the government relies on outside data, explained the soy import increase through market factors, said trade flows are hard to attribute, and pointed to EU-level measures and dialogue with Brazil rather than a unilateral boycott.
The cabinet has no independent information on global deforestation figures and therefore relies on reports from reputable knowledge institutions.
Het kabinet heeft geen zelfstandige informatie over mondiale ontbossingscijfers en baseert zich dan ook op rapporten en berichten van gerenommeerde kennisinstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht dat Nederland niet is uitgenodigd voor de door de VS georganiseerde klimaattop

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the Netherlands was excluded from the US-hosted climate summit and whether Dutch climate leadership is credible, and what the government will do to follow up on the summit and COP-26. The minister replied that the Netherlands was invited to the ministerial on adaptation and resilience, rejected the claim that the Netherlands is not seen as a climate leader, and promised to inform parliament through letters on climate diplomacy and COP-26.
You will receive this letter before the summer.
U ontvangt deze brief voor de zomer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked the government to respond to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, asking whether ministers agree with her criticism of climate policy, economic growth, and political inaction, and what concrete measures they will take (21 questions). The government's joint answer refers to the earlier answers to the questions and does not address the substance of the individual questions.
The written questions from MPs Van Raan and Teunissen (both PvdD), question number 2018Z24289, have been answered by way of Parliamentary Proceedings appendix, session 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen (beiden PvdD) vraagnummer 2018Z24289 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP asked the government, in 21 questions, whether ministers are accountable for climate policy and whether they will respond to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including on economic growth, intergenerational justice and changing the system. The answer, given on behalf of several ministers, was not included in the document, which contains only the question list and a reference to the answer in a separate parliamentary appendix.
The written questions of MP Teunissen (PvdD), question number 2018Z24288, have been answered by way of Parliamentary Proceedings appendix, session 2018–2019, no. 1305.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Teunissen (PvdD) vraagnummer 2018Z24288 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de bloemenveiling in Aalsmeer die een gigantische plastic afvalberg produceert en daar jaarlijks miljoenen euro’s aan verdient

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether the Aalsmeer flower auction's use of single-use plant trays, which generate large plastic waste, should be replaced by a deposit system or reusable trays. The State Secretary answered that Flora Holland and the VBN are working on a plan to promote reusable trays and recycling and that the government will assess next steps after consultation with the sector.
I have invited Flora Holland and the VBN to lay down their ambition to phase out single-use trays in a pledge through which they can join the Plastic Pact being concluded.
Ik heb Flora Holland en de VBN uitgenodigd om hun ambitie om eenmalige trays uit te faseren neer te leggen in een «pledge» waarbij zij zich kunnen aansluiten bij het te sluiten Plastic Pact.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht dat de veiligheid van vuurpijlen niet gegarandeerd kan worden

MP Teunissen asked about reports that firework launch stands failed safety tests and whether the sale of rockets should be banned if no safe stands are found. The Staatssecretaris confirmed the test failures, said TNO is researching alternative stands and that the trade must supply safe ones, and declined to commit to a ban for now.
Firework sellers bear a statutory responsibility for a launch stand that meets the requirements.
De verkopers van vuurwerk dragen een bij wet vastgelegde verantwoordelijkheid voor een lanceerstandaard die voldoet aan de eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het nieuws dat een lek in de persleiding van FrieslandCampina tienduizenden vissen het leven heeft gekost

An MP asked why a leak in a pipeline carrying FrieslandCampina wastewater killed large numbers of fish in the Berkel, why the response took days, who is responsible and whether the factories should have been shut down. The minister answered that the water board handled the leak as quickly as feasible, that the cause is still under investigation, and that liability and cost recovery cannot be determined until then.
The cause of the breach is currently being investigated. I am awaiting the results of that investigation.
De oorzaak van de breuk wordt momenteel onderzocht. Ik wacht de resultaten van dat onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Teunissen over het bericht ‘Chemieconcern Ineos overweegt miljardeninvestering en fabriek in Rotterdam’

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about a possible INEOS plant in Rotterdam linked to shale gas, citing environmental, climate and plastics concerns and asking whether the government would oppose it. The minister said the plant would process imported ethane and propane (shale-derived byproducts) into ethylene and propylene, estimated about 0.8 Mton CO2 per year, acknowledged the plastics problem, and said the government would not oppose the investment but would apply climate agreements, with talks with Dutch authorities ongoing.
The cabinet wants to promote CO2 emission reduction in existing industry and stimulate the development of new industries, companies and business activity.
Het kabinet wil CO 2 -emissiereductie in de bestaande industrie bevorderen en de ontwikkeling van nieuwe industrieën, bedrijven en bedrijvigheid stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over het bericht dat Shell kinderen wurgcontracten zou hebben laten ondertekenen

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked ministers about reports that Shell had children sign contracts with broad rights waivers, English-law jurisdiction and confidentiality clauses for Generation Discover 2018, and about related questions on the Hogeschool Leiden and the festival. The government answered that the forms were sent in error, were replaced, and that affected children were not photographed, declined to answer questions 3 to 25 because Shell will destroy the contracts, and did not consider the other issues reason for action beyond general comments.
Because Shell will destroy the agreements you refer to and will therefore not rely on them, I will not address questions 3 through 25, as you yourself suggest.
Omdat Shell de overeenkomsten waar u naar verwijst, zal vernietigen en daar dus geen beroep op zal doen ga ik, zoals u zelf voorstelt, niet in op de vragen 3 tot en met 25.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over tankers die elke dag illegaal kankerverwekkend gas lozen

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about tankers that vent benzene and other carcinogenic vapours on the Waal and Rhine, including near inhabited areas, and about enforcement gaps between provinces and the state. The minister answered that venting is banned only for petrol, that a national ban on venting other dangerous substances will take effect around 2020 under a revised Rhine convention, that enforcement lies with the ILT and Rijkswateren authorities, and that no change in provincial responsibility is warranted.
Nevertheless, my aim is to ban venting of all dangerous substances while sailing as quickly as possible.
Niettemin is mijn streven gericht op het zo snel mogelijk verbieden van het varend ontgassen van alle gevaarlijke stoffen

m: Motie van het lid White c.s. over met de eilandbesturen komen tot een verbetering van de toepassing van het "comply or explain"-principe
Asks the government to work with island councils to improve application of the comply-or-explain principle to BES legislation and inform the Chamber before summer 2026.
requests the government to work with the island councils to improve application of the comply or explain principle
verzoekt de regering om samen met de eilandbesturen tot een verbetering van de toepassing van het «comply or explain»-principe te komen
Motie van het lid White over de studieschuld deels kwijtschelden van jongeren die zich na hun studie weer op de eilanden vestigen
Asks the government to explore partially forgiving student debt for young people who settle on the Caribbean islands after their studies, in consultation with the islands.
requests the government to examine in consultation with the islands whether it is possible to forgive part of the student debt
verzoekt de regering om in overleg met de eilanden in het Caribische deel van het Koninkrijk te onderzoeken of het mogelijk is om een deel van de studieschuld kwijt te schelden
Motie van de leden Bruyning en White over een zo spoedig mogelijke sluiting van de vuilstort bij Lagun
Motion asking the government to close the Lagun waste dump on Bonaire as soon as possible and pursue a remediation operation, informing the House monthly.
requests the government, in consultation with the island government, to proceed to closing the Lagun waste dump as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering in overleg met het eilandsbestuur over te gaan tot zo spoedig mogelijke sluiting van de vuilstort bij Lagun
Motie van het lid Bamenga c.s. over per direct een huurcommissie instellen voor Saba en Statia
Asks the government to immediately establish a rent commission (Huurcommissie) for the islands Saba and Sint Eustatius to handle tenant disputes.
requests the government to immediately establish a rent commission for Saba and Statia
verzoekt de regering om per direct een huurcommissie in te stellen voor Saba en Statia
Motie van het lid Bamenga c.s. over zorgen dat steun uit de verhuurderssubsidie altijd direct bij huurders terechtkomt
Asks the government to ensure rent-subsidy support reaches tenants directly even when landlords do not cooperate, for example through legal obligations or alternative routes.
Motie van het lid Bamenga c.s. over de Bijdrage Particuliere Verhuur structureel maken en uitbreiden naar Saba en Statia
Asks the government to make the Bonaire rental contribution pilot permanent and extend it to Saba and Statia.
requests the government to make the Bijdrage Particuliere Verhuur pilot on Bonaire permanent
verzoekt de regering om de pilot van de Bijdrage Particuliere Verhuur op Bonaire structureel te maken
Motie van het lid Ceder c.s. over de defensiecapaciteit van het Caribische deel van het Koninkrijk versterken
Asks the government to improve information on international threats to the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom and to strengthen their defence capacity, for example with drones.
requests the government to improve information provision on international threats and protection against them to the governments and administrations in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom
verzoekt de regering de informatievoorziening over internationale dreigingen en de bescherming daartegen richting de regeringen en besturen in het Caribische deel van het Koninkrijk te verbeteren
Motie van de leden Kathmann en White over gelijke privacybescherming in het hele Koninkrijk
Asks the government to draw up a plan with autonomous countries and islands to equalise privacy protection across the Kingdom, including enforcement and supervision resources.
to develop a broadly supported plan to bring privacy protection across the Kingdom to an equivalent level within a few years
te komen tot een gedragen plan om binnen enkele jaren de privacybescherming in het hele Koninkrijk op een gelijkwaardig niveau te brengen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden White en Kathmann ter vervanging van nr. 10 over opname van het burgerservicenummer op de identiteitskaarten van Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba
Makes the citizen service number (BSN) mandatory on the Caribbean Netherlands ID card, reversing the earlier decision not to include it, which widens state data exposure for citizens.
The amendment is considered feasible and allows the entry into force of the BSN on the identity card to be set by royal decree
Het amendement wordt goed uitvoerbaar geacht en biedt de mogelijkheid om de inwerkingtreding van het BSN op de identiteitskaart bij koninklijk besluit vast te stellen
Motie van het lid Bruyning c.s. over onderzoeken hoe IND-voorzieningen op Saba en Sint-Eustatius aanvragen zelfstandig kunnen afhandelen
Asks the government to study how IND facilities on Saba and Sint Eustatius can decide and process residence and work permit applications locally instead of via Bonaire, reporting within six months.
requests the government to investigate how the IND facilities on Saba and Sint Eustatius can independently assess and process applications
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken hoe de IND-voorzieningen op Saba en Sint-Eustatius aanvragen zelfstandig kunnen beoordelen en afhandelen
Motie van de leden Ceder en White over dependances van universiteiten en hogescholen in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk
Asks the government to discuss with the Caribbean authorities and Dutch institutions setting up university branches on the Caribbean islands and to report to the House by Q3 2025.
to inform the House by the third quarter of 2025 about the outcomes of these discussions
de Kamer uiterlijk in het derde kwartaal van 2025 te informeren over de uitkomsten van deze gesprekken
Motie van het lid White c.s. over stimuleren dat Caribisch Nederland Nederlandse bancaire voorzieningen kan gebruiken
