qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid White over ‘verhuisberichten die niet goed doorkomen bij de Belastingdienst waardoor ondernemers in de financiële problemen komen’

An MP asked whether address changes sent to the Chamber of Commerce are sometimes not processed correctly by the Tax Authority, leaving entrepreneurs with blocked bank accounts, and what safeguards, compensation and faster procedures exist. The State Secretary acknowledged such cases occur in a very limited number of instances, saw no need for a structural investigation, pointed to existing correction procedures, contact moments before seizure, a Stellateam for urgent cases, and extra attention to address mutations with the Chamber of Commerce.
Given the small number of cases and the existing procedures, it is not appropriate to investigate this.
Gezien het kleine aantal gevallen en de bestaande procedures is het niet aan de orde om hier onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White en Mutluer over de aanhoudende problematiek van vuurwapenbezit op Curaçao

MPs White and Mutluer asked about rising firearm possession on Curaçao and the other Caribbean islands, including enforcement capacity, youth prevention, coastal smuggling and online sales. The minister answered that Curaçao is responsible for its own law enforcement, acknowledged capacity shortfalls and said Netherlands cooperates through the Justitieel Vierpartijenoverleg and related programmes.
Curaçao, as an autonomous country within the Kingdom, has its own responsibility for law enforcement and for policy to combat illegal firearms and their possession.
Curaçao heeft als autonoom land binnen het Koninkrijk een eigen verantwoordelijkheid voor de rechtshandhaving en voor het beleid om illegale vuurwapens en het bezit hiervan tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White en Pijpelink over de onderwijstaal op Caribisch Nederland

MPs White and Pijpelink asked the State Secretary of Education about aligning education law for Caribbean Netherlands, school quality on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and the CAS islands, and the role of Dutch versus Papiamentu in schooling. The State Secretary answered that Caribbean Netherlands education is subject to comply-or-explain and separate laws, that quality concerns are being addressed through island education agendas and support, and that Dutch-language and multilingual policy is pursued through ministerial cooperation.
It is worrying that the inspectorate again assesses the education quality of one of the schools as insufficient.
Het is zorgelijk dat de inspectie de onderwijskwaliteit van een van de scholen wederom als onvoldoende beoordeelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid White over het (tijdelijk) stoppen vanuit de Verenigde Staten met financiering op de CAS-eilanden

MP White asked the government about the impact on Curaçao, Aruba and Sint Maarten of the US aid freeze (USAID), including effects on civil society, healthcare, education, legal aid for migrants, and Dutch responsibility and support. The government answered that the Caribbean countries are primarily responsible for compensating lost funding, that the Kingdom bears no direct responsibility, and that the Netherlands can only play a facilitating role such as helping with EU fund applications.
It is not for the Dutch cabinet to give insight into these specific funding flows or to investigate the possible impact.
Het is niet aan het Nederlandse kabinet inzage te geven in deze specifieke financieringsstromen of onderzoek te doen naar de mogelijke impact.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid White over de zorgwekkende staat van het funderend onderwijs op Curaçao

MP White asked the minister how the Curaçao education inspectorate's alarming report on primary education should be explained, whether the situation was discussed at the 2024 M4LO meeting, what the Caribbean countries and the Netherlands can do, and how the BES islands are included. The minister replies that education is a matter for the autonomous Caribbean countries, that the issue was not specifically tabled at M4LO 2024, that cooperation runs through voluntary programmes such as Kibrahacha and SEA, and that Caribbean Netherlands is represented by the Netherlands with separate island education agendas.
For this reason it is not for the Ministry of OCW to make statements about reports on education in Curaçao prepared by the Curaçao Education Inspectorate or one of the other countries.

Het is hierdoor niet aan het Ministerie van OCW om uitspraken te doen over rapporten over het onderwijs in Curaçao die zijn opgesteld door de Inspectie van het Onderwijs van Curaçao of één van de andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden White en Gabriëls over het circulaire economiebeleid in Caribisch Nederland

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about circular economy policy in the Caribbean Netherlands, the state of waste management and plastic pollution there, and whether extended producer responsibility should be extended to these islands. The State Secretary answered that the islands have no specific circular economy policy but have environmental plans and plastic bans, that the ministry supports waste policy there, and that extending producer responsibility is not supported without prior research, while committing to examine further measures with the islands.
I am willing to examine with those islands how the actions already in place to further reduce plastic pollution can be continued.
Ik ben bereid met die eilanden te onderzoeken hoe verdergegaan kan worden met de acties die al ingesteld zijn om de plasticvervuiling verder te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White, Gabriëls en Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht ‘Bewoners Bonaire geëvacueerd na grote brand bij de vuilstort’

MPs White, Gabriëls and Slagt-Tichelman asked about a large fire at the Selibon waste dump on Bonaire, its health and environmental effects, and the permit and oversight failures at the site. The government answered that the underground fire is not yet controlled, that the acting Kingdom Representative has taken over permitting and enforcement from the island authority due to neglect of duty, and that a waste plan and asbestos and biomedical waste measures are being prepared.

This led to a decision by the acting Kingdom Representative (on 15 November 2024) to step in for the island executive and make a number of decisions on permitting, supervision and enforcement at Selibon/Lagun.

Dit heeft geleid tot een besluit van de waarnemend Rijksvertegenwoordiger (op 15 november 2024) om indeplaats te treden van het bestuurscollege en daarmee te voorzien in een aantal beslissingen op het gebied van vergunningverlening, toezicht-, en handhaving (VTH) bij Selibon/Lagun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid White over schendingen van mensenrechten van Venezolaanse vluchtelingen op Aruba

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the State Secretary whether Dutch support to Aruba's migration system made the Netherlands complicit in violating non-refoulement of Venezuelan refugees, as Amnesty alleged. The government answered that asylum and human rights are primarily Aruba's responsibility, that Dutch assistance aimed at aligning procedures with international standards and did not include tracing, detention or deportation, and that Kingdom intervention under Article 43 of the Statute is a high bar.
Both asylum, reception and return policy, as well as human rights policy, are in the first instance the responsibility of the autonomous countries within the Kingdom.
Zowel asiel-, opvang- en terugkeerbeleid, als mensenrechtenbeleid, is in eerste instantie een verantwoordelijkheid van de autonome landen binnen het Koninkrijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jansen en Palmen, Ceder en White n.a.v. Beleidsreactie ACOI-rapport over de openbaarheid van de Bijlmervliegramp-stukken en het feit dat openbaarheid jaren op zich laat wachten door vertra

MPs Jansen, Palmen, Ceder and White asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the Bijlmer air disaster archive remains largely closed years after the 2023 motion and why the government is commissioning external studies before acting on the ACOI recommendations. The minister defends the sequencing as driven by scarce expertise and procedure, outlines timelines and planned studies, and says access to the audio material was delayed by equipment and digitisation needs.
The aim is to have the study on recommendation 4 completed in the first quarter of 2025.
Het streven is het onderzoek naar aanbeveling 4 in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 gereed te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid White over het belang van ondernemende vrouwen en migranten

MP White asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the government will improve access to finance and other conditions for female and migrant entrepreneurs, including Seed Capital scheme criteria, the national MKB financing covenant, and the economic legacy of slavery. The minister answered that existing instruments are open to all entrepreneurs, cited diversity criteria, Code-V and DLiT support, and referred the slavery question to a separate letter.
The national government has a broad range of financing instruments for both the broad and the innovative SME sector (including startups).
De Rijksoverheid heeft een breed instrumentarium voor financiering, voor zowel het brede als het innovatieve mkb (inclusief startups).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White en Bushoff over de ziekenhuiszorg in Curaçao

Two MPs asked the State Secretary and Minister about the financial distress of Curaçao Medical Center, the continuity and access of healthcare on Curaçao, and what Dutch support is available. The government answered that healthcare is Curaçao's responsibility, that Curaçao has not requested or used offered Dutch support, and that a supplementary financing package and structural reforms are planned.
I do not have sufficient information to make a full assessment of this.
Ik beschik niet over voldoende informatie om een volledige inschatting hiervan te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en White over extreem hoge ticketprijzen voor vliegreizen naar Suriname

MPs De Hoop and White asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why flights to Suriname are two to four times pricier than to Aruba and other Caribbean destinations, whether cartel behaviour or extra costs explain this, and how the government will protect a network serving diaspora travellers. The minister replied that airlines set fares commercially, that the competition authority ACM previously found no excessive pricing, that the ministry has no indication of abuse of dominance and little power to intervene under the bilateral agreement, and that it will push for more steering on public interests like network quality in EU rules.
The ministry will work to achieve more steering of public interests, such as network quality, when the relevant EU laws and regulations are revised.
Het ministerie zal zich inzetten voor meer sturing op publieke belangen, zoals netwerkkwaliteit, bij de herziening van de hiervoor relevante EU wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid White over de voorbereiding van de BES-eilanden op het orkaanseizoen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about preparations on the BES islands for the 2024 hurricane season, including climate plans and risk management. The government answered that the islands and Caribbean countries are primarily responsible for disaster preparedness, that coordination runs through the Week of Crisis Management and KNMI briefings, and that climate plans are being drafted with Rijk support and progress will be reported in autumn.
You will be informed about the progress in the autumn.
U wordt in het najaar geïnformeerd over de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en White over het bericht dat honderd oudere Surinamers een verblijfsstatus aanvragen

MPs Piri and White asked the Interior and Justice ministers about reports that about a hundred elderly former Dutch-Surinamese residents were applying for residence status, and about a possible scheme for this group. The state secretary said a targeted one-off scheme was examined but not developed, that the caretaker cabinet would leave new policy to its successor, and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
Given the caretaker status of the current Cabinet, I am of the view that it is no longer for me to develop policy.
Gelet op de demissionaire status van het huidige Kabinet ben ik van oordeel dat het niet meer aan mij is beleid te ontwikkelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister. The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en White over het meenemen van de AOW-uitkering naar het buitenland

MPs Stultiens and White asked why AOW pensions can be fully exported to some countries with enforcement treaties but only at the married rate to others, how many people are affected, which countries lack treaties, and whether new treaties are planned. The minister explains that export rules follow the Wet BEU and enforcement treaties, lists about 36 treaty jurisdictions plus EU/EER/Switzerland and Caribbean arrangements, reports roughly 0.04% of AOW recipients are affected, and says a 2015 motion to seek treaties with eight countries has not succeeded because the countries declined negotiation.
Should these countries wish to enter negotiations in the future, a new assessment would have to be made per country on whether that is desirable.
Mochten deze landen in de toekomst alsnog in onderhandeling willen treden dan zal per land een nieuwe weging gemaakt moeten worden over de wenselijkheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White en Westerveld over het gebruik van de term ‘ras’ in de gezondheidszorg

MPs White and Westerveld asked the minister about the use of the term 'race' in health care after a news report that medical guidelines still use it, and whether this risks misdiagnosis and unequal care. The minister agreed etnicity must never justify worse care and should only be used for guidelines when solidly evidence-based, but said a broad check of all medical bodies is not feasible and that discrimination risks exist across the sector, pointing to an existing VWS anti-discrimination programme.
A broad check on all medical institutions is not feasible.
Een brede check op alle medische instanties is niet haalbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid White over het bericht 'Caribische eilanden krijgen gelijk na gemopper over bureaucratie Nederland'

MP White asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about press reports that the Caribbean Netherlands islands face bureaucratic hurdles in obtaining extra budgets for their tasks, and about the Raad voor het Openbaar Bestuur's advice on fixed funding, transport and medical care. The State Secretary answered that the IdeeVersa study and ROB advice support improving financial relations, that reforms to the WolBES and FinBES laws and a possible Bestuurlijk Overleg Financiële verhoudingen are under way with a letter to the House promised before summer, and she described the existing student grants, transport and medical travel arrangements.
I am in discussion with departments about the funding of island tasks, the adequacy of the general grant, and the extent to which special grants can be made structural or added to the general grant.

Ik ben in gesprek met departementen over de financiering van de eilandelijke taken, de toereikendheid van de vrije uitkering en in hoeverre bijzondere uitkeringen structureel kunnen worden gemaakt of aan de vrije uitkering kunnen worden toegevoegd.
