qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over zijn vragen ten aanzien van het nieuwsbericht over verplichte e-facturatie per 2026

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a report that only one in ten SMEs is ready for mandatory e-invoicing in 2026, and about preparation, consequences, and possible postponement. The minister corrected the date to 1 July 2030 under the EU VIDA package, said the government will involve businesses, pay attention to administrative burden, and commit to submitting the legislation at least two years before entry into force, while stating that businesses remain responsible for knowing the rules.
The cabinet aims to submit to parliament the legislation on the part of VIDA covering e-invoicing and digital reporting at least two years before entry into force.
Het kabinet streeft ernaar om de wetgeving betreffende het deel van VIDA dat ziet op e-facturatie en digitale rapportage bij uw Kamer in te dienen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht ‘Duizenden banen op de tocht door nieuwe Postwet, regionale postbedrijven dreigen te verdwijnen’

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the new Postal Act's effect on regional postal companies, including the phase-out of discounted access to PostNL's national network, pricing after five years, and job impacts. The minister defends the transitional access regime, rejects sector-specific job protections, and commits to a further response before the 3 September round table.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, Verkuijlen en Kisteman over de storing bij de radiosystemen van de Kustwacht op 1 juli jl.

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about a July 2025 radio system failure at the Kustwacht, its cause, whether lives were endangered, its link to the 2024 NAFIN outage, backup and cyber protection. The government answered that the radio systems are operational again, the cause was investigated with measures taken, no critical situations arose, but it withheld details on cyber protection for security reasons and gave limited detail on the causes.
For security reasons I cannot go into this any further.
Vanwege veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik hierop verder niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kisteman, Dral en Bikkers over het bericht 'Gokken, alcohol, drugs: verslavingsproblemen nemen toe bij noodlijdende ondernemers'

MPs Kisteman, Dral and Bikkers asked the ministers whether the government is aware of rising addiction among distressed entrepreneurs, whether there are regional or sectoral differences, and what measures and municipal support are planned. Minister Karremans answered that addiction among entrepreneurs is not registered separately and no national figures exist, pointed to existing debt-support programmes and municipal efforts, and committed to exploring with municipalities and other partners how support for entrepreneurs with multiple problems can be structurally strengthened.
Yes. I will explore with municipalities, trade organisations and care partners whether, and if so how, support for entrepreneurs with multiple problems can be structurally strengthened.
Ja. Ik ga samen met gemeenten, brancheorganisaties en zorgpartijen verkennen of, en zo ja, hoe de ondersteuning van ondernemers met meervoudige problematiek structureel versterkt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht 'Ouders die kind van school houden vanwege geloofsovertuiging worden niet meer vervolgd'

MPs asked the State Secretary for Education about press reports that the Public Prosecution Service (OM) has stopped prosecuting parents who keep children out of school for religious or ideological reasons, and whether this creates a precedent and undermines compulsory schooling. The government answered that the OM now prosecutes only formal-ground cases, that it shares concern about rising non-attendance, and that it is exploring alternatives, including possible legislation, reporting back before the summer.
I am examining what options there are to get children who stay at home without permission due to objections arising from their parents' religious conviction or worldview into school as well.

Ik ben aan het bezien welke mogelijkheden er zijn om kinderen die zonder toestemming thuiszitten vanwege bezwaren die voortkomen uit de geloofsovertuiging of levensopvatting van hun ouders, ook naar school te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Kisteman en Heite over het bericht 'Civitas Christiana voert al jaren een leugen– en lastercampagne tegen Rutgers

MPs Becker, Kisteman and Heite asked the State Secretary of Education about Civitas Christiana's campaign against Rutgers, including its impact on schools, desinformation, foreign influence and the motion on foreign funding. The State Secretary answered that schools must be free from external pressure, pointed to a court ruling against Civitas and to existing support tools, and said the motion on foreign funding is being followed up through consultations and pending legislation.
In addition, the bill on free and safe education will make a confidential counsellor mandatory at every school.
Daarnaast wordt met het wetsvoorstel vrij en veilig onderwijs een vertrouwenspersoon op elke school verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Kisteman over het voorkomen dat financieel gezonde bedrijven onnodig failliet gaan en het bieden van maatwerk voor ondernemers met coronabelastingschulden

MPs Van Eijk and Kisteman (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Finance about bankruptcies of financially healthy firms with corona tax debts, the scope for tailored debt settlements, and operational problems with creditors, payment terms and the valuation of settlement offers. The State Secretary answered at length, announcing amendments to the collection guidelines from 1 July 2025 (clarifying hold-out creditors and allowing settlement payments beyond twelve months), while defending the existing rules on creditors, enforcement proceeds and deadlines and promising ongoing monitoring via stand-van-zakenbrieven.
I can now inform the House that two amendments to the Collection Guidelines 2008 have proven feasible from 1 July 2025.
Ik kan uw Kamer inmiddels mededelen dat twee wijzigingen van de Leidraad invordering 2008 (LI 2008) haalbaar zijn gebleken per 1 juli 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over nieuwe horecaregels in Amsterdam

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he would intervene in Amsterdam's new hospitality rules, including discretionary exemptions for late opening, snack bar closing times and possible restrictions on terraces and dancing. The minister replied that municipalities are responsible for their own rules and declined any additional steps beyond the existing cooperation programme with the VNG.
The municipality of Amsterdam is responsible for its own rules and has the best view of their effects.
Gemeente Amsterdam is verantwoordelijk voor haar eigen regels en heeft het beste zicht op de effecten daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over betaalbare boodschappen door QR-code als onderdeel van de VVD Agenda voor Werkend Nederland

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether an English-language label with a QR code linking to Dutch product information should be allowed in supermarkets to lower prices, and asks about EU negotiations, the motion on QR codes, savings estimates and inflation. The minister rejects the QR-code route as a solution to territorial supply constraints, argues Dutch labels must remain, states no savings estimates exist, and promises a letter on inflation.
I have no figures on how many euros an average Dutch household could save per year if an English-language label with a QR code were allowed on supermarket products.

Ik heb geen cijfers over hoeveel euro een gemiddeld Nederlands huishouden naar schatting op jaarbasis kan besparen als een Engelstalig etiket met QR-code op producten in de supermarkt wordt toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht ‘Staatssecretaris Paul stelt ultimatum: 'weigerscholen' moeten voor 7 maart doorstroomtoets maken’’

An MP asks the state secretary about the refusal of some primary schools to administer the transition test (doorstroomtoets) after sanctions were threatened, and what this means for pupils whose advice may be underestimated. The state secretary answers that the test is a second objective signal that helps pupils at risk of underadvice, that the school's advice remains decisive but should normally be adjusted if the test shows more capacity, and that the test also informs inspectorate monitoring.
I will communicate the final figures for school year 2023–2024 to the House in April, including breakdowns by various groups of pupils.
Ik communiceer de definitieve cijfers over schooljaar 2023–2024 in april met uw Kamer, waarbij ook uitsplitsingen worden gemaakt naar diverse groepen leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kisteman en Van Eijk over de BijzonderBeheer Barometer van PwC (i.v.m. antwoord op vraag 4)

MPs Kisteman and Van Eijk asked the Ministers about PwC's Bijzonder Beheer Barometer, which claims Tax Authority rules (requiring settlements to include all creditors and limiting payment plans to twelve months) make restructuring unworkable for firms. The minister defended the Tax Authority's strict debt-relief policy, said flexibility exists for individual cases, gave no commitment to change the WHOA or policy, and noted the Impulsaanpak Winkelgebieden might be extended only if budget becomes available.
The receiver, in principle, pursues a strict deferral and debt-relief policy towards entrepreneurs.
De ontvanger voert ten aanzien van ondernemers in beginsel een stringent uitstel- en kwijtscheldingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht 'Krap zesje voor ondernemersklimaat: 'Het gaat de verkeerde kant op''

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government will act on regulatory burden after reports that the business climate is worsening, and what concrete targets and timelines the Minder Druk Met Regels action programme sets. The minister answered that the government is committed to reducing burden through the action programme, a reduction programme with a ministerial steering group, EU-level efforts, and cooperation with the VNG, while providing few hard numerical targets and no firm deadline beyond the business climate pact due by summer 2025.
The cabinet has included the following objective in the coalition agreement: the cabinet reduces regulatory burden for businesses and makes it easier to comply with rules.
Het kabinet heeft in het regeerprogramma de volgende doelstelling opgenomen: het kabinet dringt regeldruk voor bedrijven terug en maakt het eenvoudiger om aan regels te kunnen voldoen.
Antwoord op van de leden Martens-America en Kisteman over het bericht ’Kleding SHEIN vol hormoonverstorende stoffen, slippers 325 keer giftiger dan toegestaan’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that SHEIN clothing contained hormone-disrupting substances, how many non-conforming products are sold, what legal basis Dutch and EU authorities have to act, and why enforcement was not intensified before the holidays. The Minister answered that EU market surveillance studies find 85-95% of sampled third-country platform products non-conforming, that the European Commission has exclusive competence over VLOPs like SHEIN under the DSA, and that the government will push for EU-level action and a customs reform, but could not yet provide Productenmeldwijzer report figures and declined to comment on enforcement timing.
As Minister I do not make decisions on the (temporary) intensification of supervision. That is for the supervisory authorities.
Als Minister neem ik geen besluit over de (tijdelijke) intensivering van het toezicht. Dat is aan de toezichthouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over de tijdige bezorging van rouwpost in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that an undertaker delivered funeral cards himself after PostNL delays, and whether residents' loss of trust in PostNL is desirable. The minister acknowledged delays despite special rules for mourning mail, said the ACM is studying the postal market and a future vision follows in 2025, and described PostNL's calamity protocol, which was used in under 0.2% of cases.
Currently I am having the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) carry out research into the postal market.
Momenteel laat ik de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) onderzoek uitvoeren naar de postmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kisteman, Van Eijk en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Achteraf betalen kan binnenkort ook in fysieke winkels dankzij nieuwe samenwerking'

Three VVD MPs asked the government about news that buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) would extend to physical shops, and about its effects on young people and indebted consumers. The minister answered that BNPL-in-shops offers minimal social added value with large risks, pointed to the coming CCDII directive, age verification and a sector code, and said a temporary ban is not feasible.
The government therefore finds the announcement to extend BNPL services to physical shops very undesirable.
De aankondiging om BNPL-diensten uit te breiden naar fysieke winkels vindt het kabinet dan ook zeer onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buijsse en Kisteman over het bericht 'Statiegeld mogelijk omhoog naar €1 per fles'

Two VVD MPs asked whether a reported possible increase of the deposit on bottles to EUR 1 would burden consumers, harm the environment, dirty streets, and how collection could be improved. The state secretary answered that no increase has been decided yet, the ILT is still reviewing Verpact's studies, an evaluation of the deposit scheme is underway with results due spring 2025, and that ILT has ordered Verpact to create 5,400 extra return points.
At this moment there is not yet any intention to increase the deposit.
Op dit moment is er nog geen sprake van een voornemen tot verhoging van het statiegeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht 'Een derde van de schoolbestuurders laat zich maximaal belonen'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about a report that a third of school board members are paid up to the WNT maximum, and about exceeding the cap in 51 cases, plus pay, cao, cost, and cumulation questions. The State Secretary says the supervisory board sets pay within the WNT, overruns were mostly optical and checked by the accountant and Inspectorate, and a bill on governance and integrity is planned.
If there is in fact a violation, the Inspectorate of Education can take enforcement action.
Indien er wel sprake is van een overtreding dan kan de Inspectie van het Onderwijs handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht 'Op veel scholen wordt gehandeld in vuurwerk, inclusief cobra’s en nitraten'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about reports that illegal fireworks, including cobras and nitrates, are traded at many schools and whether national guidelines exist. The State Secretary said general national rules apply, schools have a safety duty, and the Wet vrij en veilig onderwijs will add incident registration and reporting to the Inspectorate.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Kisteman over een  reportage over glazenwassers door het tv-programma Radar

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Kisteman asked about a Radar report on rogue window cleaners, including consumer rights, complaint channels, cash payment, sector knowledge, enforcement and whether the Zaanstad licensing approach should be copied. The minister answered that consumers may be required to pay in cash, that Zaanstad's licensing scheme is a municipal matter, that no further sector study is planned, and that no integrated national enforcement campaign is currently running.
The police have no overviews of the number of reports made over the past two years about window cleaners, because no sector-specific overviews are kept.
Bij politie zijn geen overzichten aanwezig van het aantal meldingen dat de afgelopen twee jaar is gedaan over glazenwassers, omdat geen sectorale overzichten worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht 'Inspectie bezoekt al jaren veel minder basisscholen dan aan Kamer is beloofd'

An MP asks whether the Inspectorate of Education met its 2007 commitment to visit every primary school every four years, given poor registration and a visit gap of about one third, and how it plans to fix this. The minister admits the commitment was not met, announces an independent external investigation by the Auditdienst Rijk, and promises a verification plan for registration plus a later letter on the new inspection framework.
We intend to commission an independent and external investigation into the reports on the inspectorate's visits to schools in primary and secondary education.
Wij zijn voornemens een onafhankelijk en extern onderzoek te laten verrichten naar de rapportages over de bezoeken van de inspectie aan scholen in het funderend onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over Het bericht 'Tien jaar Passend Onderwijs: hogere kosten en meer thuiszitters'

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Education why special education enrolment and the number of children staying at home without schooling keep rising ten years after the introduction of Passend Onderwijs, and how this relates to the aims of inclusive education, funding and exemptions. The State Secretary answers all questions in substance, attributing the rise to broader social developments and staff shortages, setting out short, medium and long-term measures, and announcing the Terugdringen Verzuim bill and further research into absolute truancy.
I will soon submit the Terugdringen Verzuim bill.
Daarom dien ik binnenkort het wetsvoorstel Terugdringen Verzuim in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht «School van Anneloes kost ouders 7.100 euro per jaar: «Dag begint niet met wiskunde, maar meditatie»»

The MP asks the state secretary about a news report on a costly private school (B3-school) with meditation-focused mornings, including numbers of applications, reasons parents choose such schools, teacher employment, lighter requirements and homeschooling oversight. The state secretary reports 85 inspection advisory visits in 2020-2023 with only a handful of negative advice, explains that private schools face fewer regulations because there is no funding relationship, and says a bill setting minimum homeschooling requirements is being prepared.
The Ministry of OCW has no overview of the number of teachers working at a B3 school, and therefore also not whether teachers at a B3 school are employed permanently or as freelancers.
Het Ministerie van OCW heeft geen overzicht van het aantal docenten dat op een b3-school werkt, en dus ook niet of docenten op een b3-school in vast dienstverband of als zzp-er werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht 'Basisscholen bestookt met ‘linkse’ lespakketten: Het is echt dagelijkse spam’

Kisteman (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Education about reports that primary schools are flooded with unsolicited, 'left-leaning' teaching packages, and whether schools are protected against one-sided information and commercial interests. The State Secretary said schools are free to choose materials within the law, expressed concern about the overload and called on providers to be restrained, but declined to inventory package use and did not propose binding rules.
Given the constitutional freedom of education regarding teaching materials, it does not fit my responsibility to carry out an inventory of the use of teaching packages.
Gezien de grondwettelijke onderwijsvrijheid ten aanzien van leermiddelen past het niet bij mijn verantwoordelijkheid om een inventarisatie te doen naar het gebruik van lespakketten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het artikel 'Schuldhulpverlening ziet fors meer bedrijven met geldzorgen'

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about rising debt-relief requests from small businesses, including the pilots and the proposed access point and bookkeeping voucher. The minister acknowledges the trend, reports on pilots and an access point due in Q1 2025, rejects the voucher, and points to municipal support.
As soon as those are available, we will send them to the House.
Zodra die beschikbaar zijn zullen we die naar de Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over prijzen van supermarkten en benzinestations

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about fuel stations passing down price drops slowly (the 'rockets and feathers' effect), supermarkets apparently aligning prices, and how consumers can be protected against such strategies. The minister acknowledged ACM research showing consumers overpaid 2.2 to 4.8 cents per litre, said the ACM currently cannot target such market failures and is reviewing its instruments, and pointed to a forthcoming letter to Parliament on the matter.
I am therefore currently examining whether the ACM's instruments should be revised.
Ik onderzoek daarom momenteel of het instrumentarium van de ACM moet worden herzien
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over de berichten 'PostNL mag tarieven voor brieven en pakketten volgend jaar verhogen' en 'PostNL neemt twee keer zoveel tijd voor bezorging zakelijke post'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that PostNL may raise stamp and parcel tariffs next year and will take longer to deliver business mail, and about how the ACM sets tariff room, cost allocation and quality. The minister answered that the ACM sets the tariff room by statutory formula, that PostNL allocates universal-service costs under an ACM-approved system, that business mail delivery times are for PostNL and its clients to agree, and that studies due in early 2025 will inform structural postal reforms.
On the basis of these studies I will make policy choices on the future of the postal market and structural measures to be taken.
Op basis hiervan zal ik beleidskeuzes maken over de toekomst van de postmarkt en te nemen structurele maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Kisteman over het bericht «Steeds meer Twentse scholen vinden Paarse Vrijdag maar gedoe»

MPs Becker and Kisteman asked the State Secretary of Education about a report that more Twente schools find Paarse Vrijdag (Purple Friday, an LGBTIQ+ awareness initiative) burdensome, and about acceptance, safety, and support for LGBTIQ+ pupils. The answers affirm the importance of sexual diversity education, report COC-coordinated participation by nearly 3,000 school locations, describe ministry subsidies and support for GSAs, and promise talks with Twente schools and further follow-up on the evaluation of the safety action plan.
I am happy to discuss this with the Twente secondary schools and the Healthy School Programme
Ik ga hier graag over in gesprek met de Twentse middelbare scholen en het Programma Gezonde School
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het nieuwsbericht ‘Winkelstraat loopt verder leeg: al 433.000 vierkante meter niet meer gebruikt’

The MP asks the minister about reports of growing vacancy in shopping streets, especially in smaller town centres, and the role of municipalities and the Impuls Winkelgebieden programme. The minister answers that the Corona effect has faded, that municipalities must take local lead, and that the first evaluation is due in 2027.
At the end of November the last decisions will be issued.
Eind november zullen de laatste beschikkingen worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht 'Tandarts en andere mkb’ers wacht nog een berg bureaucratie'

MPs Kisteman (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a newspaper report on mounting bureaucratic burdens on small businesses, including rising compliance costs, reporting obligations and the role of the Adviescollege Toetsing Regeldruk. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says regulatory burden is a political trade-off, points to ongoing sector studies and a programme due in autumn, and defers the choice of a new reduction programme to the next cabinet.

The Adviescollege Toetsing Regeldruk (ATR) advises the States General and cabinet and oversees correct, transparent information provision so that the cabinet and States General can decide on regulation on an informed basis.

Het Adviescollege Toetsing Regeldruk (ATR) adviseert Staten-Generaal en kabinet en ziet toe op een juiste, transparante informatievoorziening zodat het kabinet en Staten-Generaal onderbouwd kunnen beslissen over regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Kisteman over de zero-emissiezones

MPs Veltman and Kisteman asked the state secretary about zero-emission zones, including the exemption for small businesses requested in a motion, the timing of the Central ZE-zones exemption counter, and the risk of small businesses disappearing from the streets. The state secretary answered that an extra exemption for certain older vans has been agreed, that the counter is being prepared to open by 1 July 2024 with municipalities, and that existing exemption categories cover those who cannot yet transition.
That is why I am working with the RDW and the municipalities to have a functioning counter ready from 1 July 2024.
Daarom zet ik mij samen met de RDW en de gemeenten in om al vanaf 1 juli 2024 een functionerend loket gereed te hebben.

m: Motie van het lid Sneller c.s. over de gemeente Grave bestuurlijk en financieel voorbereiden op een herindeling
Asks the government, with the province, to help the municipality of Grave prepare financially and administratively for a merger should its residents wish it.
requests the government, in close cooperation with the provincial executive, to promote that the municipality of Grave is prepared administratively and financially for a merger

verzoekt de regering, de komende periode binnen haar mogelijkheden en verantwoordelijkheden in nauwe samenwerking met het provinciebestuur te bevorderen dat de gemeente Grave in bestuurlijk en financieel opzicht voorbereid wordt op een herindeling
Motie van het lid Snoeren c.s. over een grenscorrectie voor de dorpen Sint Pancras en Koedijk

Asks the government to explore, after the merger process, a border correction moving Sint Pancras and/or Koedijk to Alkmaar, consulting the province and residents, and to report to the House within a year.
requests the government to explore whether a border correction for the villages Sint Pancras and/or Koedijk
verzoekt de regering ... te verkennen of voor de dorpen Sint Pancras en/of Koedijk een grenscorrectie
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Snoeren en Bisschop ter vervanging van nr. 17 over een absolute weigeringsgrond voor de openbaarmaking van bedrijfs- en fabricagegegevens

Creates an absolute ground for refusing public disclosure of confidential business and manufacturing data supplied to government, limiting access to government information under the Open Government Act.
so that this information is not made public. For this data an absolute ground for refusal applies instead of a relative ground for refusal.
zodat deze informatie niet openbaar wordt gemaakt. Zo geldt er voor deze gegevens een absolute weigeringsgrond in plaats van een relatieve weigeringsgrond.
Amendement van de leden Snoeren en Bisschop over een absolute weigeringsgrond voor de openbaarmaking van bedrijfs- en fabricagegegevens
Amends the Open Government Act so that business and manufacturing data given confidentially to government are an absolute ground for refusing disclosure rather than a relative one.
This way an absolute ground for refusal applies to this data instead of a relative ground for refusal.
Zo geldt er voor deze gegevens een absolute weigeringsgrond in plaats van een relatieve weigeringsgrond.
Motie van het lid Bruins c.s. over de effecten van drie volmachtstemmen per kiezer

Asks the government to map the positive and negative effects of tripling proxy votes per voter in the evaluation of the re-run elections and to reconsider the extension before the next general election.
requests the government, in the evaluation of the re-run elections, to explicitly map the positive and negative effects of this extension
verzoekt de regering, in de evaluatie van de herindelingsverkiezingen nadrukkelijk de positieve en negatieve effecten van deze uitbreiding in kaart te brengen
Motie van de leden Snoeren en Terpstra over uiterlijk één maand na de herindelingsverkiezingen de evaluatie naar de Kamer sturen
Asks the government to send the evaluation of the 2020 reorganisation elections to the House no later than one month after the elections.
requests the government to send the evaluation to the House at the latest one month after the reorganisation elections
verzoekt de regering, de evaluatie ten uiterste één maand na de herindelingsverkiezingen aan de Kamer te doen toekomen
qa: Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Snoeren en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht 'Wethouder voor twee maanden kost Meerssen bijna drie ton!'

MPs Snoeren and Nijkerken-de Haan asked the Minister of Interior about a Meerssen alderman whose two-month tenure triggers a large wachtgeld (severance) payment, and whether the costs and BBV provisioning rules create perverse incentives for small municipalities. The minister defended the career principle in the APPA pension law, said the Meerssen case is exceptional, and rejected amending the law.
I am not considering any amendment of the Appa on this point.
Ik overweeg op dit punt geen aanpassing van de Appa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snoeren, Lodders en Ziengs over het bericht 'Woonbelasting weer omhoog: uitschieters tot +27%!'

VVD MPs asked the government about reported large rises in local property and waste charges for 2021, the effect of abolishing the macro norm and introducing the local-cost benchmark, and possible caps and measures against rising fees. The minister answered that the national picture awaits the COELO atlas, that the benchmark is too recent to evaluate (evaluation planned for 2025), that local councils decide on charges, and that the rise in the import-waste tax is unlikely to raise local waste fees.
It is still too early to determine the effects of introducing the local-cost benchmark, because the benchmark was only introduced in 2020.
Het is nog te vroeg om te kunnen constateren wat de gevolgen van de invoering van de benchmark lokale lasten zijn, omdat de benchmark pas in 2020 is ingevoerd.

m: Motie Haverkamp c.s. over een officiële "Go America 2009"
Asks the government to organise an official 'Go America 2009' commemoration event in September 2009.
requests the government to organise an official 'Go America 2009' in line with other initiatives in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering in aansluiting op andere initiatieven in Nederland een officiele «Go America 2009» te organiseren
Motie Van Dam en Van Baalen over een nota inzake de strategische overwegingen achter het handelsbeleid
Asks the government to send parliament a note by next spring on strategic considerations behind trade policy as a tool to influence countries such as China, Russia and India.
requests the government to send the House a note by next spring on the strategic foreign-policy considerations behind trade policy
verzoekt de regering de Kamer uiterlijk komend voorjaar een nota te sturen waarin wordt ingegaan op de vanuit buitenlands beleid ingegeven strategische overwegingen achter het handelsbeleid
Motie Van Baalen c.s. over de erkenning van het lot van troostmeisjes door Japan
Motion asks the government to keep recognition of the comfort women issue in Japan relations and to press Japan for an additional gesture, raising it during visits.
requests the government, in line with the letter, to raise recognition of the comfort women and pressing Japan for an additional gesture with the Japanese government, including during future visits

verzoekt de regering overeenkomstig het gestelde in de bovengenoemde brief, de erkenning van het lot van de troostmeisjes en het aandringen op een aanvullend gebaar van Japan in de richting van hen, ook bij voorkomende bezoeken onder de aandacht van de Japanse regering te brengen
Motie Voordewind c.s. over het aan de orde stellen van eerbiediging van de mensenrechten tijdens de EU-China-top
Asks the government to press China on human rights such as press freedom, housing compensation and labour rights at the EU-China summit.
requests the government to vigorously raise respect for the aforementioned human rights during the EU-China summit
verzoekt de regering om de eerbiediging van bovengenoemde mensenrechten tijdens de EU-China-top sterk aan de orde te stellen
Motie Voordewind c.s. over maatregelen tegen Iran wanneer de maatregelen van de Veiligheidsraad te lang op zich laten wachten
Calls on the government to press for additional Iran sanctions in the Security Council and, if these are delayed too long, to pursue measures within the EU and with like-minded countries.
calls on the government, when additional Security Council measures take too long, to pursue measures within the EU and with like-minded countries
roept de regering op wanneer additionele VR-maatregelen al te lang op zich laten wachten, binnen de EU en met gelijkgezinde landen tot maatregelen te komen
Motie Haverkamp c.s. over een platform economische wederopbouw na conflict
Asks the government to set up a platform on economic reconstruction after conflict, with all relevant departments, NGOs and business represented.
requests the government to establish a platform for economic reconstruction after conflict, in which all relevant departments, NGOs and business are represented
verzoekt de regering een platform Economische Wederopbouw na conflict op te richten, waarin alle departementen ter zake, ngo's en het bedrijfsleven zijn vertegenwoordigd

qa: Vragen van de leden Roemer (SP), Cohen (PvdA), Wilders (PVV), Sap (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP), Blok (VVD), Slob (ChristenUnie), Thieme (PvdD), Pechtold (D66) en Van Haersma Buma (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van V

MPs from ten parties asked the state secretary of Security and Justice why Germany refused to extradite the fugitive war criminal Klaas-Carel Faber, whether German nationality obtained through a Hitler decree was the reason, and whether the Netherlands would press Germany to enforce the sentence. The minister answered that a Munich court refused extradition because Faber is a German national who did not consent, that German authorities also consider him German without the decree, and that letters were sent to the Bavarian and federal German justice ministers asking that the sentence be enforced in Germany.
By letter of 31 May 2011 I made known to the Minister of Justice of the German state of Bavaria the importance I attach to the law taking its course in this case.
Bij brief van 31 mei 2011 heb ik het belang dat ik eraan hecht dat in deze zaak het recht zijn loop krijgt kenbaar gemaakt aan de Minister van Justitie van de Duitse deelstaat Beieren.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen

MPs asked whether the cabinet's speed-limit increase to 130 km/h could be measured by kilometres of road where 130 km/h is allowed, what the targets and milestones are, and how accountability will be given. The minister confirmed the plan, described an eight-stretch dynamic-speed experiment (about 330 km) and a goal of at least a third of motorways at 130 km/h this term, and said accountability would be given during budget debates without fixed annual targets.
The cabinet will account for this during the budget debate.
Het kabinet zal bij de begrotingsbehandeling verantwoording afleggen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the cabinet measures Dutch knowledge-economy position, what the baseline and interim targets are for reaching the global top 5, and how it will be held accountable. The minister answered that the position is based on the Global Competitiveness Index, that sub-targets with concrete benchmarks will follow in the 2012 budget, and that annual reporting will occur through the departmental annual report.
The chosen sub-targets for education, science and innovation will be further elaborated in the 2012 budget, with concrete target values.
De gekozen subdoelstellingen voor onderwijs, wetenschap en innovatie zullen in de begroting 2012 nader worden uitgewerkt, met concrete streefwaarden.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD), aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen

Six opposition MPs asked the minister to specify measurable, enforceable CO2 targets for 2020, including Mton limits inside and outside the ETS, interim targets, foreign allowance purchases and accountability. The state secretary confirmed the 20% target, explained the EU ETS and non-ETS split, said the exact Dutch non-ETS figure awaits a PBL analysis and a spring 2011 letter, and promised such clarity then.
Due to uncertainties it is too early to draw conclusions, but the Netherlands appears to be on track with current policy to achieve sufficient reduction in the non-ETS sectors.
Door onzekerheden is het te vroeg conclusies te trekken, maar Nederland lijkt met het huidig ingezette beleid goed op weg om voldoende reductie in de niet-ETS sectoren te realiseren.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen

Six opposition MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment for measurable targets, indicators, baselines, interim goals, instruments and accountability for the government's inland shipping investments meant to relieve roads and the environment. The minister listed indicators (lock passage times, waterway norm compliance, emissions, incidents), pointed to the annual report and planned targets for 2012 onward, and referred the jeugdzorg budget question to another minister.
For the accessibility of waterways, annual target values are formulated.
Voor de bereikbaarheid van vaarwegen worden jaarlijkse streefwaarden geformuleerd.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen

Six opposition MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment for measurable, verifiable government targets on backlog maintenance of flood defences and on how the government will report on progress each year. The state secretary answered that the existing 6-yearly assessment cycle sets the framework, that a new flood-protection programme (HWBP3) and an integral safety programme will be presented before the 2012 budget, and that progress will be reported through the budget cycle and separate programme reports.

As I promised in a Second Chamber debate on 13 December 2010, I will present an integral safety programme before the 2012 budget, giving insight into the flood-safety task in the coming years and the costs involved.

Zoals, tijdens een debat in de Tweede Kamer op 13 december 2010 door mij is toegezegd, zal ik vóór de begroting 2012 een integraal veiligheidsprogramma aanbieden dat inzicht zal bieden wat de waterveiligheidsopgave de komende jaren zal zijn en welke kosten daarmee gepaard zullen gaan.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen over

MPs asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum whether the cabinet targets a quarter less asylum inflow, 30% less regular inflow and 50% less non-Western inflow by 2015, and how it will be accounted for. The minister confirmed the package aims at a very substantial decline, but said no intermediate targets exist, that the effects cannot be quantified precisely, and that inflow will be reported to parliament twice a year.
No intermediate targets have been set, other than the annual savings and investment amounts included in the financial section of the coalition agreement.
Er zijn geen tussendoelen vastgesteld, anders dan de in de financiële paragraaf van het regeerakkoord opgenomen jaarlijks te besparen en te investeren bedragen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

Opposition MPs asked the cabinet how performance pay for teachers would be defined, measured, funded and accounted for, and when the goals would be met. The state secretary answered that experiments with performance pay will be set up with CPB and Erasmus University from 2012, structural introduction from 2014-2015 at the earliest, and accountability via the departmental annual report, while leaving the criteria, the size of the pay rise and the number of teachers affected undecided.
The starting point in designing the various experiments is that they provide sufficiently objectifiable information for the eventual design of the measure.
Het uitgangspunt bij de uitwerking van de verschillende experimenten is dat zij voldoende objectiveerbare informatie leveren voor de uiteindelijke vormgeving van de maatregel.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afrekenbare en controleerbar

Six opposition MPs asked the Interior Minister how the government's planned wage freeze in the public sector would be measured, what milestones apply, how it would be achieved and how it would be accounted for. The minister answered that the target is the budgetary yield (EUR 870 million structurally by 2015), that the measure is legally feasible, that wage talks with unions start when existing collective agreements expire, and that accountability occurs in the spring budget cycle, giving little measurable detail.
The goal is the budgetary yield of structurally 870 million.
Het doel is de budgettaire opbrengst van structureel 870 mln.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afreke

MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the cabinet will progressively restrict social rental allocation to lower-income groups and for measurable targets, definitions, interim goals, instruments and accountability. The minister confirmed the policy, pointed to the temporary regulation requiring at least 90% of low-rent homes go to households below a set income, and said he will assess housing corporations annually from 2012 against these rules.
Failure to meet these requirements may lead to withholding of compensation (state aid).
Het niet voldoen aan deze eisen kan leiden tot onthouden van compensatie (staatssteun).

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afrekenbare en controleerbar

MPs asked the government to define measurable, accountable targets, baselines, interim goals and reporting for the planned Randstad Infrastructure Authority, and whether powers over transport and infrastructure would transfer from national, provincial and municipal government to it. The minister deferred substantive answers to a vision note due in March 2011, noting the Randstad plan is one of 17 reforms that will be accounted for in the policy agenda.

During the budget debate for the Ministry of the Interior on 1 December 2010, I promised you that in March 2011 I would present a vision note on the organisation and functioning of domestic governance.

Tijdens de behandeling van de begroting voor Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties op 1 december 2010 zegde ik u toe in maart 2011 te komen met een visienota inzake de inrichting en functioneren van het binnenlands bestuur.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the education minister whether the cabinet's target of cutting early school leavers to at most 25,000 covers all leavers, what interim targets and instruments exist, and how progress will be reported. The minister confirmed the 25,000 target for 2014/2015, set 35,000 for 2010/2011, promised a letter by March 2011 and a shift to a percentage norm, and pointed to budgeted funds and annual reporting to parliament.

By March 2011 at the latest I will send a letter to the House of Representatives with the results for school year 2009/2010, in relation to the current early school leaving covenants with municipalities, schools and institutions.
Uiterlijk maart 2011 stuur ik een brief naar de Tweede Kamer met het resultaat van het schooljaar 2009/2010, in relatie tot de huidige vsv-convenanten met gemeenten, scholen en instellingen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinet

MPs asked the education minister which performance targets, indicators, baselines and milestones the cabinet will use to meet its promise that education performance will rise, and how it will act and report. The minister answered that targets and indicators will be specified in the 2012 budget, that a baseline is the September 2010 value, and that progress will be reported through the departmental annual report and OCW monitoring publications.
The sub-objectives and associated effect and performance indicators will be further elaborated in the 2012 budget, with concrete target values.
De subdoelstellingen en bijbehorende effect- en prestatie indicatoren zullen in de begroting 2012 nader worden uitgewerkt, met concrete streefwaarden.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the Minister of Education whether the cabinet aims to reach more children through early childhood education (vve), what the baseline is, and how targets, selection, instruments and annual accountability will be set. The minister confirmed the aim, cited about 28,000 children in preschool and 25,000 in early primary education, and deferred detailed targets, measures and planning to a letter in spring 2011, while stating annual accountability via the departmental annual report.
In that letter I will make the objectives of the vve policy more concrete and add a planning of the actions I undertake.
In die brief maak ik de doelstellingen van het vve-beleid concreter en voeg daar een planning bij van de acties die ik onderneem.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en controleerbar

Six opposition MPs asked the state secretary for health how the government's planned reform of youth care would be measured, including baseline, interim targets, and how a €300 million cut fits with improving effectiveness. The state secretary said the reform aims at integrated care, stronger self-reliance and less bureaucracy, with municipalities made responsible, and that accountability would follow the regular cycle, without giving concrete measurable indicators or targets.
The cabinet will account for this within the regular cycle.
Het kabinet zal binnen de reguliere cyclus verantwoording afleggen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en

MPs from several parties asked the minister whether the cabinet's target of 12,000 extra nurses is measurable and accountable, including its exact definition, baseline, interim targets and reporting. The state secretary answered that the target is about enabling 12,000 extra staff in care, that no other measurable indicators or interim targets exist yet, and that a visiejbrief and a joint labour market agenda will follow with annual reporting.
Annual reports will be published under the Labour Market Care and Welfare Research Programme, containing overviews of the number of nursing, care and social pedagogical staff.

Wel worden in het kader van het Onderzoeksprogramma Arbeidsmarkt Zorg en Welzijn jaarlijks rapporten gepubliceerd, waarin overzichten zijn opgenomen over het aantal verplegend, verzorgend en sociaal agogisch personeel.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en

Seven opposition MPs asked the Health Minister whether the government's goal of improving elderly care quality has measurable targets, indicators, a baseline, interim goals, and a plan with accountability. The state secretary answered that no measurable indicators or interim targets were set, that existing sector quality indicators are used, and referred to the coalition agreement and an upcoming vision letter for measures.
The exact goal is not expressed in measurable indicators.
Het exacte doel is niet uitgedrukt in meetbare indicatoren.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabine

Six opposition MPs asked the health minister for measurable, accountable targets for narrowing the AWBZ eligibility group, including indicators, baselines, interim goals, measures and annual accountability. The state secretary answered that no measurable indicators, baseline or interim targets exist beyond financial figures, and referred to the coalition agreement and a forthcoming policy letter for measures and timing.
The exact goal is not expressed in measurable indicators. No effect or performance indicators are used.
Het exacte doel is niet uitgedrukt in meetbare indicatoren. Er worden geen effect- en prestatie-indicatoren gehanteerd.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en

Six opposition MPs asked the health minister for measurable, verifiable targets behind the government's plan to freeze the group eligible for the health care allowance (zorgtoeslag). The minister answered that only the budgetary targets in the coalition agreement's financial annex apply, that eligibility figures for 2011 can only be established later, and that accountability will follow the regular cycle.
There is no target in the coalition agreement regarding the number of health care allowance users.
Er staat geen doel in het regeerakkoord ten aanzien van het aantal zorgtoeslaggebruikers.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the health minister whether the cabinet intends to expand market competition in curative care, and for measurable, checkable targets, baselines, milestones and accountability arrangements for that goal. The minister confirmed a package of measures (wider free pricing, uniform product definitions, abolishing functional funding, profit distribution under conditions, the Wet Marktordening Gezondheidszorg) and promised letters in early 2011, with half-yearly progress reports to parliament.
I aim to address, in early 2011 letters, the goals, instruments and means regarding the cabinet agenda on market forces in curative care and performance-based funding.
Ik streef er naar om begin 2011 in genoemde brieven in te gaan op de doelen, instrumenten en middelen met betrekking tot de kabinetsagenda rondom marktwerking in de cure en prestatiebekostiging.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afrekenbare en controleerbare

MPs asked the economics minister for measurable, checkable targets, baselines and milestones for the government's plan to concentrate business subsidies on top sectors. The minister confirmed the plan but deferred concrete indicators, instruments and budgets to a business policy letter and a mid-2011 update, and pointed to the annual report for accountability.
The House of Representatives will be informed around mid-2011 about the concrete elaboration of business policy, particularly regarding the top sectors.
De Tweede Kamer zal medio 2011 worden geïnformeerd over de concrete uitwerking van het bedrijfslevenbeleid, in het bijzonder met betrekking tot de topgebieden.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

Six MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs for measurable, verifiable targets, baselines and interim milestones for improving SME access to government tenders. The minister confirmed the goal but deferred measurable indicators and milestones to a later memorandum, citing measures in the new Procurement Act and an evaluation after four years.
The cabinet will go into this further in the memorandum in response to the report on the bill for the new Procurement Act.
Het kabinet zal hier verder op ingaan bij de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag bij het wetsvoorstel voor de nieuwe Aanbestedingswet.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

Six opposition MPs asked ministers for measurable, checkable targets for abolishing the numerus fixus in medicine, including student numbers, interim goals and accountability. The government confirmed the coalition agreement's five-year abolition plan but deferred the concrete indicators, targets and instruments to a later response to the advisory council's report.
The response to the RVZ advice will further address the elaboration of the coalition agreement.
In de reactie op het advies van de RVZ zal nader worden ingegaan op de uitwerking van het regeerakkoord.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs for measurable, enforceable targets for 14% renewable energy by 2020, including baselines, interim milestones and how the government will be held accountable. The minister confirmed the 14% target (about 290 PJ), stated no interim targets will be set, deferred a fuller assessment and promised an SDE+ evaluation in 2014 and an annual accountability letter in May.
The cabinet does not set interim targets for the individual years.
Het kabinet hanteert geen tussendoelstelling voor de afzonderlijke jaren.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabine

Six opposition MPs asked the health minister whether the cabinet will move conditions with low disease burden out of the basic health insurance package, and asked for measurable, accountable targets, definitions, baselines, interim goals and accountability arrangements. The minister confirmed removal from the basic package to save 1.3 billion euros from 2015, said the government does not decide what supplementary insurers cover, and promised a plan of action in early 2012 while giving no interim targets and only general accountability through the regular cycle.
Not at this moment. The low-disease-burden approach requires further elaboration.
Op dit moment niet. De benadering via het lage-ziektelastcriterium vereist nadere uitwerking.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

MPs from several parties asked the minister whether the cabinet aims for 2% annual energy savings until 2020 and requested measurable, verifiable targets, baselines, interim goals, actions and accountability. The minister answered that the cabinet has no separate energy-saving target, that targets are EU climate and renewable goals, and that existing covenants will continue alongside a planned Green Deal, with a letter on the Green Deal promised for February 2011.

As indicated in the answer to question 1, this cabinet has no separate target for energy saving. There will therefore be no baseline measurement, interim targets, measurable indicators or progress reports.

Zoals bij het antwoord op vraag 1 aangegeven, heeft dit kabinet geen separate doelstelling voor energiebesparing. Van nulmeting, tussendoelen, meetbare indicatoren en voortgangsrapportages zal dan ook geen sprake zijn.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afrekenbare en controleerbar

MPs asked the Interior Minister for measurable, verifiable targets, baselines, interim milestones and accountability arrangements for the planned reduction of elected and executive political office holders in municipalities, provinces, water boards and the national parliament. The minister confirmed a reduction of at least 25% for local and provincial bodies and one-third for each chamber of parliament, with the baseline set at current membership and constitutional and statutory amendments to follow in 2011, but gave no interim targets or detailed reporting schedule.
A constitutional amendment is required to reduce the number of members of the States General. The cabinet will bring a proposal for such an amendment into procedure in 2011.
Voor de vermindering van het aantal leden van de Staten-Generaal is grondwetswijziging vereist. Het kabinet zal daartoe in 2011 een voorstel tot grondwetswijziging in procedure brengen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether the cabinet aims to cut administrative burden for businesses by 10% by 2012 and 5% yearly thereafter, and how this target would be measured, achieved, verified and accounted for. The minister answered that all seven questions, including the measurability and accountability of the targets, will be addressed separately in a regulatory burden letter to be sent in February 2011.
The question on the accountability and verifiability of cabinet targets regarding administrative burden and regulatory pressure will be answered separately in the Regulatory Burden letter.
De vraag over omtrent de afrekenbaarheid en controleerbaarheid van kabinetsdoelen met betrekking tot administratieve lasten en regeldruk, zal separaat beantwoord worden in de Regeldrukbrief

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

MPs asked the economics minister for measurable targets, baselines, interim goals, instruments and reporting timelines for the government's aim to strengthen links between knowledge, research and innovation policy. The minister confirmed the aim but deferred concrete indicators, targets and budgets to a forthcoming business policy letter and topic-area agendas, with accountability via the annual report.
The House of Representatives will be informed around mid-2011 about the concrete elaboration of business policy, particularly regarding the top sectors.
De Tweede Kamer zal medio 2011 worden geïnformeerd over de concrete uitwerking van het bedrijfslevenbeleid, in het bijzonder met betrekking tot de topgebieden.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afreke

Seven opposition MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the cabinet's right-to-buy goal for corporation tenants has measurable targets, annual sales figures, interim milestones, legal obstacles and instruments. The Minister confirmed the intention, but said detailed answers would come in a spring 2011 elaboration and it was premature to answer the specifics now.
As indicated, your House will receive an elaboration of the passage in the Coalition Agreement in spring 2011. It is premature to go into parts of that elaboration now.
Zoals aangegeven ontvangt uw Kamer in het voorjaar van 2011 een uitwerking van de passage in het Regeerakkoord. Het is prematuur om nu al op onderdelen van die uitwerking in te gaan.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afreke

MPs asked the Minister of Interior how the cabinet's plan to allow rent increases of inflation plus 5% for tenants of regulated homes with incomes above 43,000 euro would be made measurable and accountable, including targets, indicators, milestones, instruments and reporting. The Minister confirmed the coalition agreement policy as the starting point and referred all the measurement and target questions to a forthcoming housing vision.
For the answers to these questions I refer to the housing vision I promised to send to your House.
Voor de antwoorden op deze vragen verwijs ik naar de door mij aan Uw Kamer toegezegde woonvisie.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the cabinet how it will measure and achieve measurable quality targets for higher education linked to the social loan system, including criteria, benchmarks, milestones, instruments and accountability. The State Secretary answered that the money will be invested in higher education quality, that criteria and targets will be set out in the cabinet response to the Veerman commission and the Strategic Agenda, and that accountability runs through the regular departmental annual report.

For the answer to this question I refer you to the cabinet response to the Veerman commission report, which you will receive in February, and to the Strategic Agenda for Higher Education and Research (June 2011).

Ik verwijs u voor het antwoord op deze vraag naar de kabinetsreactie op het rapport van de commissie-Veerman die u in februari a.s. ontvangt en naar de Strategische Agenda voor het Hoger Onderwijs en Onderzoek (juni 2011).

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over afrekenbare en controleerbare

MPs asked whether the cabinet will pursue a substantial cut in Dutch EU contributions and a structural 1 billion euro reduction, and for measurable targets, baselines, milestones and accountability. The state secretary confirmed the aim, explained that the current 1 billion rebate continues until 2013 with no savings booked, and that a substantial reduction is pursued from 2014, but gave no measurable indicators, milestones or accountability arrangements, deferring details to later letters.
You will be informed in due course about the cabinet's precise position on the new financial perspectives.
U zult te zijner tijd worden geïnformeerd over de precieze inzet van het kabinet ten aanzien van de nieuwe financiële perspectieven.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoele

MPs asked the state secretary whether the cabinet will cut development aid from 0.8% to 0.7% of GNI, which missions, reception of unaccompanied minors and the World Broadcasting Service will be paid from the development budget, and what measurable, time-bound goals and accountability apply. The answers confirm the cut and the financing of DAC-eligible parts, defer goals and indicators to the 2012 budget, and promise accountability through the annual report.

During the elaboration of the policy review along the lines set out in the basic letter of 26 November 2010, the goals will be further specified and, where possible, accompanied by effect and performance indicators, baseline measurements and interim targets.

Tijdens de uitwerking van de herziening van het beleid langs de lijnen zoals uiteengezet in de basisbrief dd 26 november 2010, zullen de doelen nader gepreciseerd worden en daar waar mogelijk worden vergezeld van effect- en prestatie-indicatoren, nulmetingen en tussentijdse doelen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over afrekenbare en controleer

MPs asked the Justice minister whether the national police is under ministerial responsibility, what measurable indicators, interim targets, steps, timing and annual accountability apply to forming a national police force. The minister confirmed ministerial responsibility, cited goals such as less bureaucracy and more effective investigation, but deferred timing and interim targets to the pending police law amendment, promising indicators where possible and reporting through the annual report.

The pace of forming the national police and the interim steps to be taken are first determined by the process of legally regulating the national police through an amendment to the police bill previously submitted to the House.

Het tempo van de vorming van de nationale politie en de te zetten tussenstappen worden allereerst bepaald door het proces om nationale politie wettelijk te regelen via een wijziging van het eerder bij de Kamer ingediende wetsvoorstel

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Defensie over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen met betrekking t

MPs from several parties asked the defence minister whether the cabinet's structural defence cuts of 635 million euros (possibly reaching one billion) are correct, what the JSF cost overrun means, and what measurable, verifiable targets, baselines, interim goals, instruments and accountability arrangements exist for these cuts. The minister confirmed the phased cut and the possible one billion euro total, said a policy letter next spring will set out measures including a review of the F-16 replacement project, and deferred the measurable-target and accountability questions to the 2012 budget, pointing to existing progress reports.
On Budget Day I will inform the House further in the 2012 budget about the measurability of objectives and results and how Defence can (further) account for them.
Met Prinsjesdag zal ik in de begroting 2012 de Kamer nader informeren over de meetbaarheid van doelstellingen en resultaten en de manier waarop Defensie (verder) verantwoording kan afleggen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over afrekenbare en controleer

MPs asked whether the cabinet will raise the detection rate for serious crimes by 25%, double convictions for robbery, and speed up simple criminal cases, and asked for measurable targets, baselines, interim goals, instruments and reporting arrangements. The minister confirmed the three targets, said progress will be monitored and reported in the annual report from 2011 and in a letter to parliament, and described general means but gave no specific indicators, baselines or interim targets.
The cabinet will monitor progress towards the targets based on figures from, among others, the police, the Public Prosecution Service and the Council for the Judiciary.
Het kabinet zal de voortgang van realisatie van de doelstellingen monitoren op basis van cijfermateriaal van onder meer de politie, het Openbaar Ministerie en de Raad voor de Rechtspraak.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over afrekenbare en controleer

Seven MPs from across the opposition asked the Minister of Security and Justice for measurable targets, indicators, yearly milestones, funding adequacy and reporting for the planned 3,000 additional police officers. The minister referred to a letter of 14 December 2010 for most questions and said the 1 January 2011 operational strength baseline was not yet known, to be reported in June.
For answering these questions I refer for brevity to my letter to the House of Representatives of 14 December 2010.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik kortheidshalve naar mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 14 december 2010

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Financiën over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen met betrekking

MPs from several parties asked the Finance Minister for measurable, accountable targets on sound public finances, including indicators, baselines, interim targets, actions and reporting. The minister confirmed the goal of restoring the budget, pointed to the Startnota expenditure and revenue frameworks and an 18 billion euro package in 2015, but declined separate effect and performance indicators and gave only general reporting through budget documents.
Apart from the stated objective, using separate effect and performance indicators is not under consideration.
Naast genoemde doelstelling is het hanteren van separate effect- en prestatie-indicatoren niet aan de orde.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afrekenbare en controleerbar

MPs ask the Minister of Interior Affairs for measurable, verifiable targets, baselines, interim milestones, instruments and accountability arrangements for the cabinet's plan to scale up provincial government in the Randstad. The minister replies that a vision memo on internal governance will follow in March 2011, that the Randstad plans are one of 17 cabinet reforms, and that progress will be reported in the policy agenda and annual report.
In this memo I will also address the cabinet's intentions regarding the scaling up of provincial government in the Randstad.
In deze nota zal ik ook in gaan op de kabinetsvoornemens inzake de opschaling van het provinciaal bestuur in de Randstad.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afreke

MPs asked whether the cabinet aims to reduce civil servants across all government tiers, and asked for measurable targets, interim goals, instruments and annual accountability. The minister replied that the goal is a smaller state expressed as a financial cut of EUR 6.6 billion structurally (EUR 1.8 billion for central government), not in headcount, with an implementation programme to be sent to parliament before March 2011 and annual accountability on Accountability Day.
It concerns a financial target that has not been translated into numbers of persons or fte's.
Het betreft een financiële taakstelling die niet is vertaald in aantallen personen of in fte's.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinet

MPs from several parties asked the minister of Social Affairs whether the cabinet is cutting childcare allowance, what the effects, measurable goals, indicators, baselines and milestones are, and how accountability will be given. The minister confirmed the cuts, gave budget figures, but mostly deferred measurable goals and indicators to the 2012 budget and the forthcoming bill, promising a legislative proposal and annual accountability.
The objectives of the cabinet policy based on the coalition agreement will be incorporated into the regular operational objectives and indicators in the relevant articles of the 2012 budget.

De doelstellingen van het kabinetsbeleid op basis van het regeerakkoord zullen worden verwerkt in de reguliere operationele doelstellingen en indicatoren in de betrokken artikelen van de begroting 2012.

MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs for measurable, accountable targets for reducing benefit fraud and how the government will achieve them. The minister confirmed harder enforcement, gave budgetary savings targets, and deferred the measurable indicators, baseline, interim goals, action plan and costs to a plan of action due in February, with accountability via the annual report and the Integrale Rapportage Handhaving.
In February the House of Representatives will receive the action plan setting out how the government intends to achieve the fraud target.
In februari ontvangt de Tweede Kamer het plan van aanpak hoe de regering de fraudedoelstelling wil behalen.

MPs from six parties asked the Minister of Interior whether the cabinet's cuts to the municipal and provincial funds and the ISV/BLS urban renewal budget are linked to measurable, checkable targets, and what indicators, interim goals and accountability will apply. The minister answered that the cuts serve the restoration of public finances measured by the EMU balance, that no separate effect or performance indicators apply, and that accountability will be given annually in May.
Question 4: Which effect and performance indicators are used? Answer 4: In view of the answer to question 3, this question does not apply.
